 1025: ##### 3.4.9.9.4 SYNAXIS OF THE MOST HOLY THEOTOKOS ON SUNDAY
 1026: The Service of the Synaxis and the Troparion and Kontakion of St. the Betrothed, prescribed for 26 December are not taken, but the Service of the Sunday after the Nativity is sung, according to the rule, which we will give here, first of the ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity.
 1027:  
 1028: ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity
 1029: Note: This Saturday has three cases: it can fall either on the first, or on the last day of the Afterfeast of the Nativity of Christ, or on others. When it falls on the first day, that is 26 December, then it is taken with the Synaxis of the Most Holy Theotokos and has a separate rule; when - on the last, that is 31 December, then it is taken with the Apodosis of the feast of the Nativity and has a separate rule; if on others, that is 27, 28, 29 and 30 December, then it also has a separate rule. We will give consistently all three rules.
 1030: 
 1031: #### 3.4.10.1 RULE
 1032: 
 1033: ##### 3.4.10.1.1 SATURDAY AFTER THE NATIVITY 26 DECEMBER
 1034: with the Synaxis of the Most Holy Theotokos
 1035: 
 1036: #### 3.4.10.2 AT THE LITURGY
 1037: Prokeimenon and Apostle-Gospel - first of the ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity, and then - of the Synaxis. Alleluia of the Saturday and of the Synaxis - common.
 1038: Antiphons, troparia and the rest see 26 December, here on p. 177-178.
 1039: 
 1040: ##### 3.4.10.2.1 SATURDAY AFTER THE NATIVITY 27, 28, 29 OR 30 DECEMBER AT THE LITURGY
 1041: Prokeimenon, Apostle, Gospel and Communion Hymn - of the ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity. Only, if the Saturday falls on 30 December, then the Apostle-Gospel of the Saturday before Theophany is also taken in the second place[^334].
 1042: 
 1043: ##### 3.4.10.2.2 SATURDAY AFTER THE NATIVITY 30 DECEMBER
 1044: with the Apodosis of the feast of the Nativity
 1045: 
 1046: #### 3.4.10.3 AT THE LITURGY
 1047: Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - only of the Feast, and Apostle and Gospel - first of the ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity, also of the Saturday before Theophany[^335]. Everything else - only to the Feast, according to the general rule of the Apodosis of a Feast of the Lord on a weekday.
 1048: ### 3.4.11 Sunday after the Nativity of Christ
 1049: of the Holy and Righteous Kinsmen of God Joseph the Betrothed,
 1050: King David and James, Brother of the Lord
 1051: Note: Also this Sunday, as the Saturday, can fall on 26 December with the Synaxis of the Most Holy Theotokos or on 31 December with the Apodosis of the Nativity, or on 27, 28, 29, 30 December with the Afterfeast of the Nativity. We will give the rules for all these three cases.
 1052: 
 1053: #### 3.4.11.1 RULE
 1054: 
 1055: ##### 3.4.11.1.1 SUNDAY AFTER THE NATIVITY 26 DECEMBER
 1056: with the Synaxis of the Most Holy Theotokos
 1057: Everything according to the rule of the following case, with the exception only of the canon, which has another rule, as will be noted below.
 1058: 
 1059: ##### 3.4.11.1.2 SUNDAY AFTER THE NATIVITY 27, 28, 29 OR 30 DECEMBER
 1060: #### 3.4.11.2 AT Great Vespers
 1061: 
 1062: ##### 3.4.11.2.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 Resurrectional, 4 of the Feast and 3 of the Saints; Glory: of the Saints, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone
 1063: 
 1064: ##### 3.4.11.2.2 Prokeimenon of the day "The Lord is King". There are no readings
 1065: 
 1066: ##### 3.4.11.2.3 Aposticha Resurrectional; Glory: of the Saints, Both now: of the Feast
 1067:

 1069: 
 1070: ##### 3.4.11.2.5 Great Dismissal with commemoration of the Resurrectional service, of the Feast and of the Saints
 1071: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Saints, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the Feast.
 1072: AT Midnight Office: Triadikon Canon of the tone.
 1073: #### 3.4.11.3 AT Great Matins
 1074: 
 1075: ##### 3.4.11.3.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: to the Saints, Both now: of the Feast
 1076: 
 1077: ##### 3.4.11.3.2 Everything else up to the canon - Resurrectional, as usual
 1078: 
 1079: ##### 3.4.11.3.3 Canons 4 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, Theotokos on 2, of the Feast on 4 and of the Saints on 4. (26 December - 3 canons; Resurrectional on 4, both canons of the Feast on 6 and of the Saints on 4). Katavasia of the Feast. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast and Sessional hymn of the Saints; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Saints; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: of the Saints, Both now: of the Feast

 1088: On all: Resurrectional Troparion, and then Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast, on the 3rd and 9th - to the Saints.
 1089: Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast, on the 3rd and 9th - to the Saints.
 1090: 
 1091: #### 3.4.11.5 AT THE LITURGY
 1092: After the Entrance: Resurrectional Troparion, of the Feast and of the Saints; Glory: Kontakion of the Saints, Both now: of the Feast. Everything else - only to the Saints, except the Prokeimenon, which according to Slavic typikons, will be first Resurrectional of the tone, and then of the Saints. The Communion Hymn will be "Praise the Lord" and of the Saints[^336].
 1093: 
 1094: ##### 3.4.11.5.1 SUNDAY AFTER THE NATIVITY 31 DECEMBER
 1095: with the Apodosis of the feast of the Nativity
 1096: Everything according to the rule given for the previous case on p. 182-183, only:
 1097: 
 1098: ##### 3.4.11.5.2 At Matins: Resurrectional Canon on 4, of the Saints on 4 and of the Feast both canons on 6
 1099: 
 1100: ##### 3.4.11.5.3 At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon of the Feast and to the Saints (Resurrectional is not taken). Alleluia - only of the Feast, Apostle-Gospel - only to the Saints. Communion Hymn "Praise the Lord" and of the Feast
 1101: 
 1102: ### 3.4.12 Rule Concerning Saturdays and Sundays between the Nativity and Theophany
 1103: Between the Nativity and Theophany there can be:
 1104: 
 1105: ##### 3.4.12.1 One Saturday and one Sunday
 1106: 
 1107: ##### 3.4.12.2 Two Saturdays and one Sunday
 1108: 
 1109: ##### 3.4.12.3 One Saturday and two Sundays
 1110: 
 1111: ##### 3.4.12.4 Two Saturdays and two Sundays
 1112: This discrepancy regarding the number of Saturdays depends on the day of the week on which the Nativity of Christ falls, as follows from the following table:
 1113: 
 1114: TABLE OF SATURDAYS AND SUNDAYS
 1115: between the Nativity and Theophany
 1116: 
 1117: DECEMBER							JANUARY					
 1118: NATIVITY	Afterfeast of the NATIVITY	APODOSIS	THEOPHANY	Forefeast	THEOPHANY							
 1119: 25	26	27	28	29	30	31	1	2	3	4	5	6
 1120: 
 1121: ##### 3.4.12.5 Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Fr	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Fr
 1122: 
 1123: ##### 3.4.12.6 Mo	Tu	We	Th	Mo	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Mo	Sa
 1124: 
 1125: ##### 3.4.12.7 Tu	We	Th	Mo	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Mo	Sa	Su
 1126: 
 1127: ##### 3.4.12.8 We	Th	Mo	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Mo	Sa	Su	Mo
 1128: 
 1129: ##### 3.4.12.9 Th	Mo	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Mo	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu
 1130: 
 1131: ##### 3.4.12.10 Fr	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Fr	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We
 1132: 
 1133: ##### 3.4.12.11 Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th	Fr	Sa	Su	Mo	Tu	We	Th
 1134: If the Nativity of Christ falls on Sunday or Monday, then between the Nativity and Theophany there will be one Saturday and one Sunday, as you will see in the 1st and 3rd transverse rows of weekly letters.
 1135: If the Nativity of Christ falls on Tuesday, then there will be two Saturdays and one Sunday, as you will see in the 3rd row.
 1136: If the Nativity of Christ on Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, then there will be two Saturdays and two Sundays, as you will see in the 4th, 5th and 6th rows.
 1137: If the Nativity of Christ on Saturday, then there will be one Saturday and two Sundays, as you will see in the 7th row.
 1138: Now, if you wish to know how many Saturdays and Sundays there will be in a given year between the Nativity and Theophany, then first of all you must find out on which day of the week the Nativity of Christ falls, afterwards, going along the transverse line from that day of the week to Theophany, you will find the number of Saturdays and Sundays between the Nativity and Theophany. Regarding the rule which will be for these Saturdays and Sundays in the case when there will be two Saturdays and two Sundays (as in the 4th, 5th and 6th rows), there will be no inconsistency, as there will be no inconsistency in the case when either two Saturdays, or two Sundays (as in the 3rd and 7th rows), for these two Saturdays and two Sundays have their unchangeable rule. But all inconsistencies are limited to the case of only one Saturday or Sunday (as in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd and 7th rows). In this case two questions arise:
 1139: 
 1140: ##### 3.4.12.12 Which of the two Saturdays or Sundays to take? after the Nativity or before Theophany?
 1141: 
 1142: ##### 3.4.12.13 What to do with the second Saturday or Sunday, which then has no place?
 1143: To the first question we answer: if this Saturday or Sunday is in the middle of the feast of the Nativity, that is within December, then the Saturday or Sunday after the Nativity is taken; if - outside the feast of the Nativity, that is within January, then the Saturday or Sunday before Theophany is taken. Regarding the second question, that is what to do with one Saturday or Sunday which sometimes has no place, we answer: Greek books give no rule for this and therefore this Saturday or Sunday should not have been taken. However, the Slavs do not wish to discard anything and give the following rules for this case.
 1144: 
 1145: #### 3.4.12.1 RULE FOR SATURDAYS AND SUNDAYS
 1146: between the Nativity of Christ and Theophany
 1147: 
 1148: SATURDAY
 1149: The Saturday, which will be the one between the Nativity and Theophany can fall either in the middle, or outside the feast of the Nativity: in the middle, namely 30 or 31 December so, as in the first and second rows; outside the feast, namely 1 January, as in the 7th row. If, therefore, it falls in the middle of the feast, then the Apostle-Gospel will be first of the ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity, and after - of the Saturday before Theophany. Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn on 30 December will be only of the ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity; on 31 December, that is on the Apodosis of the feast - will be only of the Feast. If, therefore, it falls outside the feast, as in the 6th row, that is 1 January, then the Apostle-Gospel will be first to the Circumcision, for the Saturday does not have them. On ### 3.4.10 Saturday after the Nativity the Apostle-Gospel is taken on the Apodosis of the feast, 31 December. Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - only of the Feast.
 1150: 
 1151: SUNDAY
 1152: If there be one Sunday between the Nativity and Theophany, then, similarly as for Saturday, it falls either in the middle of the feast, that is 30 or 31 December, as in the 3rd and 2nd rows, or outside the feast, that is 1 January with the Circumcision, as in the 1st row. And if it falls in the middle of the feast, then the Sunday after the Nativity is taken on 30 or 31 December according to the rule given here on p. 182-183. And the Sunday before Theophany is taken on 1 January in the first place, also the Circumcision and everything else according to the rule which is given for 1 January, when it falls on a Sunday. If the Sunday is one and falls on 1 January, as in the 1st row, then the Sunday after the Nativity is taken on 26 December with the Synaxis of the Most Holy Theotokos according to the rule given here on p. 181[^337].
 1153: 
 1154:  
 1155: ### 3.4.13 December: Holy First-Martyr Stephen
 1156: and Venerable Theodore
 1157: The Service of these Saints - without Polyeleos, according to the general rule of two saints on 4 in the Afterfeast, although in the Pochaiv Anthologion the Service of St. Stephen is given with Polyeleos. One peculiarity of this day - at Matins, for St. Protomartyr (according to others also the Feast) has both Stichera of the Praises, and afterwards - Small Doxology, and Aposticha in its place. Finally our people even on this day abstain from work and take part in the divine service.

 1162: on weekdays

After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Heirmos and Sessional hymn of the Saints, Glory, Both now: Sessional hymn of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th - "More honorable", after the 9th - "Holy is the Lord our God" and Resurrectional Exapostilarion; Glory: of the Saints, Both now: of the Feast

 1205: ## 3.5 January
 1206: ### 3.5.1 January: Circumcision of the Lord and memory of St. Basil the Great
 1207: Note
 1208: In general typikons the divine service of this day is not given with All-Night Vigil, but only with Polyeleos. However, probably for the sake of the beginning of the civil year, or also for Basil the Great, for many years All-Night Vigil has been served with us, because it is already given in the Pochaiv Anthologion of 1777. We will present the rule first for weekdays, and then for Sunday.

 1320: ### 3.5.3 Eve of Theophany
 1321: Everything according to the rule of the Eve of the Nativity of Christ, here on p. 161-167.
 1322: Note: We adhere to the fast exactly as on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ, that is with dairy; but the simple people - without dairy, with one meal, as even the Lviv Synod allows (Title XII[^346], part 4, a. c.).
 1323: ### 3.5.4 January: Holy Theophany
 1324: Everything according to the rule of the feast of the Nativity of Christ, here on p. 168-175, with the exception of the Blessing of Water, which here takes place after Vespers or after the Prayer behind the Ambo, if Vespers be with the Service of Basil, and on the next day - after the Prayer behind the Ambo, as is given below.
 1325: 
 1326: RITE OF THE GREAT BLESSING OF WATER
 1327: 
 1328: #### 3.5.4.1 RULE
 1329: After the Prayer behind the Ambo, if Saturday or Sunday, then after the dismissal of Vespers, the church cross-bearer stands between two candle-bearers in the middle of the church, and before Him - a church server with three candlesticks, with a censer and with a vessel for incense. The Deacon takes the Holy Gospel from the table, the Priest takes the cross with his right hand and, having bowed low to the Holy Mysteries, they go out through the Holy Doors: first the Deacon with the Gospel, behind him - the Priest with the cross, vested in all sacred vestments of his rank, and the Choir sings the Troparion "The voice of the Lord"[^347]; all proceed to the narthex of the church. When all have gone out there, the Deacon places the Holy Gospel, and the Priest - the cross on a table covered with a tablecloth or a clean cloth, on which there will be also a wide vessel with water; and immediately the Priest censes the table from four sides and all present, according to the order.
 1330: After the end of the troparia follow three readings of prophecies; also the Apostle with its Prokeimenon and Alleluia, during the singing of which the deacons cense the water from four sides of the tetrapod, the Priest and all present, according to the order. Then the Priest reads the Gospel, before which the first Deacon exclaims: "Wisdom, attend" and the rest, and the second: "Let us attend".
 1331: After the singing of the Gospel the Deacon says the litany "In peace let us pray to the Lord", during which the Priest reads quietly the prayer "O Lord Jesus Christ"; and after the prayer He does not exclaim, but says to Himself: "Amen". And when "For the precipitous, pure" is said, the Priest begins loudly this prayer: "Great Art Thou, O Lord"[^348]. The prayer "O Trinity beyond all being", since it is given only in some editions, may be omitted; this is allowed by the Euchologion of Benedict, although our typikons do not allow this[^349].
 1332: In the prayer "Great Art Thou, O Lord" three members are exclaimed three times, namely the first member "Great Art Thou, O Lord", at which the Priest three times crosswise signs the water with three lit candles[^350]; the second "Thou Thyself, therefore", at which He blesses the water with His hand, immersing His fingers crosswise; the third "Thou Thyself and now", at which He breathes three times crosswise on the water. When He exclaims: "And save, O Lord, Thy servants, the Most Holy Ecumenical Primate (Name) the Pope of Rome[^351]  and our faithful Emperor (Name)" the Choir sings "Many Years".
 1333: At the end of this prayer the Choir: "Amen"; priest: "Peace be unto all" and, after the prayer at the bowing of heads, which he says quietly, he exclaims: "For Thou Art the sanctification" and immediately blesses with the cross: immerses it simply into the water, holding with both hands, and sings this troparion: "When in Jordan"[^352], and all the people sing with Him. "And the second time singing the same troparion"[^353], and all the people sing with Him. Then the server pours holy water onto a tray or into a sprinkler. The Priest turns his face to the west, holding the precious cross with his left hand, and with the right - the sprinkler, and sprinkles all the people with holy water. After this the choirs sing Glory, Both now: Stichera "Let us praise, O faithful", the procession returns to the church in the same way, and the Priest sprinkles on all sides[^354], and thus they enter the sanctuary through the Holy Doors: the Deacon with the Gospel, and after him the Priest with the cross. And when the Priest has sprinkled the entire sanctuary, the Deacon places the Gospel, and the Priest the cross on the Holy Table, in its place, and the Choir sings "Blessed be the name of the Lord", if there be Vespers with the Service of Basil; if Vespers - separate from the Holy Liturgy, then immediately the Great Dismissal of the Feast; at the end: Troparion, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the Feast, which both choirs sing together in the middle of the church, as at Vespers with the Service of Basil on 25 December.
 1334: Note: The Lviv Synod orders pastors to perform this blessing of water in their churches both on the Eve, and, more solemnly, on the very day of the Feast (Title IV, Chapter IV, part 2).

 1341: ### 3.5.5 January: Synaxis of Saint John the Forerunner
 1342: This Synaxis can fall either on weekdays, or on a Sunday. Its service has the appearance of a Saint on 6 without Polyeleos, but with the Great Doxology. Vespers will be with an Entrance, in view of the Great Prokeimenon of the Feast. Matins from the beginning to the canon - of small type, from the canon to the end - of great type. Here is the rule for both cases.

 1500: ### 3.5.17 JANUARY
 1501: Our Venerable Father Anthony the Great
 1502: ### 3.5.20 JANUARY
 1503: Our Venerable Father Euthymius the Great
 1504: ### 3.5.25 JANUARY
 1505: Our Holy Father Gregory the Theologian
 1506: ### 3.5.27 JANUARY
 1507: Translation of the relics of Saint John Chrysostom
 1508: Note
 1509: In January fall five saints, whose memory we honor with Polyeleos without All-Night Vigil, that is 11 January - Ven. Theodosius, 17 January - Anthony the Great, 20 January - Euthymius the Great, 25 January - Gregory the Theologian, 27 January - Translation of the relics of Chrysostom, and since the Triodion can begin within the limits of 35 days, from 11 January to 14 February, therefore these saints can fall either outside, or in the middle of the Triodion: in the middle of the Triodion, if the beginning of the Triodion falls on one of the days from 11 to 27 January; outside the Triodion, if the beginning of the Triodion falls on one of the days from 28 January to 14 February. And if they fall outside the Triodion, then their services are subject to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos; if they fall in the middle of the Triodion, they should have a separate rule, and since church books do not give it, we will give it.
 1510: 
 1511: VARIOUS CASES REGARDING THESE SAINTS
 1512: Of the above-mentioned five saints, St. Theodosius can fall only with one service of the Triodion, that is with the service of the Sunday of the Publican; and since in this case at the Liturgy it would be necessary to take three Apostles and three Gospels: of the ### 3.5.7 Sunday after Theophany, of the Sunday of the Publican and of the Saint, then, to avoid this, Slavic typikons transfer the service of the venerable one to another day.
 1513: St. Anthony can fall only with the service of the Sunday of the Publican, but is not transferred, for he does not coincide with the ### 3.5.7 Sunday after Theophany.
 1514: St. Euthymius can fall not only with the Sunday of the Publican, but also with the Sunday of the Prodigal [Son]. If the Sunday of the Publican falls on 13 January, then the Sunday of the Prodigal [Son] will be on 20 January, that is together with St. Euthymius.
 1515: St. Gregory and Chrysostom can fall not only with the Sunday of the Publican and of the Prodigal [Son], but also with the Meatfare, for when the Triodion begins on 18 or 20 January, then the Sunday of the Prodigal [Son] will be 25 or 27 January, and when the Triodion begins on 11 or 13 January, then 25 or 27 January will be Meatfare Sunday. These saints can fall also on the Saturday of Souls, that is Meatfare, which precedes Meatfare Sunday. If the Triodion begins on 12 or 14 January, then 25 or 27 falls on Meatfare Saturday. Chrysostom can fall also on Cheesefare Tuesday, which will be after Meatfare Sunday, for if 25 January falls on Meatfare Sunday, then 27 January will be Cheesefare Tuesday.
 1516: 
 1517: #### 3.5.27.1 RULE
 1518: If one of these saints falls outside the Triodion, one should adhere to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos. If he falls in the middle of the Triodion, as e. g. St. Theodosius can fall on the Sunday of the Publican, he must be transferred to another day. If one of the four other saints falls on the Sunday of the Publican, of the Prodigal [Son], Meatfare, on Meatfare Saturday or on Cheesefare Tuesday, then one must adhere to the rule of the Three Hierarchs, given in the Menaion on 30 January, which we will give immediately, with the exception of the All-Night Vigil, which will not be here, but there will be it at Great Vespers, at the end. Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint. At Compline, after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Saint, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the Triodion[^361].
 1519: ### 3.5.10 January: The Three Hierarchs
 1520: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian and John Chrysostom,
 1521: and the Holy Hieromartyr Hippolytus
 1522: Note
 1523: The Service of the Hieromartyr is sung on another day at Compline; the service of the Hierarchs is sung on this day, according to the general rule of a Saint with All-Night Vigil; it departs from the general rule of a Saint with All-Night Vigil only in that at Matins, instead of "More honorable", it has separate refrains, as on feasts of the Theotokos. However, if their service falls within the limits of the Triodion, then it is combined with the service of the Triodion, and therefore has separate rules.

 1579: III. THREE HIERARCHS
 1580: ON CHEESEFARE MONDAY, TUESDAY OR THURSDAY
 1581: Note
 1582: Our and Russian church rules do not give for this case All-Night Vigil, and consequently neither Small Vespers, but only one Great, without blessing of loaves; afterwards also Compline, at which after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Saints. All this according to the rule of the Forerunner on 24 February[^365]. However, since with us even in this case All-Night Vigil is served, although there is no rule for it, we will give the rule of the All-Night Vigil also for this case, similarly to the rule of the Meeting on 2 February, if it falls on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday of Cheesefare week.

 1586: AT Great Vespers, AT MATINS,
 1587: 
 1588: AT THE HOURS AND AT THE LITURGY
 1589: Everything, as outside the Triodion, only at Matins, at the Praises there will be Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Triodion.
 1590: Note
 1591: If the Three Hierarchs fall on one of the days of Cheesefare week, then the three-ode canon of Matins we sing at Compline, namely: if the Feast is on Monday, then at Compline on Sunday; if on Tuesday, then on Wednesday; if on Wednesday, then on Thursday; if on Thursday, then on Tuesday; if on Friday, then on Wednesday. Thus give our and Russian typikons for the Feast of the Meeting on these days. Only, if the Feast falls on Monday, let the three-ode canon be sung on Tuesday, for when there is All-Night Vigil - Compline does not happen.

 1600: ## 3.6 February
 1601: Meeting of the Lord
 1602: Note
 1603: This feast falls on 2 February and therefore can fall either in the middle, or outside the Triodion. And since the first boundary of the Triodion is 11 January, and the last - 14 February, therefore it can fall at most 22 days from the beginning of the Triodion and 12 days before the beginning of the Triodion. When there is the earliest boundary of the Triodion, that is 11 January, then the feast reaches Monday of the first week of Lent, the next - immediately after the fourth Sunday of the Triodion, that is after Cheesefare Sunday. And if it falls outside the Triodion, then its order is celebrated according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, although partly it is of the Lord. It differs from a feast of the Theotokos only by a separate dismissal and at the Liturgy - by a separate entrance verse, and on the Apodosis there will not be the Apostle-Gospel of the Feast and of the day, as for the Theotokos, but only of the day, as for the Lord. And if it falls on a Sunday, its service is combined with the Resurrectional, according to the rule of a feast of the Theotokos. It has one day of Forefeast and seven days of Afterfeast, for it is given up on 9 February.
 1604: If it falls in the middle of the Triodion and coincides in this way with the services of the Triodion, then it has a separate rule for the Forefeast, for the Feast and for the Afterfeast, as we present.

 1658: II. FOREFEAST OF THE MEETING ON MEATFARE SATURDAY
 1659: When the Forefeast of the Meeting falls on Meatfare Saturday, then the service of the Forefeast we sing on the previous Friday with Saints Cyrus, John and Tryphon[^367], according to the general rule of two saints on 4 in the Forefeast, only at "Lord, I have cried" there will be stichera: of the Forefeast - 3 and to the Holy Unmercenaries - 3, and the stichera of Tryphon are taken in the morning at the Praises on 4; Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast[^368]. After them, at the Aposticha, - stichera of the Forefeast with their refrains. On Meatfare Saturday we sing the general order for the deceased.
 1660: 
 1661: III. FOREFEAST OF THE MEETING
 1662: ON CHEESEFARE MONDAY, TUESDAY AND THURSDAY
 1663: Everything according to the general rule of a Saint on 4 in the Forefeast, only at the Aposticha of Vespers, and also at Matins, there will not be stichera of the Forefeast, but idiomesa of the Triodion of the day twice and to the Martyr with general refrains; also Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast. And at Matins, after the 2nd Kathisma there will not be the Sessional hymn of the Forefeast, but of the Triodion. The canon, where the three-ode canon comes, will be of the Forefeast with heirmos on 4, three troparia of the Saint on 2 and of the Triodion on 8[^369]; katavasia at the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th - heirmos of the canon of the Saint. Generally, in those odes where the three-ode canon comes, there will be the Katavasia of the Triodion.

 1709: [367] Similarly also in the new Constantinopolitan Typikon the Forefeast is transferred back, to Friday; and in the new Greek-Venetian Menaion the service for the deceased is transferred to the Saturday of the Prodigal [Son].

 1711: [369] Rules of menaia ours and Russian; however, the Typikon of the Lviv University prescribes to the saint only two troparia.
 1712: [370] According to Tserkovne Oko "Blessed is the man" is sung; our handwritten typikon allows to sing either "Blessed is the man", or the sequential kathisma; the Greek Triodion prescribes the sequential kathisma, similarly also the Typikon of the Lviv University.
 1713: [371] Rules of menaia ours and Russian give an entrance, however, this does not correspond to the rule of the Triodion of Cheesefare Saturday, in which an entrance is not given, nor is it prescribed to sing "Blessed is the man". Rather one could assume an entrance if "Blessed is the man" is taken; however, even "Blessed is the man" by no means corresponds to a saint who does not have Polyeleos.

 1864: APODOSIS OF THE FEAST OF THE MEETING
 1865: Note
 1866: This Apodosis can fall either in the middle, or outside the Triodion. In the middle of the Triodion, if the Triodion falls on one of 30 days from 11 January to 9 February inclusive; outside the Triodion, if it falls on other five days, from 10 to 14 February. And if it falls outside the Triodion, then the Apodosis will be 9 February, according to the general rule of the Apodosis of a feast of the Theotokos; And in this case the Afterfeast has 7 days inclusive with the Apodosis. But if it falls in the middle of the Triodion, then the number of days of the Afterfeast from 7 can be reduced to 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0, and the reason for this - various services of the Triodion, with which it coincides. However, this reduction does not always take place in the middle of the Triodion, but only when the Apodosis of the Feast coincides with certain services of the Triodion, which are incompatible with the service of the Feast. Such are: Meatfare Saturday (of Souls), Meatfare Sunday, which is of the Last Judgment, Cheesefare Wednesday and Friday, which have a completely Lenten rule, and Monday of the 1st week of Lent, on which the day of 9 February can fall, and partially also Cheesefare Sunday. Generally one can establish such a rule: if Pascha falls on days from 8 April and earlier, and the Triodion - from 28 January and earlier, then the Apodosis of the Meeting will be 9 February, that is on the seventh day after the Feast. When in a given year the Apodosis of the Feast will be at its proper time, and earlier, when there will be no Apodosis at all, the following table, compiled according to the rules of Slavic menaia, will show.

 1940: ### 3.6.4 February: First and Second Finding of the Precious Head of the Forerunner
 1941: Notes
 1942: 
 1943: ##### 3.6.4.1 Since the last boundary of the Triodion is 14 February, this feast always falls in the middle of the Triodion. If the Triodion is earlier, then this feast enters all the deeper into the Triodion and coincides with many Triodion services. Even more, this feast can coincide with other services, given in the Triodion from Wednesday of Meatfare Week to Tuesday of the 8th week of the Triodion, that is of the 4th of Great Lent, inclusive. The last boundary of the beginning of the Triodion is 14 February, and after subtracting from 14 February 13 days, which precede the beginning of the Triodion, 11 will remain, dividing which by 7, we will get in the quotient 1, with 4 in the remainder, that is one whole week and one not whole - the first four days; and since the first day of the first week is Sunday (for the Triodion begins on Sunday), then the first day of the second week will be Sunday, the second - Monday, the third - Tuesday, the fourth - Wednesday. And since the first Sunday of the Triodion is the Sunday of the Publican, the second - of the Prodigal [Son], the third - Meatfare, then the Wednesday on which the Finding falls will be Meatfare Wednesday (for in the Lenten Triodion the days of the week are named after the following Sunday), as the earliest boundary of this feast in relation to the Triodion. And that the last boundary of this feast in relation to the Triodion is Tuesday of the 4th week of Great Lent is proven thus. The first boundary of the Triodion is 11 January, from which to 24 February will be 45 days, dividing which by 7, we will get 6 whole weeks with a remainder of 3; but, since the first day of this remainder is Sunday, as is the first day of each of the 6 past weeks, it will be the 7th Sunday of the Triodion, and the second day will be Monday, the third - Tuesday of the 8th week of the Triodion, of the 4th of Great Lent

 2051: 1.	"Blessed is the man" (according to the rule - 1st antiphon).
 2052: 
 2053: ##### 3.6.4.4.15 At "Lord, I have cried" - 6 stichera: 3 to the Forerunner and 3 to the Fathers, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone that is being given up
 2054: 
 2055: ##### 3.6.4.4.16 After the Entrance: Prokeimenon of the day and Paremia of the Triodion, Prokeimenon of the Triodion and 3 readings to the Forerunner; and immediately after the readings the Priest having taken off the phelonion and having closed the Holy Doors: "Vouchsafe, O Lord"
 2056: 
 2057: ##### 3.6.4.4.17 Aposticha of the Triodion and one stichera to the Forerunner with his refrain; Glory: to the Fathers, Both now: their Theotokion
 2058: 
 2059: ##### 3.6.4.4.18 Troparion to the Forerunner, Glory: to the Fathers, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 2060: 
 2061: ##### 3.6.4.4.19 Litany "Have mercy on us, O God" and three great prostrations
 2062: 7.	"O All-Holy Trinity", "Blessed be the name of the Lord", "Blessed be the Lord", "It is truly meet" and dismissal (from "Glory to Thee, O Christ God").
 2063: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion to the Forerunner, Glory, and now: to the Fathers.
 2064: 
 2065: AT MATINS
 2066: 
 2067: ##### 3.6.4.4.20 At "God is the Lord": Troparion to the Forerunner twice, Glory: to the Fathers, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Fathers
 2068: 
 2069: ##### 3.6.4.4.21 After two sequential kathismata - Sessional hymns of the Fathers, and also Polyeleos with "Great Doxology" and everything else up to the canon - only to the Forerunner, that is all three sessional hymns, Gradual, Prokeimenon, Gospel and Stichera
 2070: 
 2071: ##### 3.6.4.4.22 Canons 2 making 14: of the Forerunner on 6 and of the Fathers on 8. Katavasia of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Forerunner, Glory: of the Fathers, Both now: their Theotokion; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Fathers; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Forerunner, Glory: of the Fathers, Both now: their Theotokion
 2072: 
 2073: ##### 3.6.4.4.23 Stichera of the Praises - 6: 3 to the Forerunner and 3 to the Fathers, Glory: to the Fathers, Both now: their Theotokion
 2074: 
 2075: ##### 3.6.4.4.24 Great Doxology, Troparion to the Forerunner, Glory: to the Fathers, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Fathers
 2076: 
 2077: #### 3.6.4.5 AT THE HOURS
 2078: On all: Troparion to the Forerunner, Glory: to the Fathers. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - to the Forerunner; on the 3rd and 9th - to the Fathers.
 2079: 
 2080: #### 3.6.4.6 AT THE LITURGY
 2081: First everything - to the Forerunner, and then - to the Fathers. Apostle and Gospel sequential of the day we read under the Prokeimenon (zaspiv).
 2082: 
 2083: ##### 3.6.4.6.1 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2084: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE 1ST WEEK OF LENT
 2085: If it falls on Monday, then his service is transferred to Cheesefare Sunday, and if - on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, then it is transferred either to Cheesefare Sunday, or to Saturday of the 1st week of Lent[^382].
 2086: 
 2087: ##### 3.6.4.6.2 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2088: ON SATURDAY OF THE 1ST WEEK OF LENT
 2089: 
 2090: AT VESPERS
 2091: 
 2092: ##### 3.6.4.6.3 Kathisma sequential
 2093: 
 2094: ##### 3.6.4.6.4 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 of the Triodion, 3 to the Forerunner and 4 to Theodore, Glory: to Theodore, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone that is being given up
 2095: 
 2096: ##### 3.6.4.6.5 After the Entrance: Prokeimenon of the Triodion, one reading of the Triodion and 2nd Prokeimenon of the Triodion, and then "The Light of Christ" with a candlestick and the second reading of the Triodion, and also 3 readings to the Forerunner and "Let my prayer be set forth" and everything else of the Presanctified[^383]
 2097: If there are no Presanctified [Gifts], then everything is celebrated according to the rule of Cheesefare Saturday, here on p. 230-232[^384].
 2098: 
 2099: #### 3.6.4.7 AT COMPLINE
 2100: 
 2101: ##### 3.6.4.7.1 Canons for the deceased of the Octoechos and sequential of the Menaion
 2102: 
 2103: ##### 3.6.4.7.2 If Small Compline is celebrated, as Greek typikons give, then after "It is truly meet" will be Kontakion to the Forerunner and Theodore. If - Great, as Slavic Triodia have, then after the 1st Trisagion we say the Troparion of both saints, after the 2nd - usual troparia "Have mercy on us, O Lord", and at the last Trisagion - Kontakion to the Forerunner[^385]
 2104: AT MATINS, AT THE HOURS AND AT THE LITURGY
 2105: Everything according to the rule of Cheesefare Saturday, here on p. 231-232, only:
 2106: 
 2107: ##### 3.6.4.7.3 At Matins both first sessional hymns will be Theodore's
 2108: 
 2109: ##### 3.6.4.7.4 At the Liturgy: Prokeimenon and Alleluia will be only to both saints together[^386]
 2110: 
 2111: ##### 3.6.4.7.5 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2112: 
 2113: ON THE FIRST SUNDAY OF LENT
 2114: #### 3.6.4.8 AT Great Vespers
 2115: 
 2116: ##### 3.6.4.8.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 Resurrectional, 4 of the Triodion and 3 to the Forerunner, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone
 2117: 
 2118: ##### 3.6.4.8.2 Prokeimenon of the day and 3 readings to the Forerunner
 2119: 
 2120: ##### 3.6.4.8.3 Aposticha Resurrectional, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: of the Triodion
 2121: 
 2122: ##### 3.6.4.8.4 At the end: Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: "To Thine immaculate Image"
 2123: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion to the Forerunner, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Triodion.
 2124: #### 3.6.4.9 AT Great Matins
 2125: 
 2126: ##### 3.6.4.9.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: "To Thine immaculate"[^387]
 2127: 
 2128: ##### 3.6.4.9.2 Everything else up to the canon - according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos on Sunday, only after Ps. 50 - "Open to me the doors"
 2129: 
 2130: ##### 3.6.4.9.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, Forerunner on 4 and Triodion on 6. Katavasia of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn to the Forerunner, Glory: Both now: of the Triodion; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Triodion; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: of the Triodion
 2131: 
 2132: ##### 3.6.4.9.4 Stichera of the Praises on 9: 4 Resurrectional, 3 of the Triodion on 4 with their two refrains, and also idiomelon stichera of the Triodion with the refrain "Arise", Glory: the same, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2133: 
 2134: ##### 3.6.4.9.5 After the Great Doxology - Resurrectional Troparion, one of the two usual ones
 2135: 
 2136: ##### 3.6.4.9.6 After the Dismissal - Glory, and now: Gospel Stichera
 2137: 
 2138: #### 3.6.4.10 AT THE HOURS
 2139: On all: Resurrectional Troparion, also Glory: on the 1st and 6th - "To the Image", on the 3rd and 9th - to the Forerunner. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - "To the Image", on the 3rd and 9th - to the Forerunner.
 2140: 
 2141: #### 3.6.4.11 AT THE LITURGY
 2142: 
 2143: ##### 3.6.4.11.1 Resurrectional Troparion, "To the Image" and to the Forerunner, Glory: Kontakion to the Forerunner, Both now: Kontakion "To the Image"
 2144: 
 2145: ##### 3.6.4.11.2 Everything else - of the Sunday, afterwards - to the Forerunner
 2146: 
 2147: ##### 3.6.4.11.3 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2148: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE 2ND AND 3RD WEEKS OF LENT
 2149: Note: This Vespers has three cases: it is celebrated differently on Sunday evening, if the Finding falls on Monday, differently - on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening, if the Finding falls on Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday; differently - on Wednesday evening, if the Finding falls on Thursday. We will give the rule for all three cases.
 2150: ON SUNDAY EVENING,
 2151: 
 2152: IF THE FEAST FALLS ON MONDAY
 2153: 1.	"Blessed is the man" (according to the rule - 1st antiphon).
 2154: 
 2155: ##### 3.6.4.11.4 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 4 of the Triodion and 6 to the Forerunner, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: 1st Theotokion according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 2156: 
 2157: ##### 3.6.4.11.5 Entrance, Great Prokeimenon of the Triodion, 3 readings to the Forerunner and immediately "Vouchsafe, O Lord"
 2158: 
 2159: ##### 3.6.4.11.6 Aposticha of the Triodion, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday Aposticha according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 2160: 
 2161: ##### 3.6.4.11.7 After "Now lettest Thou" - Troparion to the Forerunner, Glory, and now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the troparion
 2162: 
 2163: ##### 3.6.4.11.8 Litany "Have mercy on us, O God", three great prostrations without prayer and Great Dismissal
 2164: ON MONDAY, TUESDAY AND THURSDAY EVENING,
 2165: 
 2166: IF THE FEAST FALLS
 2167: ON TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY AND FRIDAY
 2168: Everything according to the above-given rule on Sunday evening, only: 1. Instead of "Blessed is the man" there will be the sequential Kathisma.
 2169: 
 2170: ##### 3.6.4.11.9 At "Lord, I have cried" there will be only 6 stichera: 3 of the Triodion and 3 to the Forerunner, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: 1st Theotokion according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 2171: 
 2172: ##### 3.6.4.11.10 After the Entrance with "O Gladsome Light" there will be two Paremias of the Triodion, each with its Prokeimenon, and also 3 readings to the Forerunner
 2173: 
 2174: ##### 3.6.4.11.11 After the three prostrations, which are after the litany "Have mercy on us, O God", there will be the conclusion of "The Typika" (Typika), that is "O All-Holy Trinity", "Blessed be the name of the Lord", "Blessed be the Lord", "It is truly meet" and Dismissal
 2175: ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, IF THE FEAST FALLS ON THURSDAY
 2176: 
 2177: ##### 3.6.4.11.12 At "Lord, I have cried" there will be 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 to the Forerunner, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: 1st Theotokion according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 2178: 
 2179: ##### 3.6.4.11.13 Immediately after the readings to the Forerunner - "Let my prayer be set forth" and according to the order Liturgy of the Presanctified. If the Finding falls on Wednesday, then after "Let my prayer be set forth" there will be also Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Apostle-Gospel of the Forerunner, Communion Hymn "O taste" ("Vkusite") and of the Forerunner. If the Finding falls on Thursday, then on Wednesday evening there will be no Apostle-Gospel of the Forerunner, but it will be in the morning on Thursday
 2180: 
 2181: #### 3.6.4.12 AT COMPLINE
 2182: 
 2183: ##### 3.6.4.12.1 On Sunday - Small Compline, after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion to the Forerunner
 2184: 
 2185: ##### 3.6.4.12.2 On other days - Great Compline. After the 1st Trisagion - Troparion to the Forerunner, Glory, and now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the troparion; after the 2nd Trisagion - usual troparia "Have mercy on us, O Lord"; after "It is truly meet", instead of "O Lord of hosts, be with us", - Kontakion to the Forerunner; after "More honorable" - three great prostrations. We do not take the Trisagion. Small Dismissal, as at Small Compline
 2186: 
 2187: AT MATINS
 2188: Everything according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos, only:
 2189: 1.	1st and 2nd Sessional hymns will be of the Triodion, without litanies.
 2190: 
 2191: ##### 3.6.4.12.3 The Canon will be only one, namely of the Forerunner on 8. Katavasia "I shall open". And where there is a three-ode canon, there will be the Canon of the Forerunner on 6 and both canons of the three-ode canon on 8; Katavasia of the Triodion
 2192: 
 2193: ##### 3.6.4.12.4 After the stichera of the Praises there will be the Small Doxology, after which - Aposticha of the Triodion in its place, with the Doxastikon of the Forerunner; after the Troparion of the Forerunner - Glory, and now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the troparion and after the litany "Have mercy on us, O God" - three great prostrations without dismissal
 2194: 
 2195: #### 3.6.4.13 AT THE HOURS
 2196: Everything - according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos, as also outside the Fast, only after the Kontakion of the Forerunner we make three great prostrations (without prayer); at the 3rd, 6th and 9th Hour we read the Kathisma; at the 6th we read also the Paremia.
 2197: 
 2198: AT THE TYPIKA
 2199: Kontakion of the Temple, Glory: Kontakion to the Forerunner, Both now: "O protection"; if the temple is of the Theotokos, then after the Kontakion to the Forerunner - Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Temple. After "More honorable" - three great prostrations, and also "O All-Holy Trinity" and dismissal.
 2200: 
 2201: ##### 3.6.4.13.1 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2202: ON SATURDAYS OF THE 2ND AND 3RD WEEKS OF LENT
 2203: Everything according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos on Saturday, only on Friday evening there will be the sequential Kathisma and at "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 to the Forerunner, and before the readings to the Forerunner there will be two Paremias of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and with "The Light of Christ", and also "Let my prayer be set forth" and according to the order the Service of the Presanctified.
 2204: 
 2205: ##### 3.6.4.13.2 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2206: 
 2207: ON THE SECOND SUNDAY OF LENT
 2208: Everything according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos on Sunday, only:
 2209: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion to the Forerunner, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Triodion.
 2210: 
 2211: AT MATINS
 2212: 
 2213: ##### 3.6.4.13.3 Before the canon we sing "Open to me [the doors]"
 2214: 
 2215: ##### 3.6.4.13.4 Canons 4 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Triodion on 4 and of the Forerunner on 6. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Triodion and Kontakion-Ikos of the Forerunner; after the 6th - Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: Theotokion of the Resurrectional Exapostilarion
 2216: 
 2217: ##### 3.6.4.13.5 At the Praises, after 8 Resurrectional stichera and of the Forerunner, there will be also one of the Triodion with the refrain "Arise, O Lord" and the same with the refrain "Glory", and Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2218: 
 2219: ##### 3.6.4.13.6 After the Dismissal - Glory, and now: Gospel Stichera
 2220: 
 2221: #### 3.6.4.14 AT THE HOURS
 2222: On all: Resurrectional Troparion and Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Triodion, on the 3rd and 9th - to the Forerunner. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Triodion, on the 3rd and 9th - to the Forerunner.
 2223: 
 2224: #### 3.6.4.15 AT THE LITURGY
 2225: 
 2226: ##### 3.6.4.15.1 Resurrectional Troparion and to the Forerunner, Glory: Kontakion to the Forerunner, Both now: of the Triodion
 2227: 
 2228: ##### 3.6.4.15.2 Everything else - first of the Sunday, and then - of the Forerunner
 2229: 
 2230: ##### 3.6.4.15.3 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD ON THE THIRD SUNDAY OF LENT
 2231: Everything according to the rule of the first Sunday of Lent, here on p. 233-235. 
 2232: 
 2233: ## 3.7 March
 2234: ### 3.7.1 March: Holy 40 Martyrs
 2235: Note
 2236: The service of this feast is with Polyeleos, and in its relation to the Triodion it can fall from the first Tuesday to Monday of the 6th week of Great Lent, which can be proven by the method of calculation given for the determination of the feast of the Finding of the Precious Head of the Forerunner, here on p. 226. And it has ten following cases.
 2237: 
 2238: ##### 3.7.1.1 On one of the fast days of the 1st week of Lent
 2239: 
 2240: ##### 3.7.1.2 On Saturday of the 1st week of Lent
 2241: 
 2242: ##### 3.7.1.3 On the 1st Sunday of Lent
 2243: 
 2244: ##### 3.7.1.4 On one of the fast days of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th weeks of Lent
 2245: 
 2246: ##### 3.7.1.5 On the 2nd Sunday of Lent
 2247: 
 2248: ##### 3.7.1.6 On the 3rd Sunday of Lent
 2249: 
 2250: ##### 3.7.1.7 On the 4th and 5th Sundays of Lent
 2251: 
 2252: ##### 3.7.1.8 On Wednesday of the 4th week of Lent
 2253: 
 2254: ##### 3.7.1.9 On Thursday of the Great Canon
 2255: 
 2256: ##### 3.7.1.10 On the Akathist Saturday (5th of Lent)
 2257: RULES FOR THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES
 2258: 1. 40 MARTYRS ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE 1ST WEEK OF LENT
 2259: Everything - according to the rule of the Finding of the Precious Head, here on p. 232.
 2260: 2. 40 MARTYRS ON SATURDAY OF THE 1ST WEEK OF LENT
 2261: According to the rule of the Finding, here on p. 232-233.
 2262: 3. 40 MARTYRS ON THE FIRST SUNDAY OF LENT
 2263: According to the rule, here on p. 233-235.
 2264: 4. 40 MARTYRS ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE 2ND, 3RD, 4TH, 5TH AND 6TH WEEKS OF LENT
 2265: According to the rule given in their text, which you have also here on p. 235-238, about the Finding of the Precious Head.
 2266: 5. 40 MARTYRS ON THE SECOND SUNDAY OF LENT
 2267: According to the rule of the Finding, here on p. 238-239.
 2268: 6. 40 MARTYRS ON THE THIRD SUNDAY OF LENT
 2269: According to the rule of the Finding, here on p. 239.
 2270: 7. 40 MARTYRS ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 2271: According to the rule of the 2nd Sunday, here on p. 238-239.
 2272: 8. 40 MARTYRS ON THE FOURTH WEDNESDAY OF LENT
 2273: Their service is transferred to the previous Tuesday.
 2274: The rule - in the text. However, since with us on this day the Presanctified does not happen, then at "Lord, I have cried" the stichera of the Cross on 6 are taken. The feast of the Holy Martyrs is given up at the Hours[^390]. At the Aposticha - idiomelon and Martyricon of the Triodion.
 2275: 9. 40 MARTYRS ON THURSDAY OF THE GREAT CANON
 2276: Their service is transferred to the previous Tuesday, according to the rule of the 8th case.
 2277: 10. 40 MARTYRS ON THE AKATHIST SATURDAY
 2278: Their service we sing in the morning, that is on the 5th Sunday of Lent, according to the rule of the Finding on the 2nd Sunday, here on p. 238-239[^391]. 
 2279: ### 3.7.2 March: Forefeast of the Annunciation
 2280: Has 10 following cases:
 2281: 
 2282: ##### 3.7.2.1 On one of the fast days of the Forty Days
 2283: 
 2284: ##### 3.7.2.2 On Saturday of the 3rd and 4th weeks of Lent
 2285: 
 2286: ##### 3.7.2.3 On the Sunday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2287: 
 2288: ##### 3.7.2.4 On Wednesday and Friday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2289: 
 2290: ##### 3.7.2.5 On Thursday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2291: 
 2292: ##### 3.7.2.6 On the 4th and 5th Sundays of Lent
 2293: 
 2294: ##### 3.7.2.7 On Tuesday of the 5th week of Lent
 2295: 
 2296: ##### 3.7.2.8 On Thursday of the 5th week of Lent, that is of the Great Canon
 2297: 
 2298: ##### 3.7.2.9 On the Akathist Saturday, 5th of Lent
 2299: 
 2300: ##### 3.7.2.10 On Lazarus Saturday
 2301: RULES FOR THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES 
 2302: 
 2303: ##### 3.7.2.11 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2304: 
 2305: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE FORTY DAYS
 2306: 
 2307: AT VESPERS
 2308: Vespers will be different on Sunday evening, and different - on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and different - on Wednesday evening.
 2309: a) On Sunday evening, when the Forefeast is on Monday
 2310: Everything - according to the general rule of other Sundays of Holy Lent, with the Great Prokeimenon, only:
 2311: 
 2312: ##### 3.7.2.12 At "Lord, I have cried", after 6 stichera, which are in the Triodion, there will be 4 - of the Forefeast; Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2313: 
 2314: ##### 3.7.2.13 At the Aposticha, after the stichera of the Triodion, - Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2315: b) On Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening, when the Forefeast is on Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday
 2316: Everything - according to the general rule of these fast days, only: At "Lord, I have cried" - 6 stichera: 3 prosomia of the Triodion and 3 of the Forefeast; Glory, Both now: to the Forefeast; likewise also at the Aposticha, after the stichera of the Triodion - Glory, Both now: to the Forefeast.
 2317: Note: On the Forefeast the typikon prescribes the Service of the Presanctified, as also on Saints with Polyeleos; however, with us the Service of the Presanctified is sung only on Wednesday and Friday, and on other days - of Chrysostom. When the Service of the Presanctified was supposed to be according to the typikon, but is not celebrated, then 3 stichera, which are at the Aposticha, should be transferred to "Lord, I have cried", and after them sing both 3 prosomia stichera of the Triodion, and 3 of the Forefeast. On Wednesday evening the stichera from the Aposticha do not need to be transferred to "Lord, I have cried", for they are already given in the Triodion at "Lord, I have cried".
 2318: c) On Wednesday evening, when the Forefeast is on Thursday
 2319: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule of this day, only: At "Lord, I have cried", after 6 stichera, which will be in the Triodion, also 3 of the Forefeast on 4; Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast.
 2320: AT COMPLINE: Everything - according to the Lenten rule.
 2321: 
 2322: AT MATINS
 2323: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule, only:
 2324: 
 2325: ##### 3.7.2.14 Canon of the Forefeast on 6 and of the Triodion on 8. After the 3rd ode - Sessional hymn of the Forefeast, and after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast
 2326: 
 2327: ##### 3.7.2.15 At the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2328: AT THE HOURS: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule.
 2329: 
 2330: ##### 3.7.2.16 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2331: ON SATURDAYS OF THE 3RD AND 4TH WEEKS OF LENT
 2332: 
 2333: AT VESPERS
 2334: Everything - according to the Lenten rule of Friday for Saturday, only: At "Lord, I have cried", after 6 stichera of the Triodion there will be also 4 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone.
 2335: 
 2336: #### 3.7.2.1 AT COMPLINE
 2337: If Small is sung, then after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Forefeast, and if Great will be (which only Slavic Triodia have), then after the 1st Trisagion - Troparion of the Forefeast, after the 2nd - usual troparia "Have mercy on us, O Lord". Canon of the Octoechos for the deceased; after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Forefeast.
 2338: 
 2339: AT MATINS
 2340: 
 2341: ##### 3.7.2.1.1 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Forefeast twice, Glory, and now: the same
 2342: 
 2343: ##### 3.7.2.1.2 Kathismata and Sessional hymns usual of the Octoechos
 2344: 
 2345: ##### 3.7.2.1.3 Canon of the Forefeast on 6[^394]. After the 3rd ode - Katavasia of the Forefeast and Sessional hymn of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast, after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Forefeast. When there is a four-ode canon, that is the 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th odes, then - of the Forefeast on 6 and of the Triodion on 8, Katavasia of the Triodion
 2346: 
 2347: ##### 3.7.2.1.4 Aposticha of the Octoechos, as on all Saturdays, only Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2348: 
 2349: ##### 3.7.2.1.5 Troparion of the Forefeast one and after the litany - dismissal, as usual
 2350: AT THE HOURS: On all: Troparion and Kontakion - of the Forefeast.
 2351: AT THE LITURGY: Troparion, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Forefeast. Everything else - only of the day without the deceased.
 2352: 
 2353: ##### 3.7.2.1.6 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2354: 
 2355: ON THE SUNDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2356: #### 3.7.2.2 AT Great Vespers
 2357: 
 2358: ##### 3.7.2.2.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 Resurrectional, 4 of the Cross and 3 of the Forefeast, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone
 2359: 
 2360: ##### 3.7.2.2.2 Aposticha Resurrectional; Glory: Both now: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2361: 
 2362: ##### 3.7.2.2.3 Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2363: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast.
 2364: #### 3.7.2.3 AT Great Matins
 2365: 
 2366: ##### 3.7.2.3.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2367: 
 2368: ##### 3.7.2.3.2 Everything else up to the canon - Resurrectional, as outside the Forefeast
 2369: 
 2370: ##### 3.7.2.3.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Cross on 6 and of the Forefeast on 4. Katavasia of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Forefeast, and also Sessional hymn of the Cross; Glory, and now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Cross; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2371: 
 2372: ##### 3.7.2.3.4 Everything else to the end - according to the rule of the Sunday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2373: 
 2374: #### 3.7.2.4 AT THE HOURS
 2375: On all: Resurrectional Troparion, and also Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross, and on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross; on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast.
 2376: 
 2377: #### 3.7.2.5 AT THE LITURGY
 2378: 
 2379: ##### 3.7.2.5.1 Resurrectional Troparion, of the Cross and of the Forefeast; Glory: Kontakion of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2380: 
 2381: ##### 3.7.2.5.2 Everything else - only of the Sunday
 2382: 
 2383: ##### 3.7.2.5.3 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2384: 
 2385: ON WEDNESDAY AND FRIDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2386: Everything - according to the Lenten rule of these days, only:
 2387: 
 2388: AT VESPERS
 2389: 
 2390: ##### 3.7.2.5.4 At "Lord, I have cried" - 6 stichera: 3 of the Cross and 3 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2391: 
 2392: ##### 3.7.2.5.5 Likewise also at the Aposticha of Vespers and Matins after the stichera of the Triodion there will be Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2393: AT Great Compline: Everything - according to the Lenten rule.
 2394: 
 2395: AT MATINS
 2396: 
 2397: ##### 3.7.2.5.6 Canon of the Triodion on 6 and of the Forefeast on 4, and where there is a three-ode canon, there the Canon of the Cross on 4, of the Forefeast on 2 and the three-ode canon on 8
 2398: Katavasia after the 3rd, 8th and 9th[^395]  - heirmos of the three-ode canon, and after the 6th - heirmos of the Forefeast, because it is - the last canon. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Forefeast and Sessional hymn of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Cross; after the 9th - Lenten Triadikon Exapostilarion of the tone; and also of the Cross with its Cross-Theotokion[^396].
 2399: 
 2400: ##### 3.7.2.5.7 At the Praises - 4 stichera of the Cross, which are taken at "Lord, I have cried", which were left, that is 3 last on 4; Glory, and now: again must be taken from "Lord, I have cried"[^397]
 2401: 
 2402: ##### 3.7.2.5.8 At the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2403: 
 2404: ##### 3.7.2.5.9 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2405: 
 2406: ON THURSDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2407: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule, only:
 2408: AT VESPERS: At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast.
 2409: 
 2410: ##### 3.7.2.5.10 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2411: 
 2412: ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 2413: #### 3.7.2.6 AT Great Vespers
 2414: At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Octoechos and 4 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone.
 2415: AT COMPLINE: Kontakion of the Triodion, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Forefeast.
 2416: #### 3.7.2.7 AT Great Matins
 2417: 
 2418: ##### 3.7.2.7.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2419: 
 2420: ##### 3.7.2.7.2 Other things up to the canon - Resurrectional, as without the Forefeast
 2421: 
 2422: ##### 3.7.2.7.3 Canons 4 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, Theotokos of the Octoechos on 2, Triodion on 4 and Forefeast on 4. Katavasia sequential. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Forefeast and Sessional hymn of the Triodion; Glory, and now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2423: 
 2424: ##### 3.7.2.7.4 Everything else - Resurrectional and of the Triodion, as usual
 2425: AT THE HOURS: On all - Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Forefeast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Triodion, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast.
 2426: AT THE LITURGY: Resurrectional Troparion and of the Forefeast; Glory: Kontakion of the Triodion, Both now: of the Forefeast. Everything else - of the Sunday.
 2427: 
 2428: ##### 3.7.2.7.5 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2429: ON TUESDAY OF THE 5TH WEEK OF LENT
 2430: The Forefeast is transferred to Monday, because on Tuesday the Great Canon is sung, for then on Wednesday will be the Feast of the Annunciation, and on Thursday - the Apodosis, the festal service of which - is incompatible with the penitential Great Canon.
 2431: 
 2432: ##### 3.7.2.7.6 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2433: 
 2434: ON THURSDAY OF THE GREAT CANON
 2435: Then the service of the Forefeast must be transferred to the previous Wednesday[^398]; on Thursday there will be the service of the Great Canon, and on Friday - the Feast.
 2436: 
 2437: ##### 3.7.2.7.7 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2438: 
 2439: ON THE AKATHIST SATURDAY
 2440: Everything according to the rule of the Triodion of this Saturday, however:
 2441: AT VESPERS: At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 7 of the Triodion and 3 of the Forefeast, Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: of the Akathist.
 2442: AT COMPLINE: Morning four-ode canon of the Triodion. After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Akathist, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Forefeast.
 2443: 
 2444: AT MATINS
 2445: 
 2446: ##### 3.7.2.7.8 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Akathist twice, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2447: (After both kathismata - three kontakia-ikoi of the Akathist).
 2448: 
 2449: ##### 3.7.2.7.9 Canons 2 making 14: of the Forefeast on 6 and of the Akathist on 8. Katavasia "I shall open". After the 3rd and 6th odes - three kontakia-ikoi of the Akathist; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Akathist; Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2450: 
 2451: ##### 3.7.2.7.10 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the Akathist, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2452: AT THE HOURS: On all: Troparion of the Akathist, Glory: of the Forefeast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Akathist, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast.
 2453: 
 2454: #### 3.7.2.8 AT THE LITURGY
 2455: 
 2456: ##### 3.7.2.8.1 Troparion of the Akathist and of the Forefeast, Glory: Kontakion of the Akathist, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2457: 
 2458: ##### 3.7.2.8.2 Everything else - of the Akathist Saturday with Apostle-Gospel, first - of the day
 2459: 
 2460: ##### 3.7.2.8.3 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION ON LAZARUS SATURDAY
 2461: The Service of the Forefeast is sung on the previous Thursday, according to the rule given for the fast days, here on p. 242-244.
 2462:

 2464:  
 2465: ### 3.7.3 March: Annunciation to the Most Holy Theotokos
 2466: This feast has 16 following cases:
 2467: 
 2468: ##### 3.7.3.1 On one of the fast days of the Forty Days
 2469: 
 2470: ##### 3.7.3.2 On the 3rd and 4th Saturdays of Lent
 2471: 
 2472: ##### 3.7.3.3 On the 3rd Sunday of Lent
 2473: 
 2474: ##### 3.7.3.4 On Wednesday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2475: 
 2476: ##### 3.7.3.5 On the 4th and 5th Sundays of Lent
 2477: 
 2478: ##### 3.7.3.6 On Thursday of the Great Canon
 2479: 
 2480: ##### 3.7.3.7 On Friday of the 5th week of Lent
 2481: 
 2482: ##### 3.7.3.8 On the Akathist Saturday
 2483: 
 2484: ##### 3.7.3.9 On Lazarus Saturday
 2485: 
 2486: ##### 3.7.3.10 On Palm Sunday
 2487: 
 2488: ##### 3.7.3.11 On Great Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday
 2489: 
 2490: ##### 3.7.3.12 On Great Thursday
 2491: 
 2492: ##### 3.7.3.13 On Great Friday
 2493: 
 2494: ##### 3.7.3.14 On Great Saturday
 2495: 
 2496: ##### 3.7.3.15 On the Sunday of the Resurrection
 2497: 
 2498: ##### 3.7.3.16 On Bright Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday
 2499: RULES OF THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES
 2500: 
 2501:  
 2502: ##### 3.7.3.17 ANNUNCIATION
 2503: 
 2504: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE FORTY DAYS
 2505: Note: If the feast falls on Monday, then on Sunday evening it has two Vespers: one Small, and the second - Great with Matins, with which it comprises the All-Night Vigil; if the feast falls on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, then on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evening it has only one Great Vespers together with the Liturgy of the Presanctified, and afterwards - Great Compline with Matins, with which it comprises the All-Night Vigil. And since today with us the Liturgy of the Presanctified is celebrated only on Wednesdays and Fridays of Great Lent, we give for Vespers of this feast three rules: one - for Sunday evening, the second - for Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening, the third - for Wednesday evening.
 2506: a) On Sunday evening
 2507: AT SMALL VESPERS: Everything according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only the Aposticha will be of the Triodion, and Glory, and now: of the Feast.
 2508: AT Great Vespers WITH All-Night Vigil
 2509: 1.	"Blessed is the man".
 2510: 
 2511: ##### 3.7.3.18 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 of the Triodion and 7 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2512: 
 2513: ##### 3.7.3.19 After the Entrance - Prokeimenon of the day from the Horologion and 3 readings of the Feast[^400]; other things of Vespers with the blessing of loaves - according to the general rule of feasts of the Theotokos
 2514: b) On Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening
 2515: AT Great Vespers WITHOUT THE PRESANCTIFIED
 2516: 
 2517: ##### 3.7.3.20 There is no Kathisma
 2518: 
 2519: ##### 3.7.3.21 At "Lord, I have cried" - 8 stichera: 3 of the Triodion and 5 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2520: 
 2521: ##### 3.7.3.22 After the Entrance - Prokeimenon of the day from the Horologion, readings of the day and three of the Feast[^401]  and immediately - "Vouchsafe, O Lord". At the Aposticha: idiomelon twice and martyricon with the usual refrains; Glory, and now: of the Feast. After "Now lettest Thou" - Troparion of the Feast, litany, three great prostrations and Great Dismissal with commemoration of the Feast
 2522: c) On Wednesday evening
 2523: 
 2524: AT VESPERS WITH THE PRESANCTIFIED
 2525: 
 2526: ##### 3.7.3.23 There is no Kathisma
 2527: 
 2528: ##### 3.7.3.24 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 5 of the Triodion and 5 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2529: 
 2530: ##### 3.7.3.25 After the Entrance - 2 readings of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and 3 of the Feast, also "Let my prayer be set forth" and other things of the Presanctified
 2531: AT Great Compline WITH All-Night Vigil
 2532: Everything - according to the general rule of Great Compline, here on p. 26-27, that is after the 1st Trisagion - Troparion of the Feast, after the 2nd - Kontakion of the Feast[^412]. At the Litya and at the Aposticha: stichera of the Feast; and at the blessing of loaves: Troparion of the Feast three times.
 2533: #### 3.7.3.1 AT Great Matins
 2534: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only:
 2535: 
 2536: ##### 3.7.3.1.1 After the 1st poetic session there will be the Sessional hymn of the Triodion, without litany
 2537: 
 2538: ##### 3.7.3.1.2 Canon of the Feast, heirmoi twice, troparia on 12, and where there is a three-ode canon, there will be 2 canons on 14, that is of the Feast with heirmos on 6, of the three-ode canon on 8 and katavasia - heirmos of the three-ode canon. At the 9th ode to the heirmos and to the troparia of the Canon of the Feast we sing separate refrains, and to the troparia of the three-ode canon - "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"; also after the Katavasia we sing the heirmos of the Triodion and of the Feast; the refrain and heirmos both choirs sing together
 2539: 
 2540: ##### 3.7.3.1.3 After the stichera of the Praises - Small Doxology; Aposticha of the Triodion; Glory, and now: of the Feast. "It is a good thing" once, and after "Our Father" - Troparion of the Feast and litany "Have mercy on us, O God" with three great prostrations. This Matins ends just as the daily one, that is without dismissal
 2541: 
 2542: #### 3.7.3.2 AT THE HOURS
 2543: 
 2544: ##### 3.7.3.2.1 Hours are read with kathismata according to the Lenten rule
 2545: 
 2546: ##### 3.7.3.2.2 There are no prostrations, with the exception of three great ones before the concluding prayer of each Hour
 2547: 
 2548: ##### 3.7.3.2.3 On all there will be the Troparion and Kontakion only of the Feast, without the Lenten ones
 2549: 
 2550: ##### 3.7.3.2.4 On the 6th - Troparion, Paremias of the Triodion, Paremia
 2551: AT THE BEATITUDES (TYPIKA)
 2552: Everything - according to the Lenten rule, without prostrations, with the exception of three great ones before the prayer "O All-Holy Trinity". After "Our Father" - Kontakion of the Feast alone.
 2553: 
 2554: AT THE LITURGY WITH VESPERS
 2555: 
 2556: ##### 3.7.3.2.5 There is no Kathisma, nor prostrations
 2557: 
 2558: ##### 3.7.3.2.6 At "Lord, I have cried" - 11 stichera: 5 of the Triodion, 3 of the Feast and 3 of Archangel Gabriel, the last of which has a separate refrain; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2559: 
 2560: ##### 3.7.3.2.7 Entrance with the Gospel; 2 readings of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and 2 of the Feast[^402]; after the Small Litany - exclamation of the Trisagion and further according to the order the Liturgy of Chrysostom, at which - everything to the Feast. Instead of "It is truly meet" - heirmos of the 9th ode of the canon
 2561: IF FOR SOME IMPORTANT REASON THERE BE NO LITURGY[^403] 
 2562: 
 2563: AT VESPERS
 2564: 
 2565: ##### 3.7.3.2.8 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 of the Triodion, 4 of the Feast and 3 of the Archangel; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2566: 
 2567: ##### 3.7.3.2.9 Entrance with the Gospel; 2 readings of the Triodion with prokeimena and 2 of the Feast, and also Prokeimenon; Apostle and Gospel of the Feast; and immediately "Vouchsafe, O Lord"
 2568: 
 2569: ##### 3.7.3.2.10 Aposticha of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2570: 
 2571: ##### 3.7.3.2.11 After "Now lettest Thou": Troparion of the Archangel, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2572: 
 2573: ##### 3.7.3.2.12 Litany "Have mercy on us, O God", three great prostrations and dismissal (great)
 2574: 
 2575: COMPLINE
 2576: We celebrate small without the canon, but after the "Creed" immediately - "It is truly meet" and after the Trisagion - Kontakion of the Feast; also after "God, have mercy on us" we make 15 prostrations, or 16 usual ones with the prayer of St. Ephraim "O Lord and Master"[^404]; and before "Spotless" we recite the concluding Trisagion with "Our Father" and "Lord, have mercy" (12) according to the rule of all Sundays of the Forty Days.
 2577:  
 2578: ##### 3.7.3.2.13 ANNUNCIATION ON THE 3RD AND 4TH SATURDAYS OF GREAT LENT
 2579: 
 2580: AT VESPERS WITH THE PRESANCTIFIED
 2581: 
 2582: ##### 3.7.3.2.14 There is no Kathisma
 2583: 
 2584: ##### 3.7.3.2.15 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: idiomelon of the Triodion twice and 8 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2585: 
 2586: ##### 3.7.3.2.16 Readings - 7: 2 of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and 5 of the Feast, and then - "Let my prayer be set forth" and according to the order the Liturgy of the Presanctified
 2587: AT THE All-Night Vigil
 2588: 
 2589: ##### 3.7.3.2.17 Great Compline, according to the rule given here on p. 252
 2590: 
 2591: ##### 3.7.3.2.18 Great Matins exactly according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, of the Triodion - nothing
 2592: AT THE HOURS AND LITURGY: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos.
 2593:  
 2594: ##### 3.7.3.2.19 ANNUNCIATION
 2595: 
 2596: ON THE SUNDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS - 3RD OF LENT
 2597: 
 2598: AT SMALL VESPERS
 2599: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos on Sunday, only at "Lord, I have cried" - 4 stichera of the Cross[^405]. After "Now lettest Thou" - Resurrectional Troparion; Glory, and now: of the Feast.
 2600: #### 3.7.3.3 AT Great Vespers
 2601: 1.	"Blessed is the man", as usual.
 2602: 
 2603: ##### 3.7.3.3.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - stichera on 10: 3 Resurrectional, 3 of the Cross and 4 of the Feast; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2604: 
 2605: ##### 3.7.3.3.2 Five readings of the Feast
 2606: 
 2607: ##### 3.7.3.3.3 At the Litya - 6 stichera: 3 of the Feast and 3 of the Cross from the Praises; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2608: 
 2609: ##### 3.7.3.3.4 Aposticha Resurrectional; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2610: 
 2611: ##### 3.7.3.3.5 At the blessing of loaves: Troparion of the Feast twice and of the Cross once
 2612: #### 3.7.3.4 AT Great Matins
 2613: 
 2614: ##### 3.7.3.4.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2615: 
 2616: ##### 3.7.3.4.2 Other things up to the canon - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos
 2617: 
 2618: ##### 3.7.3.4.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Cross on 4 and of the Feast on 6. Katavasia of the Feast. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Cross, Glory, Both now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th - "More honorable"; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2619: 
 2620: ##### 3.7.3.4.4 Stichera of the Praises - 9: 4 Resurrectional and 4 of the Feast, and also idiomelon "Arise, O Lord" and idiomelon of the day; Glory: the same, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2621: 
 2622: ##### 3.7.3.4.5 After the Great Doxology - everything only to the Cross with prostrations, according to the rule of this Sunday
 2623: 
 2624: ##### 3.7.3.4.6 After the Dismissal - Glory, and now: Gospel Stichera
 2625: 
 2626: #### 3.7.3.5 AT THE HOURS
 2627: On all: Resurrectional Troparion; Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Feast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Feast, without the Lenten.
 2628: 
 2629: #### 3.7.3.6 AT THE LITURGY
 2630: 
 2631: ##### 3.7.3.6.1 Resurrectional Troparion, of the Cross and of the Feast; Glory: Kontakion of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2632: 
 2633: ##### 3.7.3.6.2 Instead of the Trisagion - "Before Thy Cross", and instead of "In Thee rejoiceth" - Heirmos of the Feast
 2634: 
 2635: ##### 3.7.3.6.3 Everything else - first of the Feast, and then - of the Cross
 2636:  
 2637: ##### 3.7.3.6.4 ANNUNCIATION ON WEDNESDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2638: This service has been removed since, in our rite, with the permission of the Apostolic See of the 9 Fridays before Easter, all daily services in the Lenten period have been abolished, with the exception of the service on the 1st week.
 2639:

 2641: 
 2642: ##### 3.7.3.6.5 ANNUNCIATION ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 2643: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only:
 2644: AT SMALL VESPERS: At "Lord, I have cried" all stichera - of the Feast.
 2645: AT Great Vespers: Five readings of the Feast.
 2646: #### 3.7.3.7 AT Great Matins
 2647: 
 2648: ##### 3.7.3.7.1 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Triodion on 4 and of the Feast on 6. After the 3rd ode there is no Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos, but only the Sessional hymn of the Feast
 2649: 
 2650: ##### 3.7.3.7.2 At the "Praises", after 4 Resurrectional stichera and 4 stichera of the Feast there will be also the 9th idiomelon of the Triodion with its refrain, also Glory: the same, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2651: 
 2652: ##### 3.7.3.7.3 After the Dismissal - Gospel Stichera
 2653: 
 2654: #### 3.7.3.8 AT THE LITURGY
 2655: 
 2656: ##### 3.7.3.8.1 Resurrectional Troparion and of the Feast; Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Feast
 2657: 
 2658: ##### 3.7.3.8.2 Everything else - of the Sunday, only Communion Hymn of the Sunday and of the Feast
 2659: 
 2660: ________________________________________
 2661: 
 2662: ##### 3.7.3.8.3 ANNUNCIATION ON THURSDAY OF THE GREAT CANON
 2663: The service of the feast together with the great canon is sung according to the Lenten rule, which is given on p. 263-264 in the rule about the Annunciation on Great: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
 2664: 
 2665: ________________________________________
 2666: 
 2667: ##### 3.7.3.8.4 ANNUNCIATION ON FRIDAY OF THE 5TH WEEK OF LENT (OF THE AKATHIST)
 2668: Note: Our handwritten typikon, Tserkovne Oko and others transfer the service of the Akathist to another time, for example to the 4th Saturday of Lent, or to the Sunday of the 5th week. The new Constantinopolitan Typikon transfers it to Thursday of the 5th week of Lent (of the Great Canon), which it transfers back, to Tuesday. The Pochaiv Anthologion and Moscow Typikon combine the service of the Annunciation with the service of the Akathist, and on Matins give a rule similar to the rule of the Annunciation on the Akathist Saturday, only the canon of the Akathist they prescribe on 6 and of the Feast on 8.
 2669: However, the service of the Annunciation is so great that it does not allow combination with another service, and the service of the Akathist is also great and long, so that it could be sung together with the feast, and therefore, it seems, we have quite serious reasons not to make this combination. Therefore, here too, the Akathist should be transferred to another day, namely, optimally to Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday of the 5th week, at Compline[^407], and on Thursday we sing the great canon.

Kontakia - alternating: on the 1st and 6th - of the day ("Behold the Bridegroom"), on the 3rd and 9th - of the Feast

Instead of "In Thee rejoiceth", we sing the heirmos of the Triodion canon[^412]  instead of the "Cherubic Hymn", Communion Hymn and "Let our mouths be filled", we sing the Troparion "Of Thy Mystical Supper".

Instead of "Cherubic Hymn" - "Let all mortal flesh keep silence", and instead of "In Thee rejoiceth" - Heirmos of the day "Weep not for Me, O Mother"

Instead of "Cherubic Hymn" - "Let all mortal flesh keep silence", and instead of "In Thee rejoiceth" - Heirmos of the day "Weep not for Me, O Mother"

After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast and Sessional hymn of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Triodion; after the 9th - Trisagion, and after "Our Father" - Troparion "When Thou didst descend", Glory, and now: of the Feast.
