 2199: Kontakion of the Temple, Glory: Kontakion to the Forerunner, Both now: "O protection"; if the temple is of the Theotokos, then after the Kontakion to the Forerunner - Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Temple. After "More honorable" - three great prostrations, and also "O All-Holy Trinity" and dismissal.
 2200: 
 2201: ##### 3.6.4.13.1 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2202: ON SATURDAYS OF THE 2ND AND 3RD WEEKS OF LENT
 2203: Everything according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos on Saturday, only on Friday evening there will be the sequential Kathisma and at "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 to the Forerunner, and before the readings to the Forerunner there will be two Paremias of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and with "The Light of Christ", and also "Let my prayer be set forth" and according to the order the Service of the Presanctified.
 2204: 
 2205: ##### 3.6.4.13.2 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD
 2206: 
 2207: ON THE SECOND SUNDAY OF LENT
 2208: Everything according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos on Sunday, only:
 2209: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion to the Forerunner, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Triodion.
 2210: 
 2211: AT MATINS
 2212: 
 2213: ##### 3.6.4.13.3 Before the canon we sing "Open to me [the doors]"
 2214: 
 2215: ##### 3.6.4.13.4 Canons 4 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Triodion on 4 and of the Forerunner on 6. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Triodion and Kontakion-Ikos of the Forerunner; after the 6th - Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: to the Forerunner, Both now: Theotokion of the Resurrectional Exapostilarion
 2216: 
 2217: ##### 3.6.4.13.5 At the Praises, after 8 Resurrectional stichera and of the Forerunner, there will be also one of the Triodion with the refrain "Arise, O Lord" and the same with the refrain "Glory", and Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2218: 
 2219: ##### 3.6.4.13.6 After the Dismissal - Glory, and now: Gospel Stichera
 2220: 
 2221: #### 3.6.4.14 AT THE HOURS
 2222: On all: Resurrectional Troparion and Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Triodion, on the 3rd and 9th - to the Forerunner. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Triodion, on the 3rd and 9th - to the Forerunner.
 2223: 
 2224: #### 3.6.4.15 AT THE LITURGY
 2225: 
 2226: ##### 3.6.4.15.1 Resurrectional Troparion and to the Forerunner, Glory: Kontakion to the Forerunner, Both now: of the Triodion
 2227: 
 2228: ##### 3.6.4.15.2 Everything else - first of the Sunday, and then - of the Forerunner
 2229: 
 2230: ##### 3.6.4.15.3 FINDING OF THE PRECIOUS HEAD ON THE THIRD SUNDAY OF LENT
 2231: Everything according to the rule of the first Sunday of Lent, here on p. 233-235. 
 2232: 
 2233: ## 3.7 March
 2234: ### 3.7.1 March: Holy 40 Martyrs
 2235: Note
 2236: The service of this feast is with Polyeleos, and in its relation to the Triodion it can fall from the first Tuesday to Monday of the 6th week of Great Lent, which can be proven by the method of calculation given for the determination of the feast of the Finding of the Precious Head of the Forerunner, here on p. 226. And it has ten following cases.
 2237: 
 2238: ##### 3.7.1.1 On one of the fast days of the 1st week of Lent
 2239: 
 2240: ##### 3.7.1.2 On Saturday of the 1st week of Lent
 2241: 
 2242: ##### 3.7.1.3 On the 1st Sunday of Lent
 2243: 
 2244: ##### 3.7.1.4 On one of the fast days of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th weeks of Lent
 2245: 
 2246: ##### 3.7.1.5 On the 2nd Sunday of Lent
 2247: 
 2248: ##### 3.7.1.6 On the 3rd Sunday of Lent
 2249: 
 2250: ##### 3.7.1.7 On the 4th and 5th Sundays of Lent
 2251: 
 2252: ##### 3.7.1.8 On Wednesday of the 4th week of Lent
 2253: 
 2254: ##### 3.7.1.9 On Thursday of the Great Canon
 2255: 
 2256: ##### 3.7.1.10 On the Akathist Saturday (5th of Lent)
 2257: RULES FOR THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES
 2258: 1. 40 MARTYRS ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE 1ST WEEK OF LENT
 2259: Everything - according to the rule of the Finding of the Precious Head, here on p. 232.
 2260: 2. 40 MARTYRS ON SATURDAY OF THE 1ST WEEK OF LENT
 2261: According to the rule of the Finding, here on p. 232-233.
 2262: 3. 40 MARTYRS ON THE FIRST SUNDAY OF LENT
 2263: According to the rule, here on p. 233-235.
 2264: 4. 40 MARTYRS ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE 2ND, 3RD, 4TH, 5TH AND 6TH WEEKS OF LENT
 2265: According to the rule given in their text, which you have also here on p. 235-238, about the Finding of the Precious Head.
 2266: 5. 40 MARTYRS ON THE SECOND SUNDAY OF LENT
 2267: According to the rule of the Finding, here on p. 238-239.
 2268: 6. 40 MARTYRS ON THE THIRD SUNDAY OF LENT
 2269: According to the rule of the Finding, here on p. 239.
 2270: 7. 40 MARTYRS ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 2271: According to the rule of the 2nd Sunday, here on p. 238-239.
 2272: 8. 40 MARTYRS ON THE FOURTH WEDNESDAY OF LENT
 2273: Their service is transferred to the previous Tuesday.
 2274: The rule - in the text. However, since with us on this day the Presanctified does not happen, then at "Lord, I have cried" the stichera of the Cross on 6 are taken. The feast of the Holy Martyrs is given up at the Hours[^390]. At the Aposticha - idiomelon and Martyricon of the Triodion.
 2275: 9. 40 MARTYRS ON THURSDAY OF THE GREAT CANON
 2276: Their service is transferred to the previous Tuesday, according to the rule of the 8th case.
 2277: 10. 40 MARTYRS ON THE AKATHIST SATURDAY
 2278: Their service we sing in the morning, that is on the 5th Sunday of Lent, according to the rule of the Finding on the 2nd Sunday, here on p. 238-239[^391]. 
 2279: ### 3.7.2 March: Forefeast of the Annunciation
 2280: Has 10 following cases:
 2281: 
 2282: ##### 3.7.2.1 On one of the fast days of the Forty Days
 2283: 
 2284: ##### 3.7.2.2 On Saturday of the 3rd and 4th weeks of Lent
 2285: 
 2286: ##### 3.7.2.3 On the Sunday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2287: 
 2288: ##### 3.7.2.4 On Wednesday and Friday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2289: 
 2290: ##### 3.7.2.5 On Thursday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2291: 
 2292: ##### 3.7.2.6 On the 4th and 5th Sundays of Lent
 2293: 
 2294: ##### 3.7.2.7 On Tuesday of the 5th week of Lent
 2295: 
 2296: ##### 3.7.2.8 On Thursday of the 5th week of Lent, that is of the Great Canon
 2297: 
 2298: ##### 3.7.2.9 On the Akathist Saturday, 5th of Lent
 2299: 
 2300: ##### 3.7.2.10 On Lazarus Saturday
 2301: RULES FOR THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES 
 2302: 
 2303: ##### 3.7.2.11 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2304: 
 2305: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE FORTY DAYS
 2306: 
 2307: AT VESPERS
 2308: Vespers will be different on Sunday evening, and different - on Monday, Tuesday and Thursday, and different - on Wednesday evening.
 2309: a) On Sunday evening, when the Forefeast is on Monday
 2310: Everything - according to the general rule of other Sundays of Holy Lent, with the Great Prokeimenon, only:
 2311: 
 2312: ##### 3.7.2.12 At "Lord, I have cried", after 6 stichera, which are in the Triodion, there will be 4 - of the Forefeast; Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2313: 
 2314: ##### 3.7.2.13 At the Aposticha, after the stichera of the Triodion, - Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2315: b) On Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening, when the Forefeast is on Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday
 2316: Everything - according to the general rule of these fast days, only: At "Lord, I have cried" - 6 stichera: 3 prosomia of the Triodion and 3 of the Forefeast; Glory, Both now: to the Forefeast; likewise also at the Aposticha, after the stichera of the Triodion - Glory, Both now: to the Forefeast.
 2317: Note: On the Forefeast the typikon prescribes the Service of the Presanctified, as also on Saints with Polyeleos; however, with us the Service of the Presanctified is sung only on Wednesday and Friday, and on other days - of Chrysostom. When the Service of the Presanctified was supposed to be according to the typikon, but is not celebrated, then 3 stichera, which are at the Aposticha, should be transferred to "Lord, I have cried", and after them sing both 3 prosomia stichera of the Triodion, and 3 of the Forefeast. On Wednesday evening the stichera from the Aposticha do not need to be transferred to "Lord, I have cried", for they are already given in the Triodion at "Lord, I have cried".
 2318: c) On Wednesday evening, when the Forefeast is on Thursday
 2319: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule of this day, only: At "Lord, I have cried", after 6 stichera, which will be in the Triodion, also 3 of the Forefeast on 4; Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast.
 2320: AT COMPLINE: Everything - according to the Lenten rule.
 2321: 
 2322: AT MATINS
 2323: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule, only:
 2324: 
 2325: ##### 3.7.2.14 Canon of the Forefeast on 6 and of the Triodion on 8. After the 3rd ode - Sessional hymn of the Forefeast, and after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast
 2326: 
 2327: ##### 3.7.2.15 At the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2328: AT THE HOURS: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule.
 2329: 
 2330: ##### 3.7.2.16 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2331: ON SATURDAYS OF THE 3RD AND 4TH WEEKS OF LENT
 2332: 
 2333: AT VESPERS
 2334: Everything - according to the Lenten rule of Friday for Saturday, only: At "Lord, I have cried", after 6 stichera of the Triodion there will be also 4 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone.
 2335: 
 2336: #### 3.7.2.1 AT COMPLINE
 2337: If Small is sung, then after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Forefeast, and if Great will be (which only Slavic Triodia have), then after the 1st Trisagion - Troparion of the Forefeast, after the 2nd - usual troparia "Have mercy on us, O Lord". Canon of the Octoechos for the deceased; after "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Forefeast.
 2338: 
 2339: AT MATINS
 2340: 
 2341: ##### 3.7.2.1.1 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Forefeast twice, Glory, and now: the same
 2342: 
 2343: ##### 3.7.2.1.2 Kathismata and Sessional hymns usual of the Octoechos
 2344: 
 2345: ##### 3.7.2.1.3 Canon of the Forefeast on 6[^394]. After the 3rd ode - Katavasia of the Forefeast and Sessional hymn of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast, after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Forefeast. When there is a four-ode canon, that is the 6th, 7th, 8th and 9th odes, then - of the Forefeast on 6 and of the Triodion on 8, Katavasia of the Triodion
 2346: 
 2347: ##### 3.7.2.1.4 Aposticha of the Octoechos, as on all Saturdays, only Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2348: 
 2349: ##### 3.7.2.1.5 Troparion of the Forefeast one and after the litany - dismissal, as usual
 2350: AT THE HOURS: On all: Troparion and Kontakion - of the Forefeast.
 2351: AT THE LITURGY: Troparion, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Forefeast. Everything else - only of the day without the deceased.
 2352: 
 2353: ##### 3.7.2.1.6 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2354: 
 2355: ON THE SUNDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2356: #### 3.7.2.2 AT Great Vespers
 2357: 
 2358: ##### 3.7.2.2.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 Resurrectional, 4 of the Cross and 3 of the Forefeast, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone
 2359: 
 2360: ##### 3.7.2.2.2 Aposticha Resurrectional; Glory: Both now: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2361: 
 2362: ##### 3.7.2.2.3 Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2363: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast.
 2364: #### 3.7.2.3 AT Great Matins
 2365: 
 2366: ##### 3.7.2.3.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2367: 
 2368: ##### 3.7.2.3.2 Everything else up to the canon - Resurrectional, as outside the Forefeast
 2369: 
 2370: ##### 3.7.2.3.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Cross on 6 and of the Forefeast on 4. Katavasia of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Forefeast, and also Sessional hymn of the Cross; Glory, and now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Cross; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2371: 
 2372: ##### 3.7.2.3.4 Everything else to the end - according to the rule of the Sunday of the Veneration of the Cross
 2373: 
 2374: #### 3.7.2.4 AT THE HOURS
 2375: On all: Resurrectional Troparion, and also Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross, and on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross; on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast.
 2376: 
 2377: #### 3.7.2.5 AT THE LITURGY
 2378: 
 2379: ##### 3.7.2.5.1 Resurrectional Troparion, of the Cross and of the Forefeast; Glory: Kontakion of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2380: 
 2381: ##### 3.7.2.5.2 Everything else - only of the Sunday
 2382: 
 2383: ##### 3.7.2.5.3 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2384: 
 2385: ON WEDNESDAY AND FRIDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2386: Everything - according to the Lenten rule of these days, only:
 2387: 
 2388: AT VESPERS
 2389: 
 2390: ##### 3.7.2.5.4 At "Lord, I have cried" - 6 stichera: 3 of the Cross and 3 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2391: 
 2392: ##### 3.7.2.5.5 Likewise also at the Aposticha of Vespers and Matins after the stichera of the Triodion there will be Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2393: AT Great Compline: Everything - according to the Lenten rule.
 2394: 
 2395: AT MATINS
 2396: 
 2397: ##### 3.7.2.5.6 Canon of the Triodion on 6 and of the Forefeast on 4, and where there is a three-ode canon, there the Canon of the Cross on 4, of the Forefeast on 2 and the three-ode canon on 8
 2398: Katavasia after the 3rd, 8th and 9th[^395]  - heirmos of the three-ode canon, and after the 6th - heirmos of the Forefeast, because it is - the last canon. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Forefeast and Sessional hymn of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Cross; after the 9th - Lenten Triadikon Exapostilarion of the tone; and also of the Cross with its Cross-Theotokion[^396].
 2399: 
 2400: ##### 3.7.2.5.7 At the Praises - 4 stichera of the Cross, which are taken at "Lord, I have cried", which were left, that is 3 last on 4; Glory, and now: again must be taken from "Lord, I have cried"[^397]
 2401: 
 2402: ##### 3.7.2.5.8 At the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2403: 
 2404: ##### 3.7.2.5.9 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2405: 
 2406: ON THURSDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2407: Everything - according to the general Lenten rule, only:
 2408: AT VESPERS: At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Forefeast.
 2409: 
 2410: ##### 3.7.2.5.10 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2411: 
 2412: ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 2413: #### 3.7.2.6 AT Great Vespers
 2414: At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Octoechos and 4 of the Forefeast; Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone.
 2415: AT COMPLINE: Kontakion of the Triodion, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Forefeast.
 2416: #### 3.7.2.7 AT Great Matins
 2417: 
 2418: ##### 3.7.2.7.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2419: 
 2420: ##### 3.7.2.7.2 Other things up to the canon - Resurrectional, as without the Forefeast
 2421: 
 2422: ##### 3.7.2.7.3 Canons 4 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, Theotokos of the Octoechos on 2, Triodion on 4 and Forefeast on 4. Katavasia sequential. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Forefeast and Sessional hymn of the Triodion; Glory, and now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2423: 
 2424: ##### 3.7.2.7.4 Everything else - Resurrectional and of the Triodion, as usual
 2425: AT THE HOURS: On all - Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Forefeast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Triodion, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast.
 2426: AT THE LITURGY: Resurrectional Troparion and of the Forefeast; Glory: Kontakion of the Triodion, Both now: of the Forefeast. Everything else - of the Sunday.
 2427: 
 2428: ##### 3.7.2.7.5 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2429: ON TUESDAY OF THE 5TH WEEK OF LENT
 2430: The Forefeast is transferred to Monday, because on Tuesday the Great Canon is sung, for then on Wednesday will be the Feast of the Annunciation, and on Thursday - the Apodosis, the festal service of which - is incompatible with the penitential Great Canon.
 2431: 
 2432: ##### 3.7.2.7.6 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2433: 
 2434: ON THURSDAY OF THE GREAT CANON
 2435: Then the service of the Forefeast must be transferred to the previous Wednesday[^398]; on Thursday there will be the service of the Great Canon, and on Friday - the Feast.
 2436: 
 2437: ##### 3.7.2.7.7 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2438: 
 2439: ON THE AKATHIST SATURDAY
 2440: Everything according to the rule of the Triodion of this Saturday, however:
 2441: AT VESPERS: At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 7 of the Triodion and 3 of the Forefeast, Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: of the Akathist.
 2442: AT COMPLINE: Morning four-ode canon of the Triodion. After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Akathist, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Forefeast.
 2443: 
 2444: AT MATINS
 2445: 
 2446: ##### 3.7.2.7.8 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Akathist twice, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2447: (After both kathismata - three kontakia-ikoi of the Akathist).
 2448: 
 2449: ##### 3.7.2.7.9 Canons 2 making 14: of the Forefeast on 6 and of the Akathist on 8. Katavasia "I shall open". After the 3rd and 6th odes - three kontakia-ikoi of the Akathist; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Akathist; Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2450: 
 2451: ##### 3.7.2.7.10 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the Akathist, Glory, and now: of the Forefeast
 2452: AT THE HOURS: On all: Troparion of the Akathist, Glory: of the Forefeast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Akathist, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Forefeast.
 2453: 
 2454: #### 3.7.2.8 AT THE LITURGY
 2455: 
 2456: ##### 3.7.2.8.1 Troparion of the Akathist and of the Forefeast, Glory: Kontakion of the Akathist, Both now: of the Forefeast
 2457: 
 2458: ##### 3.7.2.8.2 Everything else - of the Akathist Saturday with Apostle-Gospel, first - of the day
 2459: 
 2460: ##### 3.7.2.8.3 FOREFEAST OF THE ANNUNCIATION ON LAZARUS SATURDAY
 2461: The Service of the Forefeast is sung on the previous Thursday, according to the rule given for the fast days, here on p. 242-244.

 2466: This feast has 16 following cases:

 2470: ##### 3.7.3.2 On the 3rd and 4th Saturdays of Lent

 2499: RULES OF THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES
 2500: 
 2501:  
 2502: ##### 3.7.3.17 ANNUNCIATION
 2503: 
 2504: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF THE FORTY DAYS
 2505: Note: If the feast falls on Monday, then on Sunday evening it has two Vespers: one Small, and the second - Great with Matins, with which it comprises the All-Night Vigil; if the feast falls on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday, then on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evening it has only one Great Vespers together with the Liturgy of the Presanctified, and afterwards - Great Compline with Matins, with which it comprises the All-Night Vigil. And since today with us the Liturgy of the Presanctified is celebrated only on Wednesdays and Fridays of Great Lent, we give for Vespers of this feast three rules: one - for Sunday evening, the second - for Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening, the third - for Wednesday evening.
 2506: a) On Sunday evening
 2507: AT SMALL VESPERS: Everything according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only the Aposticha will be of the Triodion, and Glory, and now: of the Feast.
 2508: AT Great Vespers WITH All-Night Vigil
 2509: 1.	"Blessed is the man".
 2510: 
 2511: ##### 3.7.3.18 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 of the Triodion and 7 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2512: 
 2513: ##### 3.7.3.19 After the Entrance - Prokeimenon of the day from the Horologion and 3 readings of the Feast[^400]; other things of Vespers with the blessing of loaves - according to the general rule of feasts of the Theotokos
 2514: b) On Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evening
 2515: AT Great Vespers WITHOUT THE PRESANCTIFIED
 2516: 
 2517: ##### 3.7.3.20 There is no Kathisma
 2518: 
 2519: ##### 3.7.3.21 At "Lord, I have cried" - 8 stichera: 3 of the Triodion and 5 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2520: 
 2521: ##### 3.7.3.22 After the Entrance - Prokeimenon of the day from the Horologion, readings of the day and three of the Feast[^401]  and immediately - "Vouchsafe, O Lord". At the Aposticha: idiomelon twice and martyricon with the usual refrains; Glory, and now: of the Feast. After "Now lettest Thou" - Troparion of the Feast, litany, three great prostrations and Great Dismissal with commemoration of the Feast
 2522: c) On Wednesday evening
 2523: 
 2524: AT VESPERS WITH THE PRESANCTIFIED
 2525: 
 2526: ##### 3.7.3.23 There is no Kathisma
 2527: 
 2528: ##### 3.7.3.24 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 5 of the Triodion and 5 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2529: 
 2530: ##### 3.7.3.25 After the Entrance - 2 readings of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and 3 of the Feast, also "Let my prayer be set forth" and other things of the Presanctified
 2531: AT Great Compline WITH All-Night Vigil
 2532: Everything - according to the general rule of Great Compline, here on p. 26-27, that is after the 1st Trisagion - Troparion of the Feast, after the 2nd - Kontakion of the Feast[^412]. At the Litya and at the Aposticha: stichera of the Feast; and at the blessing of loaves: Troparion of the Feast three times.
 2533: #### 3.7.3.1 AT Great Matins
 2534: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only:
 2535: 
 2536: ##### 3.7.3.1.1 After the 1st poetic session there will be the Sessional hymn of the Triodion, without litany
 2537: 
 2538: ##### 3.7.3.1.2 Canon of the Feast, heirmoi twice, troparia on 12, and where there is a three-ode canon, there will be 2 canons on 14, that is of the Feast with heirmos on 6, of the three-ode canon on 8 and katavasia - heirmos of the three-ode canon. At the 9th ode to the heirmos and to the troparia of the Canon of the Feast we sing separate refrains, and to the troparia of the three-ode canon - "Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee"; also after the Katavasia we sing the heirmos of the Triodion and of the Feast; the refrain and heirmos both choirs sing together
 2539: 
 2540: ##### 3.7.3.1.3 After the stichera of the Praises - Small Doxology; Aposticha of the Triodion; Glory, and now: of the Feast. "It is a good thing" once, and after "Our Father" - Troparion of the Feast and litany "Have mercy on us, O God" with three great prostrations. This Matins ends just as the daily one, that is without dismissal
 2541: 
 2542: #### 3.7.3.2 AT THE HOURS
 2543: 
 2544: ##### 3.7.3.2.1 Hours are read with kathismata according to the Lenten rule
 2545: 
 2546: ##### 3.7.3.2.2 There are no prostrations, with the exception of three great ones before the concluding prayer of each Hour
 2547: 
 2548: ##### 3.7.3.2.3 On all there will be the Troparion and Kontakion only of the Feast, without the Lenten ones
 2549: 
 2550: ##### 3.7.3.2.4 On the 6th - Troparion, Paremias of the Triodion, Paremia
 2551: AT THE BEATITUDES (TYPIKA)
 2552: Everything - according to the Lenten rule, without prostrations, with the exception of three great ones before the prayer "O All-Holy Trinity". After "Our Father" - Kontakion of the Feast alone.
 2553: 
 2554: AT THE LITURGY WITH VESPERS
 2555: 
 2556: ##### 3.7.3.2.5 There is no Kathisma, nor prostrations
 2557: 
 2558: ##### 3.7.3.2.6 At "Lord, I have cried" - 11 stichera: 5 of the Triodion, 3 of the Feast and 3 of Archangel Gabriel, the last of which has a separate refrain; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2559: 
 2560: ##### 3.7.3.2.7 Entrance with the Gospel; 2 readings of the Triodion with their Prokeimena and 2 of the Feast[^402]; after the Small Litany - exclamation of the Trisagion and further according to the order the Liturgy of Chrysostom, at which - everything to the Feast. Instead of "It is truly meet" - heirmos of the 9th ode of the canon
 2561: IF FOR SOME IMPORTANT REASON THERE BE NO LITURGY[^403] 
 2562: 
 2563: AT VESPERS
 2564: 
 2565: ##### 3.7.3.2.8 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 of the Triodion, 4 of the Feast and 3 of the Archangel; Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2566: 
 2567: ##### 3.7.3.2.9 Entrance with the Gospel; 2 readings of the Triodion with prokeimena and 2 of the Feast, and also Prokeimenon; Apostle and Gospel of the Feast; and immediately "Vouchsafe, O Lord"
 2568: 
 2569: ##### 3.7.3.2.10 Aposticha of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2570: 
 2571: ##### 3.7.3.2.11 After "Now lettest Thou": Troparion of the Archangel, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2572: 
 2573: ##### 3.7.3.2.12 Litany "Have mercy on us, O God", three great prostrations and dismissal (great)
 2574: 
 2575: COMPLINE
 2576: We celebrate small without the canon, but after the "Creed" immediately - "It is truly meet" and after the Trisagion - Kontakion of the Feast; also after "God, have mercy on us" we make 15 prostrations, or 16 usual ones with the prayer of St. Ephraim "O Lord and Master"[^404]; and before "Spotless" we recite the concluding Trisagion with "Our Father" and "Lord, have mercy" (12) according to the rule of all Sundays of the Forty Days.
 2577:  
 2578: ##### 3.7.3.2.13 ANNUNCIATION ON THE 3RD AND 4TH SATURDAYS OF GREAT LENT
 2579: 
 2580: AT VESPERS WITH THE PRESANCTIFIED
 2581: 
 2582: ##### 3.7.3.2.14 There is no Kathisma
 2583: 
 2584: ##### 3.7.3.2.15 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: idiomelon of the Triodion twice and 8 of the Feast; Glory, and now: of the Feast

 2588:

 2592: AT THE HOURS AND LITURGY: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos.

 2595:

 2600: #### 3.7.3.3 AT Great Vespers
 2601: 1.	"Blessed is the man", as usual.
 2602: 
 2603: ##### 3.7.3.3.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - stichera on 10: 3 Resurrectional, 3 of the Cross and 4 of the Feast; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2604: 
 2605: ##### 3.7.3.3.2 Five readings of the Feast
 2606: 
 2607: ##### 3.7.3.3.3 At the Litya - 6 stichera: 3 of the Feast and 3 of the Cross from the Praises; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2608: 
 2609: ##### 3.7.3.3.4 Aposticha Resurrectional; Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast

 2611: ##### 3.7.3.3.5 At the blessing of loaves: Troparion of the Feast twice and of the Cross once
 2612: #### 3.7.3.4 AT Great Matins
 2613: 
 2614: ##### 3.7.3.4.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast

 2616: ##### 3.7.3.4.2 Other things up to the canon - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos

 2618: ##### 3.7.3.4.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Cross on 4 and of the Feast on 6. Katavasia of the Feast. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Cross, Glory, Both now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th - "More honorable"; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast

 2620: ##### 3.7.3.4.4 Stichera of the Praises - 9: 4 Resurrectional and 4 of the Feast, and also idiomelon "Arise, O Lord" and idiomelon of the day; Glory: the same, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"

 2622: ##### 3.7.3.4.5 After the Great Doxology - everything only to the Cross with prostrations, according to the rule of this Sunday
 2623: 
 2624: ##### 3.7.3.4.6 After the Dismissal - Glory, and now: Gospel Stichera
 2625: 
 2626: #### 3.7.3.5 AT THE HOURS
 2627: On all: Resurrectional Troparion; Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Feast. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Cross, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Feast, without the Lenten.
 2628: 
 2629: #### 3.7.3.6 AT THE LITURGY
 2630: 
 2631: ##### 3.7.3.6.1 Resurrectional Troparion, of the Cross and of the Feast; Glory: Kontakion of the Cross, Both now: of the Feast
 2632: 
 2633: ##### 3.7.3.6.2 Instead of the Trisagion - "Before Thy Cross", and instead of "In Thee rejoiceth" - Heirmos of the Feast
 2634: 
 2635: ##### 3.7.3.6.3 Everything else - first of the Feast, and then - of the Cross
 2636:  
 2637: ##### 3.7.3.6.4 ANNUNCIATION ON WEDNESDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS
 2638: This service has been removed since, in our rite, with the permission of the Apostolic See of the 9 Fridays before Easter, all daily services in the Lenten period have been abolished, with the exception of the service on the 1st week.

 2641: 
 2642: ##### 3.7.3.6.5 ANNUNCIATION ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 2643: Everything - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only:
 2644: AT SMALL VESPERS: At "Lord, I have cried" all stichera - of the Feast.
 2645: AT Great Vespers: Five readings of the Feast.
 2646: #### 3.7.3.7 AT Great Matins
 2647: 
 2648: ##### 3.7.3.7.1 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional on 4, of the Triodion on 4 and of the Feast on 6. After the 3rd ode there is no Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos, but only the Sessional hymn of the Feast
 2649: 
 2650: ##### 3.7.3.7.2 At the "Praises", after 4 Resurrectional stichera and 4 stichera of the Feast there will be also the 9th idiomelon of the Triodion with its refrain, also Glory: the same, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2651: 
 2652: ##### 3.7.3.7.3 After the Dismissal - Gospel Stichera
 2653: 
 2654: #### 3.7.3.8 AT THE LITURGY
 2655: 
 2656: ##### 3.7.3.8.1 Resurrectional Troparion and of the Feast; Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Feast
 2657: 
 2658: ##### 3.7.3.8.2 Everything else - of the Sunday, only Communion Hymn of the Sunday and of the Feast
 2659: 
 2660: ________________________________________
 2661: 
 2662: ##### 3.7.3.8.3 ANNUNCIATION ON THURSDAY OF THE GREAT CANON
 2663: The service of the feast together with the great canon is sung according to the Lenten rule, which is given on p. 263-264 in the rule about the Annunciation on Great: Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday.
 2664: 
 2665: ________________________________________
 2666: 
 2667: ##### 3.7.3.8.4 ANNUNCIATION ON FRIDAY OF THE 5TH WEEK OF LENT (OF THE AKATHIST)
 2668: Note: Our handwritten typikon, Tserkovne Oko and others transfer the service of the Akathist to another time, for example to the 4th Saturday of Lent, or to the Sunday of the 5th week. The new Constantinopolitan Typikon transfers it to Thursday of the 5th week of Lent (of the Great Canon), which it transfers back, to Tuesday. The Pochaiv Anthologion and Moscow Typikon combine the service of the Annunciation with the service of the Akathist, and on Matins give a rule similar to the rule of the Annunciation on the Akathist Saturday, only the canon of the Akathist they prescribe on 6 and of the Feast on 8.
 2669: However, the service of the Annunciation is so great that it does not allow combination with another service, and the service of the Akathist is also great and long, so that it could be sung together with the feast, and therefore, it seems, we have quite serious reasons not to make this combination. Therefore, here too, the Akathist should be transferred to another day, namely, optimally to Monday, Tuesday, or Wednesday of the 5th week, at Compline[^407], and on Thursday we sing the great canon.
 2670:

 2686:

 2734: ON GREAT MONDAY, TUESDAY AND WEDNESDAY
 2735: We remind first of all, that at the dismissal it is proper to commemorate the Passion services and the Annunciation.
 2736: a) On Sunday evening

 2822: 
 2823: AT THE LITURGY WITH VESPERS
 2824: Everything - according to the rule, given for Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, here on p. 264-265, only, instead of the Liturgy of Chrysostom, there will be of Basil the Great, at which everything will be first - of the day, and afterwards - of the Feast. Instead of "In Thee rejoiceth", we sing the heirmos of the Triodion canon[^412]  instead of the "Cherubic Hymn", Communion Hymn and "Let our mouths be filled", we sing the Troparion "Of Thy Mystical Supper".
 2825:  
 2826: ##### 3.7.3.17.1 ANNUNCIATION ON GREAT FRIDAY
 2827: On Thursday evening
 2828: 
 2829: AT VESPERS WITH THE LITURGY
 2830: 
 2831: ##### 3.7.3.17.2 Kathisma none
 2832: 
 2833: ##### 3.7.3.17.3 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 5 of the Triodion and 5 of the Feast, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Feast. Entrance with the Gospel
 2834: 
 2835: ##### 3.7.3.17.4 Readings - 6: 3 of the Triodion, the first two - with their Prokeimena, and 3 of the Feast, after this - Small Litany and exclamation of the Trisagion, Trisagion and according to the order the Liturgy of Basil, at which everything - only of the day
 2836: AT Small Compline: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the day, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Feast.
 2837: 
 2838: AT MATINS
 2839: Everything according to the rule of the Triodion, only:
 2840: 
 2841: ##### 3.7.3.17.5 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Feast twice, Glory, and now: of the day ("When the glorious")
 2842: 
 2843: ##### 3.7.3.17.6 After the 7th Gospel the Gradual of Tone 4 and everything else up to the canon - to the Feast, according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos, only after the Gospel of the Feast the 8th Passion [Gospel] is also read
 2844: 
 2845: ##### 3.7.3.17.7 Canon of the Feast with heirmos on 14; heirmos - twice; troparia on 12. Katavasia of the Feast, and where - three-ode canon, there the Canon of the Feast on 6, three-ode canon on 8 and Katavasia of the three-ode canon. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the day; Glory, and now: Sessional hymn of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th, instead of "More honorable", there will be the refrain of the Feast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Feast, Glory: of the day, Both now: of the Feast
 2846: 
 2847: ##### 3.7.3.17.8 At "The Praises": stichera of the Triodion, only Both now: of the Feast, and at the Aposticha: stichera of the Feast, only Glory: of the Triodion
 2848: 
 2849: ##### 3.7.3.17.9 After "Our Father" - Troparion of the Triodion "Thou Hast redeemed us", Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2850: 
 2851: ##### 3.7.3.17.10 After the litany - separate dismissal of Friday with commemoration of the Annunciation
 2852: 
 2853: AT THE ROYAL HOURS
 2854: Everything according to their rule, only on all: Troparion of the Feast, Glory: of the day. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast, on the 3rd and 9th - of the day. At "The Beatitudes": Kontakion of the day[^413].
 2855: 
 2856: AT THE LITURGY WITH VESPERS
 2857: 
 2858: ##### 3.7.3.17.11 Kathisma none
 2859: 
 2860: ##### 3.7.3.17.12 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Feast, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Feast. Entrance with the Gospel
 2861: 
 2862: ##### 3.7.3.17.13 Readings - 5: 3 of the Triodion, the first two - with their Prokeimena, and 2 of the Feast; and immediately Small Litany with exclamation of the Trisagion and according to the order the Liturgy of Chrysostom, at which everything - first of the Feast, and then - of the day. Communion Hymn only of the Feast. Instead of "It is truly meet" - Heirmos of the Feast
 2863: 
 2864: ##### 3.7.3.17.14 ANNUNCIATION ON GREAT SATURDAY
 2865: On Friday evening
 2866: 
 2867: AT VESPERS
 2868: Everything according to the rule of Great Friday, only:
 2869: 
 2870: ##### 3.7.3.17.15 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Feast; Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Feast
 2871: 
 2872: ##### 3.7.3.17.16 After the Entrance with the Gospel - 8 readings: 3 of the Triodion, the first two with their Prokeimena, and 5 of the Feast, and immediately Prokeimenon of the day of the Triodion; also Apostle, Alleluia and Gospel - of the day
 2873: 
 2874: ##### 3.7.3.17.17 At the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, only Glory: of the Feast
 2875: 
 2876: ##### 3.7.3.17.18 At the end, according to the rule of the Triodion: Troparion of the Feast, and then Glory, and now: "The noble Joseph"; but since according to the present custom the Bringing Out of the Shroud takes place and the Troparion "The noble Joseph" we sing after placing it in the prepared tomb, therefore one should sing only the Troparion of the Feast, and after the Bringing Out of the Shroud - Troparion "The noble"
 2877: 
 2878: ##### 3.7.3.17.19 At the Dismissal of Great Saturday there will be commemoration of the Annunciation
 2879: AT Small Compline: Kontakion of the day, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Feast.
 2880: 
 2881: AT MATINS
 2882: Everything according to the rule of the Triodion, only:
 2883: 
 2884: ##### 3.7.3.17.20 At "God is the Lord": Troparion "The noble" once and "When Thou didst descend" once, Glory: "Unto the myrrh-bearing women", Both now: of the Feast
 2885: 
 2886: ##### 3.7.3.17.21 After the Sessional hymn of the Triodion, which is before the canon, we sing the Polyeleos and everything else up to the canon - to the Feast, according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos
 2887: 
 2888: ##### 3.7.3.17.22 Canons 2 making 16: of the Feast with heirmos on 8, heirmoi - twice; troparia on 6 and of the Triodion with heirmos on 8, heirmoi - twice. Katavasia of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th, instead of "More honorable", there will be the refrain of the Feast and after the Katavasia of the Triodion - refrain and heirmos of the Feast; after the 9th - "Holy is the Lord our God" and Exapostilarion of the Feast
 2889: 
 2890: ##### 3.7.3.17.23 Stichera of the Praises - 6: 3 of the Triodion, and then stichera of the Feast with its refrain, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 2891: 
 2892: #### 3.7.3.18 AT THE HOURS
 2893: On all: Troparion of the Feast, Glory: of the day. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast; on the 3rd and 9th - of the day.
 2894: At "The Beatitudes": Kontakion of the day, Glory, and now: Kontakion of the Feast and, after "O All-Holy Trinity" - Dismissal.
 2895: 
 2896: AT VESPERS WITH THE LITURGY OF BASIL
 2897: 
 2898: ##### 3.7.3.18.1 Kathisma none
 2899: 
 2900: ##### 3.7.3.18.2 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Feast, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Feast
 2901: 
 2902: ##### 3.7.3.18.3 After the Entrance with the Gospel there is no Prokeimenon, but immediately the Priest: "Wisdom", and the Reader - readings of the day according to their sequence and, after their conclusion - Small Litany, exclamation of the Trisagion and "As many as have been baptized into Christ"; and according to the order the Liturgy of Basil, at which everything - first of the day, and afterwards - of the Feast. Instead of "Cherubic Hymn" - "Let all mortal flesh keep silence", and instead of "In Thee rejoiceth" - Heirmos of the day "Weep not for Me, O Mother"
 2903: 
 2904: ##### 3.7.3.18.4 ANNUNCIATION ON THE SUNDAY OF THE RESURRECTION
 2905: On Saturday
 2906: 
 2907: ##### 3.7.3.18.5 Kathisma none
 2908: 
 2909: ##### 3.7.3.18.6 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Feast, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Feast
 2910: 
 2911: ##### 3.7.3.18.7 After the Entrance with the Gospel there is no Prokeimenon, but the Priest: "Wisdom", and the Reader - the first reading of the Triodion, and also 5 readings of the Feast and other readings of the Triodion and, after the Small Litany - exclamation of the Trisagion, "As many as have been baptized into Christ" and according to the order the Liturgy of Basil, at which everything - first of the day, and afterwards - of the Feast. Instead of "Cherubic Hymn" - "Let all mortal flesh keep silence", and instead of "In Thee rejoiceth" - Heirmos of the day "Weep not for Me, O Mother"
 2912: AT Small Compline: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast[^414].
 2913: INSTEAD OF Midnight Office
 2914: After Ps. 50 - Canon of Matins of the Annunciation on 6 and of Great Saturday on 8. Katavasia of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast and Sessional hymn of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Triodion; after the 9th - Trisagion, and after "Our Father" - Troparion "When Thou didst descend", Glory, and now: of the Feast. Litany and Dismissal.
 2915: 
 2916: AT PASCHAL MATINS
 2917: Everything according to the rule of the Triodion, only:
 2918: 
 2919: ##### 3.7.3.18.8 After the verses "Let God arise" we do not add to the troparion "Christ is risen", "Glory, and now", but after the last verse the Choir sings "Christ is risen" once, the Priest - the same up to the half, and all finish: "And upon those in the tombs", after which we enter the temple, the Priest - the sanctuary, and we sing Glory: Troparion of the Feast, Both now: the same
 2920: 
 2921: ##### 3.7.3.18.9 Paschal Canon with heirmos on 8 and of the Annunciation with heirmos on 8. Katavasia of Pascha. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Hypakoe of the Resurrection; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast, also Prokeimenon of the Feast "Let everything that hath breath"; Gospel of the Feast; "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (3) and stichera "Jesus having risen from the grave" (3). At the 9th - refrains of Pascha and of the Feast, Exapostilarion of Pascha and of the Feast with the refrain "Glory, and now"
 2922: 
 2923: ##### 3.7.3.18.10 Stichera of the Praises - 8: 4 Resurrectional and 4 of the Feast with their refrains, also stichera of the Resurrection "Let God arise", Glory: of the Feast, Both now: of the Resurrection, "It is the Day of Resurrection" and, after "Christ is risen", - litany "Have mercy on us, O God" and "Let us complete"; Paschal Dismissal with commemoration of the Annunciation
 2924: AT THE HOURS: According to the rule of the Sunday of the Resurrection.
 2925: 
 2926: #### 3.7.3.19 AT THE LITURGY
 2927: 
 2928: ##### 3.7.3.19.1 Troparion "Christ is risen" (3), Glory: Troparion of the Feast, Both now: Kontakion of the Resurrection
 2929: 
 2930: ##### 3.7.3.19.2 Everything else - first of the Resurrection, and then - of the Feast, only bells are not rung for the Gospel of the Feast. Instead of "It is truly meet" - "The Angel Cried" with the Heirmos of the Resurrection
 2931: 
 2932: ##### 3.7.3.19.3 ANNUNCIATION
 2933: ON BRIGHT MONDAY, TUESDAY AND WEDNESDAY
 2934: Everything according to the rule of the Triodion of these days, only:
 2935: 
 2936: AT SMALL VESPERS
 2937: Stichera at "Lord, I have cried" and at the Aposticha are taken according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos on Sunday. Prokeimenon will be great "Who is so great a God as our God". At the Aposticha, after the Doxastikon of the Feast, will be Glory: "It is the Day of Resurrection"; also "Christ is risen" (3), Glory, and now: Troparion of the Feast; "Have mercy on us, O God" and Dismissal.
 2938: #### 3.7.3.20 AT Great Vespers
 2939: 
 2940: ##### 3.7.3.20.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 4 of the Triodion and 6 of the Feast, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2941: 
 2942: ##### 3.7.3.20.2 After the Great Prokeimenon - 5 readings of the Feast and, if Sunday evening, then after "And that we may be accounted worthy" the usual Paschal Gospel is read
 2943: 
 2944: ##### 3.7.3.20.3 At the Litya: stichera of the Feast, and at the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, Glory: of the Feast, Both now: "It is the Day of Resurrection" and, after "Christ is risen" (3), Troparion of the Feast three times with the blessing of loaves
 2945: 
 2946: ##### 3.7.3.20.4 Instead of "Blessed be the name of the Lord" - "Christ is risen" (3) and Psalm "I will bless the Lord"[^415]
 2947: 
 2948: AT MATINS
 2949: 
 2950: ##### 3.7.3.20.5 At the beginning, after the ending of the verses "Let God arise", we do not say Glory, and now: Troparion "Christ is risen", but Glory: Troparion of the Annunciation, Both now: the same
 2951: 
 2952: ##### 3.7.3.20.6 After the litany "In peace let us pray to the Lord" - Polyeleos with "Great Doxology", Post-Polyeleos Sessional hymn, Gradual of Tone 4, 1st antiphon and everything else up to the canon - according to the general rule of a feast of the Theotokos on Sunday, only "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (3) and Ps. 50 are not taken
 2953: 
 2954: ##### 3.7.3.20.7 Paschal Canon with heirmos on 6 and of the Feast with heirmos on 8. Katavasia of the Feast. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Resurrection and Sessional hymn of the Feast, and other things, as in the previous case on p. 271
 2955: 
 2956: ##### 3.7.3.20.8 At "The Praises" - 6 stichera: 3 of the Triodion, also stichera of the Resurrection with Glory: of the Annunciation, Both now: "It is the Day of Resurrection" and, after "Christ is risen" (3), Glory, and now: Troparion of the Annunciation, then two litanies and Paschal Dismissal with commemoration of the Annunciation
 2957: AT THE HOURS: Of the Sunday of the Resurrection.
 2958: 
 2959: #### 3.7.3.21 AT THE LITURGY
 2960: Troparion "Christ is risen" and of the Feast, Glory: Kontakion of the Resurrection, Both now: of the Feast. Everything else - first of the day, and afterwards - of the Feast.
 2961: 
 2962: ### 3.7.4 March: Apodosis of the Annunciation and Synaxis of the Holy Archangel Gabriel
 2963: Has 7 following cases:
 2964: 
 2965: ##### 3.7.4.1 On one of the fast days of Great Lent
 2966: 
 2967: ##### 3.7.4.2 On Saturday of the 3rd and 4th weeks of Lent
 2968: 
 2969: ##### 3.7.4.3 On the 3rd Sunday of Lent (Veneration of the Cross)
 2970: 
 2971: ##### 3.7.4.4 On Wednesday of the 4th week of Lent
 2972: 
 2973: ##### 3.7.4.5 On the 4th and 5th Sundays of Lent
 2974: 
 2975: ##### 3.7.4.6 On Thursday of the 5th week of Lent (of the Great Canon)
 2976: 
 2977: ##### 3.7.4.7 On Akathist Saturday
 2978:  
 2979: ##### 3.7.4.8 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 2980: 
 2981: ON ONE OF THE FAST DAYS OF GREAT LENT
 2982: 
 2983: AT VESPERS
 2984: a) On Sunday evening
 2985: 
 2986: ##### 3.7.4.9 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 of the Triodion, 4 of the Feast and 3 of the Archangel, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2987: 
 2988: ##### 3.7.4.10 Everything else - according to the Lenten rule of the Triodion on Sunday evening, only at the Aposticha - Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2989: b) On Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evening
 2990: We sing without canon and without prostrations because there was All-Night Vigil, only after "More honorable" - 3 great prostrations with the prayer of St. Ephraim, 12 others and again one great with the whole St. Ephraim[^416].
 2991: 
 2992: AT MATINS
 2993: Everything according to the general Lenten rule, only:
 2994: 
 2995: ##### 3.7.4.11 Canons 2: of the Feast with heirmos on 6 and of the Archangel on 6. Katavasia of the Feast[^417]; if there be a three-ode canon, then the canon of the Feast together and of the Archangel with heirmos on 6 and the three-ode canon on 8. Katavasia - heirmos of the Triodion. After the 3rd ode - sessional hymn and after the 6th - kontakion of the Archangel
 2996: 
 2997: ##### 3.7.4.12 At "The Praises": 4 stichera of the Archangel, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 2998: AT THE HOURS AND AT THE "BEATITUDES": Everything according to the Lenten rule.
 2999:  
 3000: ##### 3.7.4.13 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 3001: ON SATURDAYS OF THE 3RD AND 4TH WEEKS OF LENT
 3002: (On Friday evening)
 3003: 
 3004: AT VESPERS WITH THE SERVICE OF CHRYSOSTOM
 3005: Everything according to the rule, here on p. 253-254.
 3006: AT COMPLINE: Small Compline is sung, according to the rule, here on p. 254.
 3007: 
 3008: AT MATINS
 3009: 
 3010: ##### 3.7.4.14 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Feast twice, Glory: of the Archangel, Both now: of the Feast
 3011: 
 3012: ##### 3.7.4.15 After the kathismata: Sessional hymn of the Feast
 3013: 
 3014: ##### 3.7.4.16 Canons 2: of the Feast on 8 and of the Archangel on 6. Katavasia of the Feast (the four-ode canon is not sung here, but is sung before that, at Compline)[^418]. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Archangel and his Sessional hymn, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th, instead of "More honorable" - refrain and heirmos of the Feast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Feast; Glory: of the Archangel, Both now: of the Feast
 3015: 
 3016: ##### 3.7.4.17 Stichera of the Praises - 6: 3 of the Feast and 3 of the Archangel, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3017: 
 3018: ##### 3.7.4.18 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the Archangel, Glory and now: of the Feast
 3019: AT THE HOURS: On all: Troparion of the Feast and of the Archangel. Kontakia: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast; on the 3rd and 9th - of the Archangel.
 3020: 
 3021: #### 3.7.4.1 AT THE LITURGY
 3022: 
 3023: ##### 3.7.4.1.1 Troparion of the Feast and of the Archangel, Glory: Kontakion of the Archangel, Both now: of the Feast
 3024: 
 3025: ##### 3.7.4.1.2 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - of the Feast; Apostle-Gospel - of the day and of the Feast; instead of "It is truly meet" - Heirmos of the Feast
 3026:  
 3027: ##### 3.7.4.1.3 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 3028: 
 3029: ON THE SUNDAY OF THE VENERATION OF THE CROSS (3RD OF LENT)
 3030: The service is of the Sunday, of the Cross and of the Feast; and the service of the Archangel we sing on Monday.
 3031: Everything is sung according to the rule of the Forefeast on the Sunday of the Veneration of the Cross, here on p. 245-246, only:
 3032: 
 3033: AT MATINS
 3034: 
 3035: ##### 3.7.4.1.4 The canon of the feast is sung before the canon of the Cross
 3036: 
 3037: ##### 3.7.4.1.5 Stichera of the Praises - 9: 3 Resurrectional, 2 of the Cross and 3 of the Feast with their refrains, and also the Idiomelon of the Triodion with its refrain; Glory: the same, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 3038: 
 3039: #### 3.7.4.2 AT THE LITURGY
 3040: 
 3041: ##### 3.7.4.2.1 Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel and Communion Hymn - first of the Cross, and afterwards - of the Feast
 3042: 
 3043: ##### 3.7.4.2.2 Instead of "It is truly meet" - "In Thee rejoiceth"
 3044: 
 3045: ##### 3.7.4.2.3 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 3046: ON WEDNESDAY OF MID-LENT (4TH OF LENT)
 3047: The service of the Archangel we sing on another day or at Compline. The service of Wednesday of Mid-Lent and of the Feast we sing according to the general Lenten rule, only:
 3048: 
 3049: AT VESPERS WITH THE SERVICE OF CHRYSOSTOM
 3050: On Tuesday evening
 3051: 
 3052: ##### 3.7.4.2.4 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Triodion and 4 of the Feast, Glory: of the Triodion, Both now: of the Feast
 3053: 
 3054: ##### 3.7.4.2.5 After the Entrance - 2 readings of the Triodion with their prokeimena and the first 2 of the 5 of the Feast that are given at yesterday's Vespers, and also Small Litany with the exclamation of the Trisagion, and from here according to the order the Service of Chrysostom
 3055: AT COMPLINE: According to the rule given here on p. 254.
 3056: 
 3057: AT MATINS
 3058: 
 3059: ##### 3.7.4.2.6 Canons 2 on 10: of the Feast on 6 and of the Cross on 4, and where there is a three-ode canon, there will be 4 canons on 14, that is of the Feast on 4, of the Cross on 2 and 2 three-ode canons on 8; also katavasia - heirmos of the three-ode canon[^419]. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast and Sessional hymn of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Cross; at the 9th - "More honorable"; after the 9th - Triadikon Exapostilarion
 3060: 
 3061: ##### 3.7.4.2.7 At "The Praises" and at the Aposticha: stichera of the Triodion, only at "The Praises" - Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3062: 
 3063: ##### 3.7.4.2.8 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 3064: 
 3065: ON THE 4TH AND 5TH SUNDAYS OF LENT
 3066: Everything - according to the general rule of a forefeast or afterfeast with a Polyeleos Saint on Sunday, only:
 3067: AT COMPLINE: After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Triodion, Glory, and now: of the Feast.
 3068: #### 3.7.4.3 AT Great Matins
 3069: 
 3070: ##### 3.7.4.3.1 Before the canon we sing "Open to me the doors"
 3071: 
 3072: ##### 3.7.4.3.2 Canons 4: Resurrectional on 4, of the Triodion on 4 and of the Feast together with the Archangel on 6. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Archangel, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast
 3073: 
 3074: ##### 3.7.4.3.3 At "The Praises", after 8 stichera Resurrectional and of the Triodion there will be also the 9th Idiomelon of the Triodion with the refrain "Arise" and Glory: the same, and the Gospel stichera - after the dismissal of Matins
 3075: AT THE HOURS: Instead of the Sunday one there will be the Kontakion of the Triodion.
 3076: AT THE LITURGY: Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel and Communion Hymn - of the Sunday and of the Feast.
 3077: 
 3078: ##### 3.7.4.3.4 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION
 3079: ON THURSDAY OF THE 5TH WEEK OF LENT (OF THE GREAT CANON)
 3080: The Great Canon is transferred back to Tuesday. And here the service of the feast with the triodion is sung according to the Lenten rule given above, and at Matins the feast takes its apodosis.
 3081: 
 3082: ##### 3.7.4.3.5 APODOSIS OF THE ANNUNCIATION ON SATURDAY OF THE 5TH WEEK OF LENT (AKATHIST SATURDAY)
 3083: On Friday evening
 3084: 
 3085: AT VESPERS WITH THE SERVICE OF CHRYSOSTOM
 3086: 
 3087: ##### 3.7.4.3.6 At "Lord, I have cried" - stichera on 10: Idiomelon of the day twice and 8 of the Feast, Glory: of the Akathist, Both now: of the Feast
 3088: 
 3089: ##### 3.7.4.3.7 After the Entrance - 2 readings of the Triodion with their prokeimena and 2 readings of the Feast, and immediately Small Litany with exclamation of the Trisagion, Trisagion and according to the order the Liturgy of Chrysostom, at which - everything to the Feast
 3090: 
 3091: AT SMALL COMPLINE
 3092: Without canon[^420] and without prostrations. After "It is truly meet" - Kontakion of the Feast of the Annunciation[^421].
 3093: 
 3094: AT MATINS
 3095: Everything - according to the rule of Akathist Saturday, only: 1. Canons 2: of the Feast on 6 and of the Akathist on 8. The four-ode canon we sing before that, at Compline. At the 9th we do not sing "More honorable", but instead of it, the refrain and heirmos of the Feast (Annunciation); after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Feast.
 3096: 
 3097: ##### 3.7.4.3.8 Stichera of the Praises of the Akathist on 4, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3098: 
 3099: ##### 3.7.4.3.9 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the Feast

 3113: ## 3.8 April
 3114: ### 3.8.1 April: Holy Great-Martyr George
 3115: This feast is celebrated with us with All-Night Vigil and, by the decision of the Lviv Synod, must be transferred to Sunday (the following one). It can fall only with the services of the Flowery Triodion, from Great Friday to Thursday after the 5th Sunday of the Resurrection, both inclusive, which is proven by the method of calculation given for the Finding of the Precious Head of the Forerunner on p. 226. It has 6 following cases:
 3116: 
 3117: ##### 3.8.1.1 On Great Friday, Great Saturday and on the very day of the Resurrection
 3118: 
 3119: ##### 3.8.1.2 On one of the days of Bright Week
 3120: 
 3121: ##### 3.8.1.3 On the Sunday of the Apostle Thomas
 3122: 
 3123: ##### 3.8.1.4 On the Sundays of the Myrrh-bearers, of the Paralytic and of the Samaritan Woman
 3124: 
 3125: ##### 3.8.1.5 On Mid-Pentecost Wednesday
 3126: 
 3127: ##### 3.8.1.6 On one of the weekdays from the Sunday of the Apostle Thomas to the Ascension
 3128: RULES OF THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES
 3129: 
 3130: ##### 3.8.1.7 SAINT GREAT MARTYR GEORGE
 3131: ON GREAT FRIDAY, SATURDAY AND ON THE VERY DAY OF THE RESURRECTION
 3132: Transferred to Bright Monday. The rule - below.
 3133: 
 3134: ##### 3.8.1.8 SAINT GREAT MARTYR GEORGE
 3135: ON ONE OF THE DAYS OF BRIGHT WEEK[^422]
 3136: Everything - according to the rule of the Triodion of these days, only:
 3137: 
 3138: AT SMALL VESPERS
 3139: 1.	"Blessed is our God", "Christ is risen" (3) with the verses "Let God arise".
 3140: 
 3141: ##### 3.8.1.9 At "Lord, I have cried": 4 Resurrectional stichera of the Octoechos of the current tone; Glory: to the Saint, Both now: Theotokion of Small Vespers of the Octoechos, according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 3142: 
 3143: ##### 3.8.1.10 Prokeimenon Great of the day
 3144: 
 3145: ##### 3.8.1.11 At the Aposticha: one Resurrectional stichera of the Octoechos, also stichera of the Saint of Great Vespers, only Both now: to the Resurrection "It is the Day of Resurrection", "Christ is risen" (3) and immediately the Troparion of the Saint; Glory, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint; "Have mercy on us, O God" and dismissal
 3146: #### 3.8.1.1 AT Great Vespers
 3147: 
 3148: ##### 3.8.1.1.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 4 of the Triodion and 6 of the Saint, Glory: to the Saint, Both now: 1st Theotokion according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 3149: 
 3150: ##### 3.8.1.1.2 After the Great Prokeimenon of the Triodion - 3 readings to the Saint, and if on the very day of the Resurrection, then the Priest reads the Gospel of the Resurrection from "And that we may be accounted worthy"
 3151: 
 3152: ##### 3.8.1.1.3 At the Litya: stichera of the Saint
 3153: 
 3154: ##### 3.8.1.1.4 At the Aposticha: one Resurrectional stichera, also stichera of the Resurrection; and after the stichera of the Resurrection there will be the Doxastikon of the Saint, Both now: "It is the Day of Resurrection" and, after "Christ is risen" (3) we sing the Troparion of the Saint twice and "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos" once. Blessing of loaves, "Christ is risen" (3) and "Blessed be the name of the Lord"
 3155: 
 3156: AT MATINS
 3157: 
 3158: ##### 3.8.1.1.5 At the beginning, after the 4 verses "Let God arise" and others - Glory: Troparion to the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Troparion of the Saint. Litany "In peace let us pray to the Lord" and immediately Polyeleos; up to the canon - everything to the Saint, only after the 50th Psalm - "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" (3)
 3159: 
 3160: ##### 3.8.1.1.6 Canon of the Resurrection with heirmos on 8 and of the Saint on 6. Katavasia of Pascha. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of Pascha, after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Saint and "Jesus having risen from the grave"; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Resurrection, Glory: of the Saint, Both now: of the Resurrection
 3161: 
 3162: ##### 3.8.1.1.7 Stichera of the Praises: 3 of the Triodion, 3 of the Saint, also stichera of the Resurrection with their refrains. Glory: to the Saint, Both now: of the Resurrection "It is the Day of Resurrection", and, after "Christ is risen" (3) - Glory: Troparion of the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint, two litanies and dismissal
 3163: HOURS - of the Resurrection
 3164:

 3166:

 3168:

 3215: ##### 3.8.1.6.3 SAINT GREAT MARTYR GEORGE
 3216: 
 3217: ON THE SUNDAYS OF THE MYRRH-BEARERS, OF THE PARALYTIC AND OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN
 3218: If St. Great Martyr George falls on the Sunday of the Samaritan Woman, then the service of Mid-Pentecost is not taken.

 3220: AT SMALL VESPERS
 3221: Everything - according to the general rule of a Saint with All-Night Vigil on Sunday. Only at the end, on the Sunday of the Myrrh-bearers, there will be the Troparion to the Saint, Glory, and now: "The noble Joseph". On the Sundays of the Paralytic and of the Samaritan Woman - Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: to the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint.

 3223: 1.	"Blessed is the man", as usual.

In other Sundays: Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: to the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Saint

 3238: ##### 3.8.1.8.2 Everything else up to the canon is taken according to the general rule of a Saint with Polyeleos on Sunday, only "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" - three times
 3239: 
 3240: ##### 3.8.1.8.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional with Theotokion on 6, that is Resurrectional on 4 and Theotokion on 2, of the Saint on 4 and of the Triodion on 4. (Since in the Canon of the Triodion there are many troparia, of which the first are - Resurrectional, and some - festal, that is of the Myrrh-bearers or of Arimathea, the penultimate - Triadikon, and the last - Theotokion, one Resurrectional and one of the Feast is taken, then the Triadikon and Theotokion). Katavasia of Pascha. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Saint, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th "More honorable" we do not sing, but to the troparia of the Canon of the Resurrection we sing the refrain of the Resurrection as on Pascha; to the troparia of the Saint we sing the usual refrain of the Saint; to the troparia of the Triodion - "Glory to Thee, O Lord, for Thy holy Resurrection"[^424], except "Glory" to the penultimate and "Both now" to the last, as usual; after the 9th - "Holy is the Lord our God" and Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: to the Saint, Both now: to the Feast

 3331: ### 3.8.2 April: Holy Apostle and Evangelist Mark
 3332: Can fall with services of the Flowery Triodion, from the Resurrection to Saturday before the 6th Sunday of the Resurrection (of the Blind Man), both inclusive. It is celebrated according to the rules of St. George, here on p. 280, with the exception of the All-Night Vigil. At the end of Vespers there will be:
 3333: 
 3334: ##### 3.8.2.1 In Bright Week at the Aposticha immediately - Troparion "Christ is risen" (3), Glory: Troparion of the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion, according to the tone of the Troparion of the Saint
 3335: 
 3336: ##### 3.8.2.2 In the week of the Apostle Thomas and in the middle of Mid-Pentecost: Troparion of the Saint, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3337: 
 3338: ##### 3.8.2.3 In other cases: Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Saint, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion, according to the tone of the Troparion of the Saint
 3339: ### 3.8.3 April
 3340: Holy Apostle James the Greater
 3341: Can fall with services of the Triodion from Friday of Bright Week to Thursday after the Sunday of the Blind Man, the 6th after the Resurrection. It is celebrated according to the rules of St. George, here on p. 280, with the exception of the All-Night Vigil, as noted about St. Mark, 25 April. Although St. George does not reach the Sunday of the Blind Man like James, however, the Sunday of the Blind Man has the same rule as the three preceding Sundays, to which St. James reaches. But since on Wednesday after the Sunday of the Blind Man - is the Apodosis of the Resurrection, and on Thursday - Ascension, to which the rules of St. George do not reach, in these two cases one should adhere to the rule of the Theologian on 8 May, which we will give below, with the exception of the All-Night Vigil, which James does not have.
 3342: ## 3.9 May
 3343: ### 3.9.1 May: Our Venerable Father Theodosius of the Caves
 3344: Can fall with services of the Flowery Triodion, from Monday after the Sunday of the Apostle Thomas to the 7th Sunday after the Resurrection (Holy Fathers) inclusive. From Monday after the Sunday of the Apostle Thomas to the Apodosis of the Resurrection adhere to the rule of St. George, here on p. 280. From the Apodosis of the Resurrection and further adhere to the rule of the Theologian on 8 May, with the exception of the All-Night Vigil, as we gave on 25 April.
 3345: The Service of the Holy Martyrs is sung at Compline.
 3346: ### 3.9.2 May: Appearance of the Sign of the Precious Cross in the sky in Jerusalem
 3347: and of the Holy Martyr Acacius
 3348: The Service of this day - of small type, without Polyeleos, without Great Doxology and incomplete, for it has only a Troparion and Kontakion, stichera at "Lord, I have cried", a canon at Matins, at the Liturgy - Apostle-Gospel and Communion Hymn to the Cross from 14 September, as our and Russian typikons and the Venetian Menaion give, according to others - only Troparion and Kontakion. It coincides with services of the Flowery Triodion from Friday before the Sunday of the Myrrh-bearers to Thursday before the Descent of the Holy Spirit.
 3349: The Menaion gives only one rule - for weekdays in the middle of the feast. If, however, this service falls on one of the Sundays of Pentecost, or on some other day, on which the service of a Saint without Polyeleos should be sung at Compline or should be transferred to another day, we think that it too should be subject to this rule. The Service of St. Acacius is sung at Compline.

 3363: In other weeks, in which only the Resurrectional Troparion is given, there will be Resurrectional Troparion, Glory, and now: of the Cross.

 3370: 
 3371: ##### 3.9.2.1.6 Canons 2 making 12: of the Feast with heirmos on 6 and of the Cross on 6. Katavasia after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th - heirmos of the Cross Canon. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast and Sessional hymn of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Cross; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Cross, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3372: 
 3373: ##### 3.9.2.1.7 At the end: Troparion, as at Vespers
 3374: AT THE HOURS: On all - Troparion of the Feast, Glory: to the Cross. Kontakion: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast; on the 3rd and 9th - of the Cross.
 3375: 
 3376: #### 3.9.2.2 AT THE LITURGY
 3377: 
 3378: ##### 3.9.2.2.1 Troparion of the Feast and of the Cross, Glory: Kontakion of the Feast, Both now: of the Cross
 3379: 
 3380: ##### 3.9.2.2.2 Apostle-Gospel of the day and of the Cross. Everything else - of the Feast and of the Cross[^431]
 3381: ### 3.9.3 May: Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian
 3382: The Service of the Holy Apostle is celebrated with All-Night Vigil and, by the decision of the Lviv Synod, is transferred to Sunday. The Service of St. Arsenius - incomplete, for it has only stichera at "Lord, I have cried" and at Matins - Troparion, Kontakion and Canon.
 3383: The Service of the Theologian falls from Saturday after the Sunday of the Apostle Thomas to Friday before the Descent of the Holy Spirit, both inclusive. Has 6 following cases:
 3384: 
 3385: ##### 3.9.3.1 On one of the weekdays of Pentecost
 3386: 
 3387: ##### 3.9.3.2 On the Sundays of the Myrrh-bearers, of the Paralytic, of the Samaritan Woman and of the Blind Man
 3388: 
 3389: ##### 3.9.3.3 On Mid-Pentecost Wednesday of Pentecost
 3390: 
 3391: ##### 3.9.3.4 On Wednesday before the Ascension with the Apodosis of the Resurrection
 3392: 
 3393: ##### 3.9.3.5 On Thursday of the Ascension
 3394: 
 3395: ##### 3.9.3.6 On the Sunday of the Holy Fathers
 3396: RULES FOR THE ABOVE-MENTIONED CASES
 3397: 
 3398: ##### 3.9.3.7 JOHN THE THEOLOGIAN
 3399: 
 3400: ON ONE OF THE WEEKDAYS OF PENTECOST
 3401: Everything - according to the rule of St. George, here on p. 287-289.
 3402: 
 3403: ##### 3.9.3.8 JOHN THE THEOLOGIAN ON THE SUNDAYS OF THE MYRRH-BEARERS, OF THE PARALYTIC, OF THE SAMARITAN WOMAN AND OF THE BLIND MAN
 3404: Everything - according to the rule of St. George, here on p. 284-285.
 3405: 
 3406: ##### 3.9.3.9 JOHN THE THEOLOGIAN
 3407: ON MID-PENTECOST WEDNESDAY OF PENTECOST
 3408: Everything - according to the rule of St. George, here on p. 286-287.
 3409: 
 3410: ##### 3.9.3.10 JOHN THE THEOLOGIAN
 3411: 
 3412: ON WEDNESDAY BEFORE THE ASCENSION WITH THE APODOSIS OF THE RESURRECTION
 3413: 
 3414: AT SMALL VESPERS
 3415: Everything - to the Theologian, only at "Lord, I have cried" and at the Aposticha - Both now: to the Feast, and at the end - Troparion of the Theologian, Glory, and now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Theologian.
 3416: #### 3.9.3.1 AT Great Vespers
 3417: 1.	"Blessed is the man", as usual.
 3418: 
 3419: ##### 3.9.3.1.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Feast and 6 of the Apostle, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast
 3420: 
 3421: ##### 3.9.3.1.2 Prokeimenon of the day and 3 readings of the Apostle
 3422: 
 3423: ##### 3.9.3.1.3 At the Litya: stichera of the Apostle, only Both now: of the Feast
 3424: 
 3425: ##### 3.9.3.1.4 At the Aposticha: Resurrectional stichera, also Resurrectional stichera, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Resurrection and "Christ is risen" once
 3426: 
 3427: ##### 3.9.3.1.5 At the blessing of loaves: Troparion of the Apostle twice and "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos" once
 3428: #### 3.9.3.2 AT Great Matins
 3429: 
 3430: ##### 3.9.3.2.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion twice, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Apostle
 3431: 
 3432: ##### 3.9.3.2.2 After the 1st poetic session: Resurrectional Sessional hymn; after the 2nd - Sessional hymn of the Blind Man; after the Polyeleos with "Great Doxology" - all three sessional hymns of the Apostle; and everything else up to the canon - to the Apostle, only before the 50th Psalm - "Having beheld the Resurrection of Christ" once
 3433: 
 3434: ##### 3.9.3.2.3 Canons 3 making 14: of the Resurrection without Theotokia on 6, of the Apostle on 4 and of the Blind Man on 4. Katavasia sequential[^432]. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion of the Apostle and Hypakoe of the Resurrection, Glory: Sessional hymn of the Apostle, Both now: of the Blind Man; after the 6th - Resurrectional Kontakion-Ikos; at the 9th "More honorable" we do not sing; after the 9th - Resurrectional Exapostilarion, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Blind Man
 3435: 
 3436: ##### 3.9.3.2.4 At "The Praises" stichera of the Apostle on 4, and also Resurrectional stichera, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Resurrection and "Christ is risen" once
 3437: 
 3438: ##### 3.9.3.2.5 After the Great Doxology - Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion according to the tone of the Apostle
 3439: 
 3440: #### 3.9.3.3 AT THE HOURS
 3441: On all: Resurrectional Troparion, Glory: of the Apostle. Kontakion: on the 1st and 6th - of the Resurrection; on the 3rd and 9th - of the Apostle.
 3442: 
 3443: #### 3.9.3.4 AT THE LITURGY
 3444: 
 3445: ##### 3.9.3.4.1 Resurrectional Troparion and of the Apostle, Glory: Kontakion of the Apostle, Both now: of the Resurrection
 3446: 
 3447: ##### 3.9.3.4.2 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn of the Resurrection and of the Apostle. Apostle-Gospel of the day and of the Apostle
 3448: 
 3449: ##### 3.9.3.4.3 JOHN THE THEOLOGIAN ON ASCENSION THURSDAY
 3450: The Service of St. Arsenius is celebrated on another day, at the decision of the Ecclesiarch.
 3451: 
 3452: AT SMALL VESPERS
 3453: 
 3454: ##### 3.9.3.4.4 At "Lord, I have cried": stichera of the Feast, only Doxastikon of the Apostle. At the Aposticha: stichera of the Apostle, only Both now: of the Feast
 3455: 
 3456: ##### 3.9.3.4.5 At the end: Troparion of the Apostle, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3457: #### 3.9.3.5 AT Great Vespers
 3458: 1.	"Blessed is the man", as usual.
 3459: 
 3460: ##### 3.9.3.5.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 6 of the Feast and 4 of the Apostle, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast
 3461: 
 3462: ##### 3.9.3.5.2 Prokeimenon of the day, 3 readings of the Feast and 3 - of the Theologian
 3463: 
 3464: ##### 3.9.3.5.3 At the Litya: stichera of the Feast and of the Apostle, Glory: of the Theologian, Both now: of the Feast
 3465: 
 3466: ##### 3.9.3.5.4 Stichera of the Feast, only Doxastikon of the Apostle
 3467: 
 3468: ##### 3.9.3.5.5 At the blessing of loaves: Troparion of the Feast twice and of the Apostle once
 3469: #### 3.9.3.6 AT Great Matins
 3470: 
 3471: ##### 3.9.3.6.1 At "God is the Lord": Troparion of the Feast twice, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast
 3472: 
 3473: ##### 3.9.3.6.2 Everything else up to the canon - only of the Feast
 3474: 
 3475: ##### 3.9.3.6.3 Canons 3 making 14: of the Feast first with heirmos on 6, of the Apostle on 4 and of the Feast second on 4. Katavasia sequential. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional hymn of the Apostle, Glory, and now: of the Feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Feast; at the 9th "More honorable" we do not sing, but we sing the refrain of the Feast; to the troparia of the Apostle "Holy Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian, pray to God for us"; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the Feast, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast
 3476: 
 3477: ##### 3.9.3.6.4 Stichera of the Praises - 6: 3 of the Feast and 3 of the Apostle, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast
 3478: 
 3479: ##### 3.9.3.6.5 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the Apostle, Glory, and now: of the Feast
 3480: AT THE HOURS: On all - Troparion of the Feast, Glory: of the Theologian. Kontakion: on the 1st and 6th - of the Feast, on the 3rd and 9th - of the Theologian.
 3481: 
 3482: #### 3.9.3.7 AT THE LITURGY
 3483: 
 3484: ##### 3.9.3.7.1 Troparion of the Feast and of the Apostle, Glory: Kontakion of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast
 3485: 
 3486: ##### 3.9.3.7.2 Everything else - first of the Feast, afterwards - of the Apostle
 3487: 
 3488: ##### 3.9.3.7.3 JOHN THE THEOLOGIAN IN THE SUNDAY OF THE HOLY FATHERS
 3489: The Service of the Ascension is not taken, but the Resurrectional, of the Theologian and of the Fathers is sung.
 3490: 
 3491: AT SMALL VESPERS
 3492: 
 3493: ##### 3.9.3.7.4 At "Lord, I have cried" - Resurrectional stichera, as usual, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: Theotokion of the Resurrectional stichera, which is at "Lord, I have cried" of Small Vespers, according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 3494: 
 3495: ##### 3.9.3.7.5 At the Aposticha: Resurrectional stichera, then stichera of the Apostle of Great Vespers with his refrains, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: Theotokion of the Resurrectional Aposticha of Small Vespers, according to the tone of the Doxastikon
 3496: 
 3497: ##### 3.9.3.7.6 Resurrectional Troparion and of the Fathers, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Ascension[^438]
 3498: #### 3.9.3.8 AT Great Vespers
 3499: 
 3500: ##### 3.9.3.8.1 At "Lord, I have cried" - 10 stichera: 3 Resurrectional, 4 of the Fathers and 3 of the Apostle[^433], Glory: of the Fathers, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone
 3501: 
 3502: ##### 3.9.3.8.2 Prokeimenon of the day, 3 readings of the Fathers and 3 - of the Apostle
 3503: 
 3504: ##### 3.9.3.8.3 At the Litya: Doxastikon of the Fathers and stichera of the Apostle, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Ascension
 3505: 
 3506: ##### 3.9.3.8.4 Aposticha Resurrectional, Glory: of the Fathers, Both now: of the Ascension
 3507: 
 3508: ##### 3.9.3.8.5 At the blessing of loaves: Troparion "Rejoice, O Virgin Theotokos" twice and of the Apostle once
 3509: #### 3.9.3.9 AT Great Matins
 3510: 
 3511: ##### 3.9.3.9.1 At "God is the Lord": Resurrectional Troparion once and of the Fathers, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: Resurrectional Theotokion, according to the tone of the Apostle[^434]
 3512: 
 3513: ##### 3.9.3.9.2 Everything else up to the canon - Resurrectional, as usual, only, instead of "The Blameless", there will be Polyeleos with "Great Doxology" and after the Hypakoe - all three Sessional hymns of the Apostle
 3514: 
 3515: ##### 3.9.3.9.3 Canons 3 making 14: Resurrectional with heirmos on 4, of the Apostle on 4 and of the Fathers on 6. Katavasia sequential. After the 3rd ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Apostle and Sessional hymn of the Fathers, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Feast[^435]; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos to the Fathers; after the 9th - "Holy is the Lord our God" and Resurrectional Exapostilarion and of the Fathers, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: Theotokion (of the Resurrectional Exapostilarion)[^436]
 3516: 
 3517: ##### 3.9.3.9.4 Stichera of the Praises - 8: 3 Resurrectional, 2 of the Fathers and 3 of the Apostle with Doxastikon, Glory: of the Fathers, Both now: "Most blessed Art Thou"
 3518: 
 3519: ##### 3.9.3.9.5 After the Great Doxology - Resurrectional Troparion, one of the two usual ones
 3520: 
 3521: ##### 3.9.3.9.6 After the Dismissal of Matins - Glory, and now: Gospel Stichera
 3522: 
 3523: #### 3.9.3.10 AT THE HOURS
 3524: On all: Resurrectional Troparion, then Glory: on the 1st and 6th - of the Fathers; on the 3rd and 9th - to the Apostle[^437]. Kontakion: on the 1st and 6th - of the Fathers; on the 3rd and 9th - to the Apostle.
 3525: 
 3526: #### 3.9.3.11 AT THE LITURGY
 3527: 
 3528: ##### 3.9.3.11.1 Resurrectional Troparion, of the Fathers and of the Apostle; Kontakion of the Fathers, Glory: of the Apostle, Both now: of the Ascension[^438]
 3529: 
 3530: ##### 3.9.3.11.2 Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia and Gospel - first of the Fathers, and then of the Theologian; Communion Hymn "Praise the Lord" and of the Theologian
 3531:  
 3532: ### 3.9.4 May: Translation of the relics of our holy father Nicholas
 3533: and
 3534: ### 3.9.5 May: Holy Apostle Simon
 3535: The Service of St. Nicholas falls from the Saturday before the Sunday of the Paralytic to the Saturday before the Descent, and the service of Simon - from Monday after the Sunday of the Paralytic to the Sunday of the Descent. Can fall:
 3536: 
 3537: ##### 3.9.5.1 On one of the weekdays of Pentecost
 3538: - According to the rule of St. George on p. 287-289.
 3539: 
 3540: ##### 3.9.5.2 On the Sundays of the Myrrh-bearers, of the Paralytic, of the Samaritan Woman and of the Blind Man
 3541: - According to the rule of St. George on p. 284-285.
 3542: 
 3543: ##### 3.9.5.3 On Mid-Pentecost Wednesday of Pentecost
 3544: - According to the rule of St. George on p. 286-287.
 3545: 
 3546: ##### 3.9.5.4 On Wednesday before the Ascension with the Apodosis of the Resurrection
 3547: - According to the rule of the Theologian on p. 293-295.
 3548: 
 3549: ##### 3.9.5.5 On Ascension Thursday
 3550: - According to the rule of the Theologian on p. 295-296.
 3551: 
 3552: ##### 3.9.5.6 On the Sunday of the Holy Fathers
 3553: - According to the rule of the Theologian on p. 296-298.
 3554: 
 3555: ##### 3.9.5.7 On the Saturday of Souls before the Sunday of the Descent
 3556: - Transferred to the previous Thursday.
 3557: 
 3558: ##### 3.9.5.8 On the Sunday of the Descent, only Simon
 3559: - Transferred to the previous Thursday.
