 398: ## 2.14 Afterfeast with a Saint without a Polyeleos on Weekdays and Saturday
 399: AT VESPERS
 400: ##### 2.14.1 Kathisma current
 401: ##### 2.14.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 6 stichera, that is: 3 of the feast and 3 to the saint, Glory, Both now: to the feast, or Glory: to the saint, if he has, Both now: of the feast
 402:   * **If two saints occur**, then there will be to the first - 3 and to the second - 3, Glory, Both now: of the feast.
 403:   * **If a saint on 6 occurs**, then the stichera to him will be only 3[^203], as also to the saint on 4.
 404: On Friday evening for Saturday - 1st Theotokion of the tone, which is being taken leave of (Dogmatikon)[^204].
 405: ##### 2.14.3 On the Aposticha: stichera of the feast, Glory: to the saint, if there be, Both now: of the feast, if - not, then Glory, Both now: of the feast
 406: ##### 2.14.4 At the end: Troparion to the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 407:   * **If two saints occur**, then the troparion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast.
 408: ##### 2.14.5 Dismissal medium with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint, without commemoration of the service of the weekday, because it is not taken
 409: #### 2.14.1 AT COMPLINE
 410: Canon of the Most Holy Theotokos, according to the sequence of the *Octoechos*. After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the feast alone.
 411: AT THE Midnight Office: Everything exactly so, as in the *Horologion*.
 412: AT MATINS
 413: ##### 2.14.1.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion of the feast twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast
 414:   * **If two saints occur**, then the troparion of the feast once and of the first saint once, Glory: of the second, Both now: again of the feast.
 415: ##### 2.14.1.2 Kathismata two current with Sessional Hymns of the feast
 416: ##### 2.14.1.3 Canons 2 on 12, that is: of the feast with Heirmos on 8 and of the saint on 4. Katavasia after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th Ode - Heirmos of the last canon, that is of the saint. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional Hymn of the saint; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the saint twice, Glory, Both now: of the feast[^205]
 417:   * **If two saints occur**, then 3 canons on 14, that is: Canon of the feast with Heirmos on 6, to the first saint on 4 and to the second on 4. Katavasia after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th Ode - Heirmos of the last canon, that is of the second saint. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the first and of the second saint, also Sessional Hymn of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast.
 418:   * **If a saint on 6 occurs**, then the Canon of the feast with Heirmos on 6 and to the saint on 6[^206], everything else, as above with one saint.
 419: ##### 2.14.1.4 On the Aposticha: stichera of the feast, Glory: to the saint, if there be, Both now: of the feast, if - not, then Glory, Both now: of the feast
 420:   * If the saint on 6 will have Praises stichera with the Small Doxology, then they are taken on 4 and Glory: his, and Both now: of the feast. After the Litany "Let us complete" will be on the Aposticha stichera of the feast, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast[^207]. If this saint will have also the Great Doxology, then the Praises stichera are taken: of the feast - 3 and to the saint - 3, Glory: to the saint, and Both now: of the feast. And after the Doxology with the Trisagion - his Troparion, Glory, Both now: of the feast, and everything else, as at Great Matins.
 421: ##### 2.14.1.5 At the end: Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 422:   * If there be two saints, then the troparion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast.
 423: #### 2.14.2 AT THE HOURS
 424: At all: Troparion of the feast, Glory: at the 3rd and 9th - also to the saint. Kontakia - alternating, that is: at the 1st and 6th - of the feast, at the 3rd and 9th - to the saint.
 425:   * If two saints, then Glory: at the 3rd - to the first, and at the 9th - to the second saint. Kontakia: at the 3rd - to the first, at the 9th - to the second saint[^208].
 426: #### 2.14.3 AT THE LITURGY
 427: ##### 2.14.3.1 Antiphons in the Afterfeast of the Lord we take: two first - from the feast itself, third - general with the refrain of the feast, also and "Come, let us worship"; in the Afterfeast of the Theotokos antiphons so, as also on all days
 428: ##### 2.14.3.2 At the Entrance - Troparion, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the feast, Trisagion
 429: ##### 2.14.3.3 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - of the feast, Apostle and Gospel - of the day. Instead of *“It is truly meet”* - Heirmos of the 9th Ode of the Canon of the feast with its refrain. Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint[^209]

Sometimes these two Sessional Hymns will be only of the feast (January 11 and May 9)[^220]; third Kathisma, Polyeleos with Magnifications, also Sessional Hymn of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast

 476: ##### 2.16.3.5 Praises stichera sometimes - 4, all to the saint[^222], sometimes - 6, that is: 3 of the feast and 3 to the saint, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast
 477: ##### 2.16.3.6 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast

 502: ## 2.19 Apodosis of a Feast on a Sunday
 503: Notes
 504: ##### 2.19.1 The service of the current saint, which falls on the Apodosis of the feast, is transferred to the immediately preceding[^228] or following day[^229], sometimes also to another day, if it will not be occupied by two saints or one with a Polyeleos; sometimes it is limited to the canon at Compline after the Canon of the Theotokos
 505: ##### 2.19.2 The service of the feast on the Apodosis, from Vespers to the Canon of Matins has only the daily form, from the Canon to the end of Matins - the great form. If the Apodosis falls on a Sunday, then Vespers and Matins are great, in view of the Sunday service
 506: #### 2.19.1 AT Great Vespers
 507: ##### 2.19.1.1 Kathisma *“Blessed is the man”
 508: ##### 2.19.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 10 stichera, that is: 4 Sunday from the *Octoechos* and 6 of the feast, Glory: of the feast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone (Dogmatikon)
 509: ##### 2.19.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day *“The Lord is King”
 510: ##### 2.19.1.4 Aposticha Sunday, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 511: ##### 2.19.1.5 At the end: Sunday Troparion of the tone, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 512: 6.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration Sunday and of the saint, whose day it is[^230].
 513: #### 2.19.2 AT COMPLINE
 514: Canon of the Theotokos, which is of the sequence of the *Octoechos*. After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the feast one[^231].
 515: AT THE Midnight Office
 516: Trinitarian Canon of the *Octoechos*, as usual. On the Apodosis of Mid-Pentecost and of the Resurrection, after the 1st Trisagion, - Troparion of the feast, after the 2nd - Kontakion of the feast; prayers "Remember" we do not say.
 517: #### 2.19.3 AT Great Matins
 518: ##### 2.19.3.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 519: ##### 2.19.3.2 Everything else up to the canon - Sunday, as usual
 520: ##### 2.19.3.3 Canons 3 or 4 on 14, that is: first - from the *Octoechos* Sunday with Heirmos on 4, second - from the *Octoechos* of the Theotokos on 2 and of the feast - one or two on 8. Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional Hymn of the feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos Sunday[^232]; at the 9th - *“More honorable”* with refrains of the feast to the troparion of the canon of the feast; at the 9th - Sunday Exapostilarion current; Glory, Both now: of the feast
 521: ##### 2.19.3.4 Praises stichera - 8, that is: 4 Sunday of the *Octoechos* and 4 of the feast with "Glory"[^233] and with two refrains of the feast; Glory: Gospel Sticheron, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"
 522: ##### 2.19.3.5 After the Great Doxology - Sunday Troparion, one of two usual ones
 523: 6.	the Great Dismissal with commemoration, as at Vespers.
 524: #### 2.19.4 AT THE HOURS
 525: At all: Sunday Troparion, Glory: of the feast; Kontakia - alternating, that is at the 1st and 6th - Sunday, at the 3rd and 9th - of the feast[^234].
 526: #### 2.19.5 AT THE LITURGY
 527: ##### 2.19.5.1 First two Antiphons, if the feast is of the Lord - of the feast, third - usual with the refrain of the feast; also and "Come, let us worship". If the feast is of the Theotokos, antiphons - Sunday, as here usual, on all Sundays; sometimes "It is good" with the Sunday refrain
 528: ##### 2.19.5.2 At the Entrance - Sunday Troparion and of the feast, Glory: Sunday Kontakion, Both now: of the feast[^235]
 529: ##### 2.19.5.3 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn of the Sunday and of the feast. Apostle and Gospel on the Apodosis of the Lord - only Sunday[^236], on the Apodosis of the Theotokos - first of the Sunday, and then - of the feast[^237]

 531: AT VESPERS
 532: ##### 2.20.1 Kathisma current
 533: ##### 2.20.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 6 stichera: all - to the feast; Glory, Both now: of the feast

 161: If you take the service of the day and to the saint, then the service to the saint precedes the service of the day, with the exception of the Apostle-Gospel, which is taken first of the day, then of the saint; and there will be the troparion to the saint and of the day, Glory: Kontakion to the saint, Both now: Kontakion of the day. Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - to the saint, then of the day. Apostle-Gospel of the day and to the saint[^115].

 164: ## 2.4 Saint with Polyeleos on a Sunday
 165: A Polyeleos Saint can be either on 6, or on 8[^116], although in today's Slavonic books a Polyeleos saint on 6 is rarely encountered, but on 8[^117].
 166: #### 2.4.1 AT Great Vespers
 167: ##### 2.4.1.1 Kathisma *“Blessed is the man”* (according to the previous typikon - whole)

 169: ##### 2.4.1.3 Great Prokeimenon of the day *“The Lord is King”* and 3 readings to the saint
 170: ##### 2.4.1.4 On the Aposticha: stichera of the Sunday *Octoechos*, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday Aposticha in the tone of the Doxastikon[^118]
 171: ##### 2.4.1.5 At the end: Sunday Troparion, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Sunday Theotokion in the tone of the saint's troparion[^119]
 172: 6.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of the Sunday and of the saint.
 173: #### 2.4.2 AT COMPLINE
 174: Troparion Canon of the *Octoechos* of the current tone. After the Trisagion - Kontakion to the saint alone[^120].
 175: #### 2.4.3 AT Great Matins
 176: ##### 2.4.3.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion of the tone twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Sunday Theotokion in the tone of the saint's troparion[^121]
 177: ##### 2.4.3.2 Kathismata - two first current with their usual Sunday Sessional Hymns of the *Octoechos*, also Polyeleos with Magnifications of the saint and "The Angelic Host", Small Litany with the exclamation "For blessed is" and Hypakoe of the tone, also 1st and 2nd Sessional Hymn of the saint once without Theotokia, Glory: 3rd Sessional Hymn of the saint, Both now: his Theotokion[^122]. (Mark in chapter 65 prescribes 1st Theotokion of the tone)
 178: ##### 2.4.3.3 Gradual of the current tone and everything else up to the canon - of the Sunday
 179: ##### 2.4.3.4 Canons 3 on 14. If a saint on 8 is celebrated, then there will be the Sunday Canon of the *Octoechos* with the Heirmos on 4 and of the Theotokos on 2[^123], and of the saint on 8[^124]; if he is celebrated on 6, then there will be the Sunday Canon with the Heirmos on 4 and of the Theotokos on 4, and to the saint on 6[^125].  181: ##### 2.4.3.5 Praises stichera - 8: of the Sunday *Octoechos* of the current tone - 4 and of the saint with "Glory" - 4, with two of his refrains[^128], given on the Vespers Aposticha. Glory: Gospel sticheron sequential, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"
 182: ##### 2.4.3.6 After the Great Doxology - Sunday Troparion, one of the two usual ones, that is in an odd tone - *“Today salvation has come to the world”*; in an even tone - *“Having risen from the tomb”
 183: 7.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of the Sunday service and of the saint.

 186: #### 2.4.5 AT THE LITURGY
 187: ##### 2.4.5.1 Sunday Troparion and of the saint; also Sunday Kontakion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: Theotokion or one of the feasts of the Theotokos in the tone of the Doxastikon, or another, as we gave in the first case on page 53
 188: ##### 2.4.5.2 Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel and Communion Hymn - first of the Sunday, and after - to the saint

 191: ## 2.5 Saint with Polyeleos on Weekdays and Saturday
 192: Note: The *Octoechos* is not used.
 193: #### 2.5.1 AT Great Vespers
 194: ##### 2.5.1.1 Kathisma *“Blessed is the man”* (according to the Typikon - only the 1st antiphon)
 195: ##### 2.5.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 6 stichera[^130] or 8[^131], all to the saint. Glory: to the saint, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone, in view of its Apodosis. Prokeimenon of the day from the *Horologion* and three readings to the saint
 196: ##### 2.5.1.3 Aposticha whole to the saint, with his refrains. To the Doxastikon of the saint the Theotokion is selected from the Sunday Aposticha in the tone of the Doxastikon[^132]
 197: ##### 2.5.1.4 At the end: Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday ones in the tone of the saint's troparion[^133]
 198: 5.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration only of the service of the saint, but of the day - never, because in this case the service of the *Octoechos* is not taken.
 199: #### 2.5.2 AT COMPLINE
 200: Canon of the Theotokos from the *Octoechos* of the current tone[^134]. After *“It is truly meet”* with the Trisagion - Kontakion to the saint alone[^135].
 201: #### 2.5.3 AT Great Matins
 202: ##### 2.5.3.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion to the saint twice, Glory, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday ones, in the tone of the saint's troparion
 203: ##### 2.5.3.2 Kathismata - two current with Sessional Hymns of the saint, also Kathisma 19, that is Polyeleos with Magnifications and the Post-Polyeleos Sessional Hymn of the saint
 204: ##### 2.5.3.3 Gradual of Tone 4, first antiphon
 205: ##### 2.5.3.4 Prokeimenon, Gospel and Sticheron to the saint
 206:   * The Typikon of the Pochaiv *Anthologion*, instead of "Through the prayers of the holy Apostles" gives: "Through the prayers of the saint (name), whose memory is celebrated (See the service of a prophet). So gives also the Greek-Venetian *Menaion* (See e. g. January 11, 25, 27, 30). However, general editions do not give this.
 207: ##### 2.5.3.5 Canons two: 1st - of the Theotokos, one of the two usual ones ("Having traversed the moisture", Tone 2 of Sunday Matins, or "Having crossed the water", Tone 8 of Compline on Tuesday) with the Heirmos on 6, then to the saint one or two canons on 8[^136]
 208:   * On Saturday, if the temple is of the Lord or of the Theotokos, the canon of the temple is taken with the Heirmos on 6, Heirmos - twice, and to the saint on 8[^137].
 209: Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd Ode - Sessional Hymn of the saint, after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the saint, after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the saint.
 210: ##### 2.5.3.6 Praises stichera - 4 to the saint, Glory: his Doxastikon, Both now: Theotokion, which is after the Doxastikon of the saint
 211: ##### 2.5.3.7 After the Great Doxology with the Trisagion - Troparion to the saint, Glory, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday ones in the tone of the saint's troparion
 212: 8.	the Great Dismissal, as at Vespers.
 213: AT THE HOURS: At all hours: Troparion and Kontakion of the saint.
 214: AT THE LITURGY: Everything - only to the saint. Apostle and Gospel first - of the day, then - to the saint.
 215: ## 2.6 Saint with an All-Night Vigil on a Sunday
 216: AT SMALL VESPERS
 217: ##### 2.6.1 On *“Lord, I have cried”*: stichera - 4, all Sunday of the current tone of the *Octoechos*; also Glory: sticheron to the saint, Both now: Theotokion of the tone of Small Vespers[^138] that is 1st Theotokion of the tone[^139], which is called Dogmatikon[^140]
 218: ##### 2.6.2 On the Aposticha stichera - 4, that is: one Sunday, which is in the first place in the *Octoechos* of the current tone and 3 to the saint with two of his refrains, which are on the Aposticha of Great Vespers[^141], also Glory: to the saint from his Small Vespers, Both now: Theotokion from the Aposticha of Small Vespers[^142]
 219: ##### 2.6.3 At the end: Sunday Troparion, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday ones in the tone of the saint's troparion
 220: ##### 2.6.4 Dismissal with the commemoration of the Sunday and of the saint
 221: #### 2.6.1 AT Great Vespers
 222: ##### 2.6.1.1 Kathisma 1 *“Blessed is the man”* (according to the Typikon - whole, according to our custom today - only certain selected verses)
 223: ##### 2.6.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* stichera - 10, that is 4 from the *Octoechos* and 6 to the saint, Glory: to the saint, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone
 224: ##### 2.6.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day from the *Horologion* and 3 readings to the saint
 225: ##### 2.6.1.4 On the Litiya: according to the Slavonic Typikon, first sticheron - of the temple (which today we usually do not take), also stichera to the saint. Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday Aposticha of Great Vespers, in the tone of the Doxastikon[^153][^144][^143]
 226: ##### 2.6.1.5 On the Aposticha: stichera of the Sunday tone, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday Aposticha of Great Vespers, in the tone of the Doxastikon
 227: ##### 2.6.1.6 At the Blessing of Loaves: Troparion "O Virgin Theotokos" twice and to the saint once[^227][^145]
 228: #### 2.6.2 AT Great Matins
 229: ##### 2.6.2.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday ones in the tone of the saint's troparion
 230: ##### 2.6.2.2 Two current kathismata with their Sunday Sessional Hymns of the *Octoechos*; also Kathisma 19 (Polyeleos) with Magnifications and "The Angelic Host", and Hypakoe of the tone, and immediately all three Sessional Hymns of the saint, that is 1st and 2nd without Theotokion, then Glory: 2nd Sessional Hymn, which is called the Polyeleos one, Both now: its Theotokion[^147]
 231: ##### 2.6.2.3 Gradual, Prokeimenon, Gospel and Sticheron, all only Resurrection Sunday
 232:   * During the singing of the canon, by our custom, the Priest anoints the people with oil blessed at Vespers.
 233: ##### 2.6.2.4 Canons three or four on 14, namely: Sunday with Heirmos on 4 and of the Theotokos on 2, and to the saint on 8, there will be two or only one canon; for usually the saint has two canons[^148]
 234: Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos, and Sessional Hymn to the saint. After the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos Sunday, after the 9th - Sunday Exapostilarion, Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion of the Sunday Exapostilarion
 235: Everything else at Matins, at the Hours and at the Liturgy so, as with a Polyeleos saint, here on page 73.

 237: ## 2.7 Saint with an All-Night Vigil on Weekdays and Saturday
 238: AT SMALL VESPERS
 239: ##### 2.7.1 On *“Lord, I have cried”* and on the Aposticha all stichera - to the saint, on the Aposticha there will be separate refrains to the saint. Only regarding the Theotokia on *“Lord, I have cried”* and on the Aposticha let it be known, that they sometimes will be special[^150], sometimes only general, designated only by the first words; sometimes even without indication of the first words. And in this last case, we think that they should be selected from the *Octoechos* on Daily Vespers in the tone of the Doxastikon and of the day of the week, which are given at the end of every volume of the *Menaion* and of the Lviv *Anthologion*; if - not, then in the tone of one of the three Doxastika, given at the end of the Pochaiv *Anthologion*[^151]
 240: ##### 2.7.2 At the end: Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: Theotokion from the Sunday ones in the tone of the saint's troparion
 241: #### 2.7.1 AT Great Vespers
 242: 1.	*“Blessed is the man”* (according to the Typikon - only the 1st antiphon).
 243: ##### 2.7.1.1 On *“Lord, I have cried”*: stichera of the saint on 8, Glory: His Doxastikon, Both now: 1st Theotokion (Dogmatikon), in the tone of the Doxastikon; on Friday for Saturday - Dogmatikon of the current tone[^152], in view of the Apodosis of the tone
 244: ##### 2.7.1.2 Prokeimenon of the day from the *Horologion* and 3 readings to the saint
 245: ##### 2.7.1.3 On the Litiya: first sticheron - of the temple, which today we usually do not take, all the rest - to the saint and Glory: to the saint, Both now: Theotokion or special, if there be, or general from the Aposticha of Sunday Great Vespers, in the tone of the Doxastikon[^153]
 246: ##### 2.7.1.4 On the Aposticha all stichera - to the saint, with his two refrains; Theotokion to the Doxastikon, if there be no special one, is taken from the Sunday Aposticha in the tone of the Doxastikon[^154]
 247: ##### 2.7.1.5 At the Blessing of Loaves: Troparion of the saint twice and "O Virgin Theotokos" once
 248: AT Great Matins, AT THE HOURS AND AT THE LITURGY
 249: Everything so, as in the case of a Polyeleos saint without All-Night (see page 75-76); only Matins begins from "Glory to the Holy", and there will be anointing with oil during the canon, according to custom.
 250: Note
 251: Three feasts, namely: The Nativity and Beheading of St. John the Baptist on June 24 and August 29 and of the Chief Apostles Peter and Paul on June 29 surpass other saints with All-Night Vigil in that at Matins their canons are taken alone, without the Theotokion canon, and at the Liturgy their Apostle-Gospels are taken alone[^155], without the daily ones, which are read on the previous day under the refrain, except for Sundays, for these always precede. According to today's general custom, except for cathedral churches, on other saints too the daily Apostle-Gospels are not read. To these three feasts the Moscow Typikon adds also the feast of John the Theologian and the Feast of the temple[^156].
 252: CASES OF FEASTS
 253: ## 2.8 Forefeast with a Saint without a Polyeleos on a Sunday
 254: Note: If two saints with a Forefeast fall on a Sunday, then the service of the first (second) is transferred to another day, according to the decision of the Ecclesiarch[^157].
 255: #### 2.8.1 AT Great Vespers
 256: 1.	*“Blessed is the man”* (according to the Typikon - all three antiphons).
 257: ##### 2.8.1.1 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 10 stichera, that is: of the *Octoechos* of the current tone - 4, of the Forefeast - 3 and to the saint - 3. Glory: of the Forefeast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone. If there be a Doxastikon to the saint, then having discarded the Doxastikon of the Forefeast, Glory: Doxastikon to the saint is taken, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone[^158]
 258:   * **If the saint be on 6**, then there will be of the Sunday - 3, of the Forefeast - 3 and to the saint - 4, Glory: to the saint, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone[^159].
 259: ##### 2.8.1.2 On the Aposticha: stichera Sunday, Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast. If there be a Doxastikon to the saint, then after it at "Both now" is taken of the Forefeast
 260: ##### 2.8.1.3 At the end: Sunday Troparion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the Forefeast
 261: 5.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of the Sunday service and of the saint[^160].
 262: AT COMPLINE: After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the Forefeast alone[^161].
 263: AT THE Midnight Office: Trinitarian Canon of the current tone and everything else, as usual.
 264: #### 2.8.2 AT Great Matins
 265: ##### 2.8.2.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the Forefeast
 266: ##### 2.8.2.2 Everything else up to the canon - Sunday, as usual
 267: ##### 2.8.2.3 Canons 4 on 14, that is: first - Sunday of the *Octoechos* with Heirmos on 4 and second - of the *Octoechos* of the Theotokos on 2, also of the Forefeast on 4 and of the saint on 4[^162]. (If the saint - on 6, then here is taken only on 4). Katavasia after every Ode - current. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast and of the saint, Glory: Sessional Hymn of the saint, Both now: of the Forefeast. After the 6th Ode - Kontakion-Ikos Sunday. After the 9th - "Holy is the Lord our God" thrice and Sunday Exapostilarion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the Forefeast[^163]
 268: ##### 2.8.2.4 Praises stichera - 8, that is: of the *Octoechos* - 4 and to the saint - 4, if he has, with two separate refrains of his; if the saint does not have, then of the feast on 4 (from the Aposticha with their refrains); also Glory: sticheron of the feast, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"[^164]
 269: ##### 2.8.2.5 After the Doxology - Sunday Troparion, one of two usual ones
 270: 6.	the Great Dismissal, as at Vespers.
 271: #### 2.8.3 AT THE HOURS
 272: At all: Sunday Troparion, also Glory: at the 1st and 3rd - also of the Forefeast, at the 6th and 9th - also to the saint. Kontakion, Sunday and of the feast, we say alternatingly, that is at the 1st and at the 6th - of the Forefeast, and at the 3rd and 9th - Sunday[^165].
 273: #### 2.8.4 AT THE LITURGY
 274: All service - only of the Sunday, except Troparia, for they are taken also of the Forefeast with the Sunday ones, that is Sunday and of the Forefeast, Glory: Sunday Kontakion, Both now: of the Forefeast[^166].

 277: ## 2.9 Forefeast with a Saint without a Polyeleos on Weekdays and Saturday
 278: Notes
 279: ##### 2.9.1 Beginning from the very Forefeast until the Apodosis of the feast, the service of the *Octoechos*, with the exception of Sunday, is not taken and, instead of it, the service of the feast is taken in the first place, likewise also on Saturday; it is combined together with the service of the current saint, except for the Apodosis, for then the service of the saint is transferred to another day. Only at Compline is the Canon of the Theotokos of the *Octoechos* taken
 280: ##### 2.9.2 The Divine Service is celebrated in a lesser form, that is Vespers and Matins - daily
 281: ##### 2.9.3 The sequence of stichera and troparia does not end with usual *Octoechos* Theotokia, but festal ones; with the exception of Friday evening for Saturday, in view of the Apodosis of the tone, usually the 1st Theotokion of the tone is taken
 282: AT VESPERS
 283: ##### 2.9.4 Kathisma current
 284: ##### 2.9.5 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 6 stichera, that is: of the Forefeast - 3 and to the saint - 3, Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast, or Glory: to the saint, if he has, Both now: of the Forefeast
 285:   * **If two saints occur**, then there will be to the first - 3, to the second - 3, also Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast. Stichera of the Forefeast then are none[^167].
 286:   * **If a saint on 6 occurs**, then also there will be stichera of the Forefeast - 3 and to the saint - 3, as with a saint on 4[^168].
 287: On Friday evening for Saturday: Dogmatikon of the tone, which is being taken leave of.
 288: ##### 2.9.6 On the Aposticha: stichera of the Forefeast; if Glory be to the saint, then Both now: of the Forefeast
 289: ##### 2.9.7 At the end: Troparion to the saint, Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 290:   * **If two saints occur**, then first the troparion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the Forefeast.
 291: ##### 2.9.8 Dismissal medium with the commemoration of the service of the day and of the saint[^169]
 292: #### 2.9.1 AT COMPLINE
 293: Canon of the Theotokos of the current week in the *Octoechos*. After *“It is truly meet”* with the Trisagion - Kontakion of the Forefeast alone[^170].
 294: AT THE Midnight Office: Everything exactly so, as in the *Horologion*, to the saint - nothing.
 295: AT MATINS
 296: ##### 2.9.1.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion of the Forefeast twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the Forefeast
 297:   * **If two saints occur**, then there will be the Troparion of the Forefeast once, also to the first saint once, Glory: to the second once, Both now: of the Forefeast[^171].
 298: ##### 2.9.1.2 Kathismata two current with Sessional Hymns of the Forefeast
 299: ##### 2.9.1.3 Canons 2 on 12, that is: of the Forefeast with Heirmos on 8 and of the saint on 4[^172]. Katavasia after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th Ode - Heirmos of the last canon, that is of the saint[^173]. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional Hymn of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast, after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast, after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the saint, if the saint has one, if - not, then only of the Forefeast (December 29, January 2), Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast[^174]
 300:   * **If two saints occur**, then there will be 3 canons on 14, that is: of the Forefeast with Heirmos on 6, also of the first saint on 4[^175] and of the second on 4. Katavasia - after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th Ode - Heirmos of the last canon, that is of the second saint[^176]. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the first and second saint[^177], also Sessional Hymn of the first, Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the Forefeast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, if he has, Both now: of the Forefeast (e. g. November 2).
 301:   * **If the saint be on 6**, then the Canon of the Forefeast on 6 and to the saint on 6 (December 20)[^178].
 302: ##### 2.9.1.4 On the Aposticha: stichera of the Forefeast, Glory: to the saint, if he has, Both now: of the Forefeast, if - not, then Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 303: ##### 2.9.1.5 At the end: Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the Forefeast
 304:   * If there be two saints, then the troparion of the first, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the Forefeast.
 305: #### 2.9.2 AT THE HOURS
 306: At all: Troparion of the Forefeast, also at the 3rd and 9th also Glory: to the saint, Kontakia - alternating, that is: at the 1st and 6th - of the Forefeast, at the 3rd and 9th - to the saint.
 307:   * If there be two saints, then at the 3rd after Glory - Troparion to the first saint, and at the 9th - to the second; Kontakia: at the 3rd - to the first, at the 9th - to the second saint[^179].
 308: #### 2.9.3 AT THE LITURGY
 309: By our custom today: Troparion, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the Forefeast, everything else - of the day[^180].
 310: ## 2.10 Feast of the Lord on a Sunday and Weekdays
 311: All service - only of the feast, of the great type with All-Night Vigil.
 312: AT SMALL VESPERS
 313: On *“Lord, I have cried”*: stichera of the feast on 4 and Aposticha of the feast with two refrains of the feast, and At the end - Troparion of the feast one.
 314: #### 2.10.1 AT Great Vespers
 315: ##### 2.10.1.1 Kathismata usually none; only on Saturday for Sunday - Kathisma *“Blessed is the man”*, according to the Typikon - all three antiphons; on Sunday for Monday - only the first antiphon
 316: ##### 2.10.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”*: stichera of the feast on 8
 317: ##### 2.10.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day; only, if the feast falls on a Saturday, then, instead of the daily Prokeimenon, the Great Prokeimenon of the feast is taken, given on Vespers of the next day. In this case, Vespers of the next day will be on Saturday for Sunday, which has the Great Prokeimenon *“The Lord is King”*, which does not yield to the Prokeimenon of the feast. This Vespers, therefore, is already not of the feast itself, but of the Afterfeast and therefore it cannot exclude the Sunday service, which occupies the first place. In order not to discard the Prokeimenon of the feast, it is taken before that on Great Vespers of the feast itself, namely on Friday[^181]
 318: ##### 2.10.1.4 Three readings of the feast
 319: ##### 2.10.1.5 On the Litiya and on the Aposticha - stichera of the feast
 320: ##### 2.10.1.6 At the Blessing of Loaves - Troparion of the feast thrice
 321: #### 2.10.2 AT Great Matins
 322: ##### 2.10.2.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion of the feast twice, Glory, Both now: once more
 323: ##### 2.10.2.2 Kathismata two current with Sessional Hymns of the feast, also Kathisma 19 (Polyeleos) and Magnifications, and the Post-Polyeleos Sessional Hymn of the feast
 324: ##### 2.10.2.3 Gradual of Tone 4, 1st antiphon. Prokeimenon, Gospel and Sticheron of the feast
 325: ##### 2.10.2.4 Canons one or two. Troparia on 12, Heirmoi - twice. Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd Ode - Sessional Hymn, after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos, after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the feast. At the 9th Ode *“More honorable”* is not sung, but festal refrains to the Heirmoi and Troparia of the canon
 326: ##### 2.10.2.5 Praises stichera of the feast - 4, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 327: ##### 2.10.2.6 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the feast
 328: 7.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast.
 329: AT THE HOURS: At all hours - Troparion and Kontakion of the feast. Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast.
 330: #### 2.10.3 AT THE LITURGY
 331: Antiphons, Entrance and everything else - to the feast[^182]. Instead of the Trisagion, on the Exaltation of the Holy Cross and on the Sunday of the Adoration of the Cross we sing "Before Thy Cross"; on the Nativity of Christ, on Theophany, on Lazarus Saturday, on Great Saturday, during Bright Week and on Pentecost Sunday is sung "As many as have been baptized into Christ"[^183]. Instead of *“It is truly meet”*, according to our later Typikon, is taken the Heirmos of the 9th Ode of the Festal Canon with the festal refrain.
 332: 
 333: 
 334: ## 2.11 Feast of the Theotokos on a Sunday
 335: The service of the feast is combined with the Sunday *Octoechos*, which takes the first place.
 336: AT SMALL VESPERS
 337: ##### 2.11.1 On *“Lord, I have cried”*: 4 Sunday stichera of the current tone, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 338: ##### 2.11.2 On the Aposticha: one Sunday sticheron of the current tone, which is in the first place, also 3 stichera of the feast from the Aposticha of Great Vespers with their refrains[^184]; Glory, Both now: of the feast, from Small Vespers[^185]
 339: ##### 2.11.3 At the end: Sunday Troparion; Glory, Both now: of the feast
 340: ##### 2.11.4 Dismissal small with the commemoration Sunday and festal
 341: #### 2.11.1 AT Great Vespers
 342: ##### 2.11.1.1 Kathisma 1 (*“Blessed is the man”*), according to the Typikon - all three antiphons, by our custom today - only selected verses
 343: ##### 2.11.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 10 stichera, namely: of the Sunday *Octoechos* - 4, which is in the first place, also of the feast - 6, Glory, Both now: of the feast[^186]
 344: ##### 2.11.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day from the *Horologion
 345: ##### 2.11.1.4 Three readings of the feast
 346: ##### 2.11.1.5 On the Litiya all stichera - of the feast
 347: ##### 2.11.1.6 On the Aposticha: stichera Sunday, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 348: ##### 2.11.1.7 At the Blessing of Loaves: Troparion of the feast thrice
 349: #### 2.11.2 AT Great Matins
 350: ##### 2.11.2.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 351: ##### 2.11.2.2 Kathismata two current with Sunday Sessional Hymns and with their Theotokia, also Polyeleos with Magnifications, "The Angelic Host" and Hypakoe of the tone. All three Sessional Hymns of the feast, that is: 1st Sessional Hymn once, 2nd Sessional Hymn once, then Glory, Both now: 3rd Sessional Hymn, if it is double, then there will be Glory: first, Both now: second[^187]
 352: ##### 2.11.2.3 Gradual of the current tone, afterwards - "Resurrection of Christ"; everything else up to the canon - to the feast[^188]
 353: ##### 2.11.2.4 Canons 3 on 14, that is: Sunday from the *Octoechos*, with Heirmos on 4, Theotokion from the *Octoechos*, without Heirmos, on 2 and both canons of the feast, without Heirmos, on 8; if to the saint there be only one, then one is taken on 8[^189]. Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd Ode - Sunday Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional Hymn of the feast (on the Dormition of the Most Holy Theotokos, instead of the Sessional Hymn, - Hypakoe of the feast); after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast, after the 9th - Sunday Exapostilarion sequential, one of 11, then Glory, Both now: of the feast. At the 9th Ode - *“More honorable”*, festal refrains, according to the Typikon, are not taken; however, we think, that it would be better to coordinate the festal refrains with the troparion of the canon of the feast, than with the general refrain "Most Holy Theotokos, save us"[^190]
 354: ##### 2.11.2.5 Praises stichera - 8, that is: 4 Sunday and 4 of the feast with two festal refrains; Glory: of the feast, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"
 355: ##### 2.11.2.6 After the Great Doxology with the Trisagion - Sunday Troparion, one of two usual ones
 356: 7.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration Sunday and of the feast.
 357: ##### 2.11.2.7 Glory, Both now: Gospel Sticheron
 358: #### 2.11.3 AT THE HOURS
 359: At all: Sunday Troparion, Glory, Both now: of the feast. Kontakia - alternating, that is at the 1st and 6th - Sunday, at the 3rd and 9th - of the feast[^191].
 360: #### 2.11.4 AT THE LITURGY
 361: Antiphons Sunday. On "Come, let us worship", if you wish, to "Save us, O Son of God" add the refrain: "Through the prayers of the Theotokos, who sing to Thee, Alleluia"[^192]. Sunday Troparion and of the feast, Glory: Sunday Kontakion, Both now: Kontakion of the feast. Trisagion, Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel and Communion Hymn - first of the Sunday, afterwards - of the feast. Instead of *“It is truly meet”*, according to our later Slavonic custom, we sing the Heirmos of the 9th Ode of the festal canon (with its refrain)[^193].
 362: ________________________________________
 363: ## 2.12 Feast of the Theotokos on Weekdays
 364: Everything - according to the Typikon of a Feast of the Lord (see page 87-89), except for the Antiphons, which will be daily, and the Entrance, which will be "Come, let us worship", and the Trisagion, which always is on Theotokion feasts.
 365: 
 366: Note about the Afterfeast
 367: Everything is performed according to the Typikon of the Forefeast, given here before on page 81-83. However, in the Afterfeast there will be:
 368: ##### 2.12.1 Troparion and Kontakion of the feast itself
 369: ##### 2.12.2 At the Dismissal is commemorated also the service of the feast
 370: ##### 2.12.3 At the Liturgy, in the Afterfeast of the Lord, first two antiphons - of the feast[^194], third - usual with the refrain of the feast, also and the usual Entrance "Come, let us worship" with the same refrain of the feast[^195]
 371: ##### 2.12.4 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn on Sunday - of the day (that is of the Sunday) and of the feast, on weekdays - only of the feast; Apostle and Gospel - of the day[^196]. When on Sunday the service of a saint is also taken, then the Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn of the feast are discarded, and only of the Sunday and of the saint are taken. On weekdays, if the service of a saint is combined with the festal service, then all this is taken in the first place - to the feast, afterwards - to the saint. But because among us to a saint without Polyeleos at the Liturgy usually nothing is taken, all this is taken only to the feast
 372: ##### 2.12.5 Instead of *“It is truly meet”* - Heirmos of the 9th Ode of the canon of the feast. However, we will present separate and full models
 373: ________________________________________
 374: ## 2.13 Afterfeast with a Saint without a Polyeleos on a Sunday
 375: Note: If two saints fall on a Sunday, then the service of the second saint is transferred to another day, according to the decision of the Ecclesiarch.
 376: #### 2.13.1 AT Great Vespers
 377: ##### 2.13.1.1 Kathisma usual *“Blessed is the man”* (according to the Typikon - all three antiphons)
 378: ##### 2.13.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 10 stichera, that is: 4 from the *Octoechos* of the current tone, 3 of the Afterfeast and 3 to the saint, Glory: of the Afterfeast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone. If there be a Doxastikon to the saint, then, having discarded the Doxastikon of the feast, the Doxastikon to Him is taken, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone
 379:   * If the saint falls on 6, then there will be stichera of the Sunday - 3, of the Afterfeast - 3 and to the saint - 4, Glory: to the saint, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone.
 380: ##### 2.13.1.3 On the Aposticha: Sunday stichera of the *Octoechos*, Glory, Both now: of the Afterfeast
 381: ##### 2.13.1.4 At the end: Sunday Troparion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the Afterfeast
 382: 5.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of Sunday and of the saint[^197].
 383: AT COMPLINE: After *“It is truly meet”* with the Trisagion - Hypakoe of the tone, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the feast.
 384: AT THE Midnight Office: Trinitarian Canon of the *Octoechos* of the current tone and other things, as usual.
 385: #### 2.13.2 AT Great Matins
 386: ##### 2.13.2.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast; everything else up to the Sunday Canon - as usual
 387: ##### 2.13.2.2 Canons 4 on 14: Sunday *Octoechos* with Heirmos on 4, of the Theotokos *Octoechos* on 2, of the feast on 4 and of the saint on 4
 388:   * **If the saint be on 6**, then also - on 4. Katavasia after every Ode - current. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast and of the saint, Glory: Sessional Hymn of the saint, Both now: of the feast. After the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos Sunday, after the 9th - *“More honorable”*, after the 9th - "Holy is the Lord our God", Sunday Exapostilarion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the feast.
 389: ##### 2.13.2.3 Praises stichera - 8, that is: 4 Sunday from the *Octoechos* and 4 of the feast with two of its refrains. Glory: Gospel Sticheron, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"
 390:   * If the saint has Praises stichera, then stichera of the feast are not taken and, instead of them, 4 stichera are taken to the saint with two of His refrains, that is: 3 prosomia and one idiomelon, which is on Glory[^198], then Glory: Gospel Sticheron, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou".
 391: ##### 2.13.2.4 After the Doxology - Sunday Troparion, one of two usual ones
 392: 5.	the Great Dismissal, as at Vespers.
 393: #### 2.13.3 AT THE HOURS
 394: At all: Sunday Troparion, also Glory: at the 1st and 6th - also of the feast, at the 3rd and 9th - also to the saint. Kontakion, only Sunday and of the feast, we say alternatingly, that is: at the 1st and 6th - of the feast, at the 3rd and 9th - Sunday[^199].
 395: #### 2.13.4 AT THE LITURGY
 396: Antiphons, in the Afterfeast of a feast of the Lord, we take: two first - of the feast, third - usual with the refrain of the feast, also "Come"[^200]. In the Afterfeast of the Theotokos - Antiphons usual on all Sundays. Sunday Troparion and of the feast, Glory: Sunday Kontakion, Both now: of the feast and the Trisagion[^201]. Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia, Gospel and Communion Hymn - only Sunday[^202].

 398: ## 2.14 Afterfeast with a Saint without a Polyeleos on Weekdays and Saturday
 399: AT VESPERS
 400: ##### 2.14.1 Kathisma current
 401: ##### 2.14.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 6 stichera, that is: 3 of the feast and 3 to the saint, Glory, Both now: to the feast, or Glory: to the saint, if he has, Both now: of the feast
 402:   * **If two saints occur**, then there will be to the first - 3 and to the second - 3, Glory, Both now: of the feast.
 403:   * **If a saint on 6 occurs**, then the stichera to him will be only 3[^203], as also to the saint on 4.
 404: On Friday evening for Saturday - 1st Theotokion of the tone, which is being taken leave of (Dogmatikon)[^204].
 405: ##### 2.14.3 On the Aposticha: stichera of the feast, Glory: to the saint, if there be, Both now: of the feast, if - not, then Glory, Both now: of the feast
 406: ##### 2.14.4 At the end: Troparion to the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 407:   * **If two saints occur**, then the troparion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast.
 408: ##### 2.14.5 Dismissal medium with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint, without commemoration of the service of the weekday, because it is not taken
 409: #### 2.14.1 AT COMPLINE
 410: Canon of the Most Holy Theotokos, according to the sequence of the *Octoechos*. After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the feast alone.
 411: AT THE Midnight Office: Everything exactly so, as in the *Horologion*.
 412: AT MATINS
 413: ##### 2.14.1.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion of the feast twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast
 414:   * **If two saints occur**, then the troparion of the feast once and of the first saint once, Glory: of the second, Both now: again of the feast.
 415: ##### 2.14.1.2 Kathismata two current with Sessional Hymns of the feast
 416: ##### 2.14.1.3 Canons 2 on 12, that is: of the feast with Heirmos on 8 and of the saint on 4. Katavasia after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th Ode - Heirmos of the last canon, that is of the saint. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional Hymn of the saint; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the saint twice, Glory, Both now: of the feast[^205]
 417:   * **If two saints occur**, then 3 canons on 14, that is: Canon of the feast with Heirmos on 6, to the first saint on 4 and to the second on 4. Katavasia after the 3rd, 6th, 8th and 9th Ode - Heirmos of the last canon, that is of the second saint. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the first and of the second saint, also Sessional Hymn of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast; after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast.
 418:   * **If a saint on 6 occurs**, then the Canon of the feast with Heirmos on 6 and to the saint on 6[^206], everything else, as above with one saint.
 419: ##### 2.14.1.4 On the Aposticha: stichera of the feast, Glory: to the saint, if there be, Both now: of the feast, if - not, then Glory, Both now: of the feast
 420:   * If the saint on 6 will have Praises stichera with the Small Doxology, then they are taken on 4 and Glory: his, and Both now: of the feast. After the Litany "Let us complete" will be on the Aposticha stichera of the feast, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast[^207]. If this saint will have also the Great Doxology, then the Praises stichera are taken: of the feast - 3 and to the saint - 3, Glory: to the saint, and Both now: of the feast. And after the Doxology with the Trisagion - his Troparion, Glory, Both now: of the feast, and everything else, as at Great Matins.
 421: ##### 2.14.1.5 At the end: Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 422:   * If there be two saints, then the troparion of the first saint, Glory: of the second, Both now: of the feast.
 423: #### 2.14.2 AT THE HOURS
 424: At all: Troparion of the feast, Glory: at the 3rd and 9th - also to the saint. Kontakia - alternating, that is: at the 1st and 6th - of the feast, at the 3rd and 9th - to the saint.
 425:   * If two saints, then Glory: at the 3rd - to the first, and at the 9th - to the second saint. Kontakia: at the 3rd - to the first, at the 9th - to the second saint[^208].
 426: #### 2.14.3 AT THE LITURGY
 427: ##### 2.14.3.1 Antiphons in the Afterfeast of the Lord we take: two first - from the feast itself, third - general with the refrain of the feast, also and "Come, let us worship"; in the Afterfeast of the Theotokos antiphons so, as also on all days
 428: ##### 2.14.3.2 At the Entrance - Troparion, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the feast, Trisagion
 429: ##### 2.14.3.3 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - of the feast, Apostle and Gospel - of the day. Instead of *“It is truly meet”* - Heirmos of the 9th Ode of the Canon of the feast with its refrain. Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint[^209]

 432: ## 2.15 Afterfeast with a Saint with a Polyeleos on a Sunday
 433: #### 2.15.1 AT Great Vespers
 434: ##### 2.15.1.1 Kathisma 1-a *“Blessed is the man”* (according to the Typikon - whole)
 435: ##### 2.15.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 10 stichera, that is: 3 Sunday from the *Octoechos*, 3 of the feast and 4 to the saint, Glory: to the saint, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the current tone (Dogmatikon)[^210]
 436: ##### 2.15.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day *“The Lord is King”* and 3 readings to the saint
 437: ##### 2.15.1.4 On the Aposticha: Sunday stichera of the *Octoechos*, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast
 438: ##### 2.15.1.5 At the end: Sunday Troparion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the feast
 439: 6.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of Sunday and of the saint[^211].
 440: #### 2.15.2 AT COMPLINE
 441: ##### 2.15.2.1 Canon of the Theotokos from the *Octoechos* of the current tone
 442: ##### 2.15.2.2 After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the saint, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the feast[^212]
 443: AT THE Midnight Office
 444: Trinitarian Canon from the *Octoechos* of the current tone; everything else, as usually in the *Horologion*.
 445: #### 2.15.3 AT Great Matins
 446: ##### 2.15.3.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the feast
 447: ##### 2.15.3.2 Kathismata two current with their Sunday Sessional Hymns, also Polyeleos with Magnifications and "The Angelic Host". After the Small Litany - Hypakoe of the tone and all three Sessional Hymns of the saint without their Theotokia, that is 1st and 2nd, also Glory: 3rd, Both now: of the feast. Everything else up to the canon - Sunday, as usual
 448: ##### 2.15.3.3 Canons 3 on 14, that is Sunday with Heirmos on 4, of the feast on 4 and to the saint on 6; Katavasia designated after every Ode, after the 3rd - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast and of the saint, also Sessional Hymn of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast, after the 6th - Sunday Kontakion-Ikos; after the 9th - Sunday Exapostilarion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the feast. On the 9th - *“More honorable”* (with the exception of Sundays in the middle of the Feast of the Resurrection, for then we sing the Heirmos of the Festal Canon)[^213]
 449: ##### 2.15.3.4 Praises stichera - 8, that is: 4 Sunday and 4 to the saint, with two refrains, given on Vespers, Glory: Gospel Sticheron, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"
 450: ##### 2.15.3.5 After the Great Doxology - Sunday Troparion, one of two usual ones
 451: 6.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of Sunday and of the saint.
 452: #### 2.15.4 AT THE HOURS
 453: At all: Sunday Troparion, also Glory: at the 1st and 6th - of the feast, at the 3rd and 9th - to the saint[^214]. After the Trisagion - Sunday Kontakion, of the feast and of the saint alternating[^215], that is: at the 1st and 9th - Sunday, at the 3rd - of the feast, at the 6th - to the saint.
 454: #### 2.15.5 AT THE LITURGY
 455: ##### 2.15.5.1 Antiphons in the Afterfeast of the Lord will be: two first - of the feast, third - general with the refrain of the feast, also and "Come, let us worship"
 456: ##### 2.15.5.2 At the Entrance - Sunday Troparion, of the feast and of the saint; also Sunday Kontakion, Glory: of the saint, Both now: of the feast. Prokeimenon, Apostle, Alleluia and Gospel - of Sunday and to the saint[^216]

 458: ## 2.16 Afterfeast with a Saint with a Polyeleos on Weekdays
 459: #### 2.16.1 AT Great Vespers
 460: ##### 2.16.1.1 Kathisma 1-a (*“Blessed is the man”*, according to the Typikon - 1st antiphon)
 461: ##### 2.16.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 8 stichera[^218], that is: of the feast - 3 and to the saint - 5, Glory: to the saint, Both now: to the feast. On Friday evening - Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone (Dogmatikon)
 462: ##### 2.16.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day from the *Horologion
 463: ##### 2.16.1.4 Three readings to the saint
 464: ##### 2.16.1.5 Aposticha whole - to the saint with his refrains, only Both now: of the feast
 465: ##### 2.16.1.6 At the end: Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 466: ##### 2.16.1.7 Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint
 467: #### 2.16.2 AT COMPLINE
 468: ##### 2.16.2.1 Canon of the Theotokos from the *Octoechos* of the current tone
 469: ##### 2.16.2.2 After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the feast one[^219]
 470: AT THE Midnight Office: Everything, as usual.
 471: #### 2.16.3 AT Great Matins
 472: ##### 2.16.3.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion of the feast twice, Glory: to the saint, Both now: once more of the feast
 473: ##### 2.16.3.2 Kathismata two current with Sessional Hymns of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast. Sometimes these two Sessional Hymns will be only of the feast (January 11 and May 9)[^220]; third Kathisma, Polyeleos with Magnifications, also Sessional Hymn of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 474: ##### 2.16.3.3 Gradual of the 4th tone, 1st antiphon. Everything else up to the canon - to the saint
 475: ##### 2.16.3.4 Canons 2 or 3 on 14, that is: of the feast with Heirmos on 6, also two or one canon to the saint on 8[^221]. Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd Ode - Kontakion-Ikos of the feast and Sessional Hymn of the saint twice, Glory, Both now: Sessional Hymn of the feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos of the saint, after the 9th - Exapostilarion of the saint twice, Glory, Both now: Exapostilarion of the feast
 476: ##### 2.16.3.5 Praises stichera sometimes - 4, all to the saint[^222], sometimes - 6, that is: 3 of the feast and 3 to the saint, Glory: to the saint, Both now: of the feast
 477: ##### 2.16.3.6 After the Great Doxology - Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 478: 7.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint.
 479: #### 2.16.4 AT THE HOURS
 480: At all: Troparion of the feast, Glory: to the saint; Kontakia - alternating, that is at the 1st and 6th - of the feast, at the 3rd and 9th - to the saint[^224].
 481: #### 2.16.5 AT THE LITURGY
 482: ##### 2.16.5.1 Antiphons in the Afterfeast of the Lord will be: two first - of the feast, third - general with the refrain of the feast, also and "Come". In the Afterfeast of the Theotokos - antiphons daily "It is good"
 483: ##### 2.16.5.2 At the Entrance - Troparion of the feast and of the saint, Glory: Kontakion of the saint, Both now: Kontakion of the feast
 484: ##### 2.16.5.3 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - of the feast and to the saint; Apostle and Gospel - of the day and to the saint[^225]. Instead of *“It is truly meet”* - Heirmos of the feast

 486: ## 2.17 Afterfeast with a Saint with an All-Night Vigil on a Sunday
 487: AT SMALL VESPERS
 488: Everything as without the Afterfeast with a saint with All-Night Vigil on a Sunday; that is to the saint - nothing[^226].
 489: #### 2.17.1 AT Great Vespers
 490: ##### 2.17.1.1 Kathisma, stichera on *“Lord, I have cried”* and on the Aposticha so, as also with a Polyeleos saint in the Afterfeast on a Sunday, as here above
 491: ##### 2.17.1.2 On the Litiya: stichera to the saint, Glory, Both now: to the feast
 492: ##### 2.17.1.3 At the Blessing of Loaves: Troparion "O Virgin Theotokos" twice and to the saint once[^227]
 493: AT Great Matins, AT THE HOURS AND AT THE LITURGY
 494: Everything according to the Typikon of a Polyeleos saint, as above on page 100-102.
 495: ## 2.18 Afterfeast with a Saint with an All-Night Vigil on Weekdays
 496: AT SMALL VESPERS
 497: On *“Lord, I have cried”* and on the Aposticha - everything to the saint, only Both now: of the feast; also at the end - Troparion of the saint, Glory, Both now: of the feast.
 498: #### 2.18.1 AT Great Vespers
 499: Everything according to the Typikon of a Polyeleos saint with the Afterfeast on weekdays, as here above (page 102), only on the Litiya and on the Aposticha there will be stichera of the saint, Glory: his, Both now: of the feast. At the Blessing of Loaves: Troparion of the saint twice and "O Virgin Theotokos" once.
 500: AT Great Matins, AT THE HOURS AND AT THE LITURGY
 501: Everything according to the general Typikon of a Polyeleos saint with the Afterfeast on weekdays, as here above (page 103-104).
 502: ## 2.19 Apodosis of a Feast on a Sunday
 503: Notes
 504: ##### 2.19.1 The service of the current saint, which falls on the Apodosis of the feast, is transferred to the immediately preceding[^228] or following day[^229], sometimes also to another day, if it will not be occupied by two saints or one with a Polyeleos; sometimes it is limited to the canon at Compline after the Canon of the Theotokos
 505: ##### 2.19.2 The service of the feast on the Apodosis, from Vespers to the Canon of Matins has only the daily form, from the Canon to the end of Matins - the great form. If the Apodosis falls on a Sunday, then Vespers and Matins are great, in view of the Sunday service
 506: #### 2.19.1 AT Great Vespers
 507: ##### 2.19.1.1 Kathisma *“Blessed is the man”
 508: ##### 2.19.1.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 10 stichera, that is: 4 Sunday from the *Octoechos* and 6 of the feast, Glory: of the feast, Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone (Dogmatikon)
 509: ##### 2.19.1.3 Prokeimenon of the day *“The Lord is King”
 510: ##### 2.19.1.4 Aposticha Sunday, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 511: ##### 2.19.1.5 At the end: Sunday Troparion of the tone, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 512: 6.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration Sunday and of the saint, whose day it is[^230].
 513: #### 2.19.2 AT COMPLINE
 514: Canon of the Theotokos, which is of the sequence of the *Octoechos*. After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the feast one[^231].
 515: AT THE Midnight Office
 516: Trinitarian Canon of the *Octoechos*, as usual. On the Apodosis of Mid-Pentecost and of the Resurrection, after the 1st Trisagion, - Troparion of the feast, after the 2nd - Kontakion of the feast; prayers "Remember" we do not say.
 517: #### 2.19.3 AT Great Matins
 518: ##### 2.19.3.1 On *“God is the Lord”*: Sunday Troparion twice, Glory, Both now: of the feast
 519: ##### 2.19.3.2 Everything else up to the canon - Sunday, as usual
 520: ##### 2.19.3.3 Canons 3 or 4 on 14, that is: first - from the *Octoechos* Sunday with Heirmos on 4, second - from the *Octoechos* of the Theotokos on 2 and of the feast - one or two on 8. Katavasia current after every Ode. After the 3rd - Kontakion-Ikos and Sessional Hymn of the feast; after the 6th - Kontakion-Ikos Sunday[^232]; at the 9th - *“More honorable”* with refrains of the feast to the troparion of the canon of the feast; at the 9th - Sunday Exapostilarion current; Glory, Both now: of the feast
 521: ##### 2.19.3.4 Praises stichera - 8, that is: 4 Sunday of the *Octoechos* and 4 of the feast with "Glory"[^233] and with two refrains of the feast; Glory: Gospel Sticheron, Both now: "Most Blessed Art Thou"
 522: ##### 2.19.3.5 After the Great Doxology - Sunday Troparion, one of two usual ones
 523: 6.	the Great Dismissal with commemoration, as at Vespers.
 524: #### 2.19.4 AT THE HOURS
 525: At all: Sunday Troparion, Glory: of the feast; Kontakia - alternating, that is at the 1st and 6th - Sunday, at the 3rd and 9th - of the feast[^234].
 526: #### 2.19.5 AT THE LITURGY
 527: ##### 2.19.5.1 First two Antiphons, if the feast is of the Lord - of the feast, third - usual with the refrain of the feast; also and "Come, let us worship". If the feast is of the Theotokos, antiphons - Sunday, as here usual, on all Sundays; sometimes "It is good" with the Sunday refrain
 528: ##### 2.19.5.2 At the Entrance - Sunday Troparion and of the feast, Glory: Sunday Kontakion, Both now: of the feast[^235]
 529: ##### 2.19.5.3 Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn of the Sunday and of the feast. Apostle and Gospel on the Apodosis of the Lord - only Sunday[^236], on the Apodosis of the Theotokos - first of the Sunday, and then - of the feast[^237]
 530: ## 2.20 Apodosis of a Feast on Weekdays
 531: AT VESPERS
 532: ##### 2.20.1 Kathisma current
 533: ##### 2.20.2 On *“Lord, I have cried”* - 6 stichera: all - to the feast; Glory, Both now: of the feast
 534: On Friday evening - Both now: 1st Theotokion of the tone, which is being taken leave of (Dogmatikon)[^238], except for the Apodosis of the Nativity, Theophany and Pentecost, when *“Glory, Both now”* will be of the feast[^239].
 535: ##### 2.20.3 No Entrance, nor readings; Prokeimenon of the day from the *Horologion
 536: ##### 2.20.4 Aposticha whole - of the feast, from Great Vespers
 537: ##### 2.20.5 At the end: Troparion of the feast one
 538: ##### 2.20.6 Dismissal medium with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint of the day[^240]
 539: #### 2.20.1 AT COMPLINE
 540: ##### 2.20.1.1 Canon of the Theotokos - current of the *Octoechos
 541: ##### 2.20.1.2 After *“It is truly meet”* - Kontakion of the feast one
 542: AT THE Midnight Office
 543: Everything exactly so, as in the *Horologion*; only on the Apodosis of Mid-Pentecost and of the Resurrection: after the 1st Trisagion there will be the Troparion of the feast, after the 2nd - Kontakion of the feast, without prayers "Remember".
 544: AT MATINS
 545: ##### 2.20.1.3 On *“God is the Lord”*: Troparion of the feast twice, Glory, Both now: again once
 546: ##### 2.20.1.4 Kathismata two current with Sessional Hymns of the feast and immediately Psalm 50 and Canon
 547: ##### 2.20.1.5 Canon and everything else until the end of Matins - exactly so, as on the feast itself. Therefore at the 9th Ode there will be no *“More honorable”*, but refrains of the feast
 548: 4.	the Great Dismissal with the commemoration of the feast and of the saint.
 549: AT THE HOURS: At all: Troparion and Kontakion only of the feast, as on the feast itself.
 550: #### 2.20.2 AT THE LITURGY
 551: ##### 2.20.2.1 Two first Antiphons on the Apodosis of the Lord - of the feast, third - usual with the refrain of the feast, also and "Come, let us worship" (on the Apodosis of the Theotokos antiphons - daily)
 552: ##### 2.20.2.2 At the Entrance - Troparion, Glory, Both now: Kontakion of the feast and Trisagion. Prokeimenon, Alleluia and Communion Hymn - of the feast
 553: ##### 2.20.2.3 Apostle and Gospel on the Apodosis of a feast of the Lord - only of the day, on the Apodosis of a feast of the Theotokos - first of the day, and then - of the feast

 176: ### 1.2.2 Order of Great Vespers without Vigil
 177: #### 1.2.2.1 Beginning
 178: *The Priest takes the epitrachelion, blesses it and, having kissed the cross upon it which is at the top, puts it on himself and exits through the northern door to the front of the closed Holy Doors. Here, having bowed low, he begins as usual:*
 179: > **Priest**: "Blessed is our God," etc.
 180: 
 181: *The choirs sing 'Amen,' and also recite alternately the introductory prayers, that is, 'Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee,' 'O Heavenly King,' 'O All-Holy Trinity,' 'Lord, have mercy' (3), 'Glory, Both now,' 'Our Father.' The Priest:*
 182: > **Priest**: "For Thine is the kingdom."
 183: 
 184: *The choirs: 'Amen,' also 'Lord, have mercy' (12), 6 by each Choir, 'Glory, Both now,' 'Come, let us worship' (3).*
 185: #### 1.2.2.2 Notes
 186: 1. *If there is only one choir, then all the aforementioned is recited alternately by the Priest and the Choir such that after 'Amen' the Priest begins: 'Glory to Thee, our God, glory to Thee.'*
 187: 2. *If there are also deacons, then they too, having exited with the Priest from the sanctuary to the front of the Holy Doors, stand there: one on the right, and the second on the left of him, and the one on the right proclaims:*
 188:    > **Deacon**: "Bless, Master."
 189: 
 190:    *...and the Priest begins:*
 191:    > **Priest**: "Blessed is our God..."[^15]
 192: #### 1.2.2.3 Main Part
 193: *After this, from the Prefatory Psalm to the exclamation 'Blessed be the might of Thy kingdom' of the litany 'Let us complete,' all parts are taken and everything is done as at Great Vespers with Vigil, only at this Vespers, at 'Lord, I have cried' there can be not only 10 or 8 stichera as at Great [Vespers] with Vigil, but also 6.*
 194: 
 195: *After the exclamation of the Priest, who remains at the Holy Table (together with the deacons, if there are any) 'Blessed be the might of Thy kingdom,' the Aposticha is sung, also 'Lord, now lettest Thou,' the Trisagion and everything else with 'Our Father,' after which the Priest:*
 196: > **Priest**: "For Thine is the kingdom."
 197: 
 198: *The choirs sing the troparia in the following manner:*
 199: * **If the service is Sunday**: *they sing the Sunday troparion of the current tone, also Glory: the troparion of the current Saint (of the Menaion) and at the end Both now: the Theotokion, one of the Sunday ones, according to the tone of the troparion of the current Saint.*
 200: * **If there is no Sunday service, but there is a service of a Polyeleos Saint**: *then the troparion of the Saint is taken, Glory, Both now: the Theotokion, from the Sunday ones, according to the tone of the troparion of the Saint.*
 201: * **In the middle of a Feast (of the Lord or of the Theotokos)**: *Theotokia are not taken, but after the troparion of the Saint, the troparion of the Feast is taken.*
 202: #### 1.2.2.4 Conclusion
 203: > **Priest**: "Wisdom!"
 204: > 
 205: > **Choir**: "Bless."
 206: > 
 207: > **Priest**: "Blessed and pre-glorified Christ our God, always, now and ever, and unto ages of ages."[^16]
 208: > 
 209: > **Choir**: "Amen," *(and immediately)* "Confirm, O God, the Catholic faith unto ages of ages."
 210: > 
 211: > **Priest**: "O Most Holy Theotokos, save us."
 212: > 
 213: > **Choir**: "More honorable..."
 214: > 
 215: > **Priest**: "Glory to Thee, O Christ God, our hope, glory to Thee." *(bowing low to the Holy Mysteries)*
 216: > 
 217: > **Choir**: "Glory, Both now. Lord, have mercy (3). Lord, bless."[^17]
 218: 
 219: *The Priest departs from the Holy Table and, standing in the Holy Doors facing the people, pronounces the dismissal, mentioning in it the current service (that is, the one which falls on that day, one or more, as many as there are).*
 220: #### 1.2.2.5 Notes
 221: 1. *If there are deacons, then at the end of the troparia they exit, each through his own door, to the front of the Holy Doors and, having bowed low to the Holy Mysteries, take their stand: one on the right, and the second on the left of the Holy Doors, facing one another; then the first deacon, who is near the icon of the Savior, lifts the orarion with three fingers of his right hand toward the people and exclaims:*
 222:    > **First Deacon**: "Wisdom!"
 223: 
 224:    *...the second, who is near the icon of the Theotokos:*
 225:    > **Second Deacon**: "Bless."
 226: 
 227:    *Priest:*
 228:    > **Priest**: "Blessed and pre-glorified," etc.
 229: 
 230:    *...and remains there until the end of the dismissal. When the Priest pronounces the dismissal, both deacons hold their oraria raised with three fingers of the right hand, and at the end, having bowed all together to the Holy Mysteries, they enter, each through his own door, into the sanctuary and, having closed the Holy Doors together with the Priest and having bowed all three together to the Holy Mysteries, depart to the sacristy. If there is only one deacon, he alone exits through the southern door to the front of the icon of the Savior and exclaims:*
 231:    > **Deacon**: "Wisdom!"
 232: 
 233:    *...holding during this and at the dismissal the orarion raised as was noted above.*
 234: 2. *It is not proper to sit at this Vespers either, when it is prescribed not to sit at Vespers with Vigil, up to, and including, the dismissal.*

 237: ### 1.2.3 Order of Daily Vespers
 238: #### 1.2.3.1 Rubrics during the entire Vespers
 239: *Let it be known that at this Vespers there is no Entrance, therefore the Holy Doors are not opened, nor do deacons serve, nor does the Priest use the phelonion, but only the epitrachelion; he censes only at 'Lord, I have cried.' The Priest comes out to the front of the Holy Doors in the following cases:*
 240: 1. *At the beginning as at Great Vespers.*
 241: 2. *At all litanies (except the one Small Litany, which, according to local custom, he says quietly at his place).*
 242: 3. *At 'Wisdom! Upright!' and remains there until the end of the exclamation:*
 243:    > **Priest**: "Let us be attentive! Peace be unto all!"
 244: 
 245:    *...during which he gives the peace, having turned to the people.*
 246: 4. *At the end, at the dismissal.*
 247: #### 1.2.3.2 Text and Rubrics Flow
 248: *From the beginning of Vespers until the stichera at 'Lord, I have cried' everything is similar as at Great Vespers without Vigil; only here, instead of the 1st Kathisma ('Blessed is the man'), the current Kathisma will be [read]; if on the previous day there was a Vigil, then on account of the vigil labor, the current Kathisma is not taken at such Vespers; and because formerly, according to the Typikon, the Vigil was every Sunday, therefore, according to that same Typikon, at Vespers on Sunday for Monday there is no Kathisma, even though now there is not a Vigil every Sunday.*
 249: 
 250: *The stichera at 'Lord, I have cried' will be not 10 and not 8, but 6, at the end of which there will be no Prayer of the Entrance because there is no Entrance. Upon the conclusion of the stichera:*
 251: > **Priest**: "Wisdom! Upright!"
 252: 
 253: *...'Gladsome Light,' and then:*
 254: > **Priest**: "Let us be attentive! Peace be unto all!"
 255: > 
 256: > **Priest**: "Wisdom! Let us be attentive!"
 257: 
 258: *...and the Prokeimenon of the day from the Horologion; there will be no readings, nor is there at this place the litany 'Let us say all,' but immediately 'Vouchsafe, O Lord' and everything else until the end as at Great Vespers without Vigil, only here after the troparion of the Saint, because he is not a Polyeleos one, the Theotokion is not taken from the Sunday ones, but from the Daily Dismissal ones, according to the tone of the troparion of the Saint and according to the day of the week. If two Saints occur, then are taken: the troparion of the first Saint, Glory: the troparion of the second, Both now: the Dismissal Theotokion, according to the tone of the troparion of the second Saint; in the middle of a Feast also at this Vespers we do not conclude with the Dismissal Theotokia, but with the troparion of the Feast. Furthermore, upon the conclusion of the troparia, the Priest sings the litany 'Have mercy on us, O God' and makes the middle dismissal, that is, he exclaims:*
 259: > **Priest**: "Wisdom!"
 260: 
 261: *...and the Choir immediately: 'More honorable' and everything else as at Great Vespers without Vigil. At 'Christ our True God' the Priest turns to the people.*
 262: #### 1.2.3.3 Notes
 263: 1. *On Sunday itself or on another Feast with Vigil in parish churches in the province, the general custom remains to make an Entrance.*
 264: 2. *It is not proper to sit at this Vespers either, when it is not permitted to sit at Great Vespers without Vigil.*
 265: ________________________________________
 266: ### 1.2.4 Order of Small Vespers
 267: *This Vespers is celebrated just as Daily [Vespers][^18], however, without a Kathisma and without litanies, except for the last 'Have mercy on us, O God,' which only the Slavonic Typikons present, but the Greek do not prescribe. The stichera at 'Lord, I have cried' will be only 4. The dismissal, although it can begin from 'Glory to Thee, O Christ God,' yet with us is exclaimed also before that:*
 268: > **Priest**: "Wisdom!"
 269: 
 270: *...and 'More honorable' just as at Daily Vespers.*
